failed.question:
A buyer and a seller entered into a written contract for the sale of land. The contract satisfied the requirements of the statute of frauds. Because the buyer needed time to obtain financing, the buyer and the seller did not agree upon a closing date, and the written contract did not contain a stated closing date. Ten days after signing the contract, the buyer and the seller orally agreed to rescind the contract. The next day, the seller sold the land to a third party.
Two days after that sale, the original buyer told the seller that she had changed her mind and wanted to complete their contract. When the seller told her that he had sold the land to a third party, she sued him for breach of the written contract.
For whom will the court find?

questions.question:
An unmarried couple had been living together in an apartment for several years when they decided to purchase a starter home as tenants in common. In lieu of drafting wills, the couple verbally agreed that if either of them died, the other should own the entire home.
The couple was later involved in a serious plane crash. The man died instantly, and the woman died one day later. Each was survived by a single heir.
Common law marriage is not recognized in the jurisdiction in which the home is situated. The only applicable statute is the statute of frauds.
In an appropriate action between the couple's heirs to determine ownership of the home, how will the court likely rule?

choices.a: Each heir owns an undivided one-half interest in the home because the couple died in the same plane crash.
choices.b: Each heir owns an undivided one-half interest in the home because the statute of frauds applies.
choices.c: The woman's heir owns the entire home because the couple reasonably relied upon their verbal agreement and never made wills.
choices.d: The woman's heir owns the entire home because the deed will be reformed to reflect the subsequent verbal agreement.

data.questionStem:
Q86114

An unmarried couple had been living together in an apartment for several years when they decided to purchase a starter home as tenants in common. In lieu of drafting wills, the couple verbally agreed that if either of them died, the other should own the entire home.

The couple was later involved in a serious plane crash. The man died instantly, and the woman died one day later. Each was survived by a single heir.

Common law marriage is not recognized in the jurisdiction in which the home is situated. The only applicable statute is the statute of frauds.

In an appropriate action between the couple's heirs to determine ownership of the home, how will the court likely rule?

一对未婚伴侣在一套公寓里同居数年后，决定以分权共有人的形式购买一套入门级住宅。为替代起草遗嘱，该伴侣口头约定，如果其中一方亡故，另一方应拥有整栋房屋的所有权。

后来，这对伴侣卷入了一场严重的飞机失事。男方当场死亡，女方在一天后死亡。两人身后各留有一名继承人。

房屋所在地的司法管辖区不承认普通法婚姻。唯一适用的法规是《防止欺诈法》(statute of frauds)。

在该伴侣的继承人之间为确定房屋所有权而提起的适当诉讼中，法院可能会如何裁决？
options:
A. Each heir owns an undivided one-half interest in the home because the couple died in the same plane crash.
每位继承人拥有房屋不可分割的二分之一权益，因为该伴侣死于同一次飞机失事。

B. Each heir owns an undivided one-half interest in the home because the statute of frauds applies.
每位继承人拥有房屋不可分割的二分之一权益，因为《防止欺诈法》(statute of frauds)适用。

C. The woman's heir owns the entire home because the couple reasonably relied upon their verbal agreement and never made wills.
女方的继承人拥有整栋房屋的所有权，因为该伴侣合理地信赖了他们的口头协议，并且从未订立遗嘱。

D. The woman's heir owns the entire home because the deed will be reformed to reflect the subsequent verbal agreement.
女方的继承人拥有整栋房屋的所有权，因为地契将被修正以反映后来的口头协议。
data.explanation:
A tenancy in common is a concurrent estate in which each co-tenant holds a separate share of the property and the right to possess the entire property with no right of survivorship. But a right of survivorship can be created by an agreement that satisfies the statute of frauds - ie, the agreement must:

  • be in writing
  • be signed by the parties against whom it is to be enforced and
  • contain all essential terms.


A right of survivorship causes a co-tenant's property interest to disappear upon his/her death and allows the remaining co-tenants' interests to expand proportionately.

Here, the couple (tenants in common) agreed that whoever survived the other would own the entire home (right of survivorship). But since their agreement was verbal , it is unenforceable under the statute of frauds. Therefore, when the man died, his one-half interest transferred to his sole heir - not the woman. And when the woman died one day later, her one-half interest transferred to her sole heir.

(Choice A) Under the Uniform Simultaneous Death Act, when two or more persons die without a will and within 120 hours of each other, each is considered to have predeceased the others. This act does not apply here since the only applicable statute is the statute of frauds.

(Choice C) The doctrine of promissory estoppel allows a party to enforce an otherwise unenforceable promise upon which it reasonably and detrimentally relied. But reliance on a conditional promise (eg, a promise of property conditioned upon survivorship) is unreasonable. Therefore, the couple's reliance upon the right-of-survivorship agreement does not make it enforceable.

(Choice D) Reformation is an equitable remedy that is used to correct mistakes in a deed. Since the deed here accurately reflects the couple's apparent agreement to create a tenancy in common, the court will not reform it to reflect the later verbal agreement.

Educational objective: A right of survivorship can be created by an agreement that satisfies the statute of frauds - ie,
  • (1) is in writing,
  • (2) is signed by the parties against whom it will be enforced, and
  • (3) contains all essential terms.




选项正确率统计：A选项 16%，B选项 74%（正确选项），C选项 4%，D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

分权共有 (tenancy in common) 是一种共同财产所有权形式，其中每个共有人都持有财产的独立份额，并有权占有整个财产，但没有生还者取得权 (right of survivorship)。但是，生还者取得权可以通过一份满足《防止欺诈法》(statute of frauds) 的协议来创设——即，该协议必须：

  • 是书面形式
  • 由被执行方签署 并且
  • 包含所有必要条款。


生还者取得权导致共有人亡故后其财产权益消失，并允许其余共有人的权益按比例扩大。

在本案中，该伴侣（分权共有人）约定，任何生还的一方将拥有整栋房屋（生还者取得权）。但由于他们的协议是口头的，根据《防止欺诈法》(statute of frauds)，该协议不可强制执行。因此，当男方亡故时，他的二分之一权益转移给了他的唯一继承人——而不是女方。当女方一天后亡故时，她的二分之一权益转移给了她的唯一继承人。

(选项 A) 根据《统一同时死亡法》(Uniform Simultaneous Death Act)，当两个或两个以上的人在没有遗嘱的情况下于120小时内相继死亡时，每个人都被视为先于其他人死亡。该法案在此不适用，因为唯一适用的法规是《防止欺诈法》(statute of frauds)。

(选项 C) “禁止反言”原则 (promissory estoppel) 允许一方强制执行一项其合理且有损害地信赖的、原本不可强制执行的承诺。但对有条件承诺（例如，以生还为条件的财产承诺）的信赖是不合理的。因此，该伴侣对生还者取得权协议的信赖并不能使其具有可执行性。

(选项 D) 修正是用于纠正地契中错误的一种衡平法上的救济措施。由于本案中的地契准确地反映了该伴侣创设分权共有的明显协议，法院不会为了反映后来的口头协议而对其进行修正。

教学目标：生还者取得权可以通过一份满足《防止欺诈法》(statute of frauds) 的协议来创设——即，协议必须
  • (1) 是书面形式，
  • (2) 由被执行方签署，以及
  • (3) 包含所有必要条款。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property & Contracts
核心法律规则 在不动产法中，Tenancy in Common（分权共有）是默认的共有形式，没有生还者取得权（No Right of Survivorship）。

若要改变这一性质（例如增加生还者取得权），必须满足 Statute of Frauds（防止欺诈法）的要求，即必须有书面形式。

案情逻辑推演

1. 初始状态：
这对伴侣以 Tenants in Common 的身份买房。这意味着他们各自拥有独立的份额，且一方死后，份额传给其继承人，而非另一方共有人。
2. 试图改变：
他们口头约定（Verbally agreed）如果一方死亡，另一方拥有全部。这实际上是试图创建一个 Joint Tenancy 或赋予 Right of Survivorship。
3. 法律障碍：
题目明确指出适用 Statute of Frauds。不动产权益的转让或变更必须是书面的（In writing）并由当事人签字。口头协议在不动产法中通常是无效的。
4. 最终结果：
口头协议无效 ➔ 回到默认的 Tenancy in Common 状态。
  • 男方死后，其 1/2 份额传给男方的继承人。
  • 女方（一天后）死后，其 1/2 份额传给女方的继承人。

选项解析

✅ 选项 B (正确答案)
每位继承人拥有 1/2 权益。
因为《防止欺诈法》(Statute of Frauds) 适用，口头的生还者取得权协议无效。因此，财产按分权共有处理，各自的份额进入各自的遗产，由各自的继承人继承。
❌ 选项 A (错误)
该选项提及“死于同一次事故”，暗示适用《统一同时死亡法》(USDA)。但题目明确规定“唯一适用的法规是《防止欺诈法》”，且女方比男方多活了一天，不符合通常的同时死亡推定。
❌ 选项 C (错误)
虽然有“禁止反言”(Promissory Estoppel) 理论，但在不动产交易中，仅仅基于口头承诺而没有实质性的、合理的损害性信赖(Detrimental Reliance)，通常不足以克服《防止欺诈法》。仅仅是“没有立遗嘱”通常不构成足够的损害性信赖。
❌ 选项 D (错误)
地契修正 (Reformation) 是一种衡平法救济，用于纠正书写错误。这里的地契准确反映了他们购买时的状态（Tenants in Common），并没有错误，因此法院不会重写地契。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 看到 "Real Estate"（不动产）加上 "Verbal/Oral Agreement"（口头协议）时，脑海中要立刻亮起红灯：Statute of Frauds (SoF) 问题！

除非有极强的例外情况（如部分履行 Partial Performance 或极端的 Detrimental Reliance），否则口头的不动产协议几乎总是无效的。

questions.question:
A buyer and a seller entered into a written contract for the sale of land. The contract satisfied the requirements of the statute of frauds. Because the buyer needed time to obtain financing, the buyer and the seller did not agree upon a closing date, and the written contract did not contain a stated closing date. Ten days after signing the contract, the buyer and the seller orally agreed to rescind the contract. The next day, the seller sold the land to a third party.
Two days after that sale, the original buyer told the seller that she had changed her mind and wanted to complete their contract. When the seller told her that he had sold the land to a third party, she sued him for breach of the written contract.
For whom will the court find?

choices.a: For the buyer, because she informed the seller within a reasonable time that she desired to close the transaction.
choices.b: For the buyer, because the agreement to rescind the contract was not in a writing signed by the buyer and the seller.
choices.c: For the seller, because the contract failed to contain a stated closing date.
choices.d: For the seller, because the oral rescission was valid.

questions.question:
A seller owned a single-family house. A buyer gave the seller a signed, handwritten offer to purchase the house. The offer was unconditional and sufficient to satisfy the statute of frauds, and when the seller signed an acceptance, an enforceable contract resulted.
The house had been the seller's home, but he had moved to an apartment, so the house was vacant at all times relevant to the proposed transaction. Two weeks after the parties had entered into their contract, one week after the buyer had obtained a written mortgage lending commitment from a lender, and one week before the agreed-upon closing date, the house was struck by lightning and burned to the ground. The loss was not insured, because three years earlier the seller had let his homeowner's insurance policy lapse after he had paid his mortgage debt in full.
The handwritten contract was wholly silent as to matters of financing, risk of loss, and insurance. The buyer declared the contract voided by the fire, but the seller asserted a right to enforce the contract despite the loss.
There is no applicable statute.
If a court finds for the seller, what will be the likely reason?

choices.a: The contract was construed against the buyer, who drafted it.
choices.b: The lender's written commitment to make a mortgage loan to the buyer made the contract of sale fully binding on the buyer.
choices.c: The risk of loss falls on the party in possession, and constructive possession passed to the buyer on the contract date.
choices.d: The risk of loss passed to the buyer on the contract date under the doctrine of equitable conversion.

data.questionStem:
Q86145

A seller owned a single-family house. A buyer gave the seller a signed, handwritten offer to purchase the house. The offer was unconditional and sufficient to satisfy the statute of frauds, and when the seller signed an acceptance, an enforceable contract resulted.

The house had been the seller's home, but he had moved to an apartment, so the house was vacant at all times relevant to the proposed transaction. Two weeks after the parties had entered into their contract, one week after the buyer had obtained a written mortgage lending commitment from a lender, and one week before the agreed-upon closing date, the house was struck by lightning and burned to the ground. The loss was not insured, because three years earlier the seller had let his homeowner's insurance policy lapse after he had paid his mortgage debt in full.

The handwritten contract was wholly silent as to matters of financing, risk of loss, and insurance. The buyer declared the contract voided by the fire, but the seller asserted a right to enforce the contract despite the loss.

There is no applicable statute.

If a court finds for the seller, what will be the likely reason?

一位卖方拥有一栋独栋房屋。一位买方向卖方提供了一份经其签署的手写购房要约。该要约是无条件的，且足以满足《防止欺诈法》(statute of frauds)的要求，当卖方签署接受书时，一份可强制执行的合同即告成立。

这栋房子曾是卖方的住所，但他已搬到一间公寓，因此在与拟议交易相关的所有时间里，该房屋均处于空置状态。在双方签订合同两周后，在买方从贷款人处获得书面抵押贷款承诺一周后，以及在约定的过户日期一周前，该房屋被闪电击中并被烧毁。该损失没有保险，因为三年前，卖方在全额付清抵押贷款债务后，让其房主保险单失效了。

这份手写合同完全没有提及融资、损失风险和保险等事宜。买方宣布合同因火灾而无效，但卖方主张尽管存在损失，仍有权执行合同。

没有适用的成文法。

如果法院作出有利于卖方的裁决，可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. The contract was construed against the buyer, who drafted it.
合同应作出不利于起草方（即买方）的解释。

B. The lender's written commitment to make a mortgage loan to the buyer made the contract of sale fully binding on the buyer.
贷款人向买方提供抵押贷款的书面承诺，使得销售合同对买方具有完全约束力。

C. The risk of loss falls on the party in possession, and constructive possession passed to the buyer on the contract date.
损失风险由占有方承担，而推定占有权(constructive possession)在合同签订之日已转移给买方。

D. The risk of loss passed to the buyer on the contract date under the doctrine of equitable conversion.
根据衡平法转换原则(doctrine of equitable conversion)，损失风险在合同签订之日已转移给买方。
data.explanation:
When, as here, a real estate contract is silent as to the risk of loss, the doctrine of equitable conversion places that risk on the party with equitable title to the property. Equitable title is transferred to the buyer once the contract is formed and can be specifically enforced. A contract can be specially enforced if no conditions exist (as seen here) or all contract conditions have been performed. Therefore, the court likely found in favor of the seller because the risk of loss had already passed to the buyer when the house was destroyed.

However, had this jurisdiction followed the Uniform Vendor and Purchaser Act (a minority rule), the risk of loss would have remained with the seller until the buyer took actual possession of or received title to the property (Choice C).

(Choice A) A contract is generally interpreted according to its plain meaning; however, ambiguities within the contract may be construed against the drafter. But the rules of contract interpretation are irrelevant here because the contract is silent as to the risk of loss and the doctrine of equitable conversion controls.

(Choice B) There were no conditions in the contract of sale (eg, that the buyer secure financing before closing), so the contract became binding once the seller signed the acceptance. Therefore, the buyer would have been obligated to purchase the property even if the buyer had not received a loan commitment.

Educational objective: Unless otherwise provided, the doctrine of equitable conversion places the risk of loss on the party with equitable title to the property. The buyer acquires equitable title once a real estate contract is formed and can be specifically enforced.



选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 1%，C选项 12%，D选项 85%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当如本案中，房地产合同对损失风险问题未作规定时，衡平法转换(equitable conversion)原则将该风险归于对该财产拥有衡平法上所有权(equitable title)的一方。一旦合同成立且可被强制履行，衡平法上的所有权即转移给买方。如果不存在任何条件（如本案所示）或所有合同条件均已履行，合同就可以被强制履行。因此，法院很可能作出有利于卖方的裁决，因为在该房屋被毁时，损失风险已经转移给了买方。

然而，如果该司法管辖区遵循《Uniform Vendor and Purchaser Act》（少数派规则），损失风险将一直由卖方承担，直到买方实际占有或收到该财产的所有权为止(选项C)。

(选项A) 合同通常根据其字面含义进行解释；然而，合同中的模糊之处可作出不利于起草方的解释。但在此案中，合同解释规则并不适用，因为合同对损失风险未作规定，应由衡平法转换原则管辖。

(选项B) 销售合同中没有任何条件（例如，买方在过户前必须获得融资），因此一旦卖方签署接受书，合同即具有约束力。因此，即使买方没有收到贷款承诺，他也有义务购买该房产。

教学目标：除非另有规定，衡平法转换原则(doctrine of equitable conversion)将损失风险归于对该财产拥有衡平法上所有权(equitable title)的一方。一旦房地产合同成立且可被强制履行，买方即获得衡平法上的所有权。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Risk of Loss
核心考点：衡平法转换

本题考察的是普通法下的衡平法转换原则 (Doctrine of Equitable Conversion)。

该原则规定：一旦房地产买卖合同签署并具有可强制执行性（Specifically Enforceable），所有权在法律上发生分离：

  • 买方 (Buyer)：获得衡平法上的所有权 (Equitable Title)。
  • 卖方 (Seller)：保留法定所有权 (Legal Title)，但这仅作为买方支付价款的担保。
合同签署
(Contract)
房屋烧毁
(Fire)
过户日
(Closing)
为什么选 D？
正确答案 D

法律依据：根据普通法（Common Law），损失风险（Risk of Loss）跟随衡平法所有权。

推理逻辑：

  1. 题目指出合同是无条件的且满足《防止欺诈法》，因此合同一旦签署即成立。
  2. 此时，衡平法转换原则生效，买方立即获得了衡平法所有权。
  3. 虽然此时买方还未过户（Closing）也未占有（Possession），但风险已经转移。
  4. 题目特别说明“没有适用的成文法”（No applicable statute），这意味着必须应用普通法规则，而不是现代的成文法修正案。

因此，尽管卖方没有保险且房屋已毁，买方仍需履行合同支付价款。

其他选项为何错误？
选项 A 不利于起草方解释

这是一个合同解释的一般原则（Contra Proferentem），用于解决合同条款模棱两可的情况。但本案中合同是沉默 (Silent) 而非模糊。当合同对风险未作规定时，法律默认规则（衡平法转换）自动填补空白，无需进行合同解释。

选项 B 贷款承诺

这是一个干扰项。题目中提到要约是“无条件的”（Unconditional）。一旦卖方签字，合同即具有约束力。买方是否获得贷款承诺不影响合同的成立或风险的转移。

选项 C 占有转移风险

这是《统一卖方与买方风险法》(Uniform Vendor and Purchaser Risk Act, UVPRA) 的规则，属于少数派规则。该规则规定风险在交付占有或过户时才转移。但题目明确指出“没有适用的成文法”，因此必须适用普通法（即选项 D 的规则）。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧：

看到 "Risk of Loss"（损失风险）题目时，请按以下步骤思考：
  1. 看合同：合同里有规定风险由谁承担吗？如果有，按合同办。
  2. 看成文法：题目是否提到该州采纳了 UVPRA？如果是，风险在过户或占有时转移。
  3. 默认规则：如果合同沉默且无特殊成文法（如本题），适用普通法 (Common Law) = 衡平法转换 = 买方承担风险（一旦签字）。

questions.question:
Last year, a buyer and a seller entered into a valid contract for the sale of a parcel of real property. The contract contained no contingencies. The seller was killed in a car accident before the parcel was conveyed, but the closing eventually took place with the conveyance by a deed from the personal representative of the seller's estate.
The personal representative of the seller's estate wants to distribute the proceeds of the real property sale. The seller's will was executed many years ago and was duly admitted to probate. Paragraph 5 of his will leaves all of the seller's real property to his son, and Paragraph 6 leaves the residue of the estate to the seller's daughter. No other provisions of the will are pertinent to the question regarding to whom the proceeds of the sale should be distributed.
What will determine who receives the proceeds?

choices.a: Whether Paragraph 5 refers specifically to the parcel of real property that was sold or simply to "all of my real property."
choices.b: Whether the closing date originally specified in the contract was a date before or after the seller's death.
choices.c: Whether the jurisdiction has adopted the doctrine of equitable conversion.
choices.d: Whether the sale was completed in accordance with a court order.

Q86133

Last year, a buyer and a seller entered into a valid contract for the sale of a parcel of real property. The contract contained no contingencies. The seller was killed in a car accident before the parcel was conveyed, but the closing eventually took place with the conveyance by a deed from the personal representative of the seller's estate.

The personal representative of the seller's estate wants to distribute the proceeds of the real property sale. The seller's will was executed many years ago and was duly admitted to probate. Paragraph 5 of his will leaves all of the seller's real property to his son, and Paragraph 6 leaves the residue of the estate to the seller's daughter. No other provisions of the will are pertinent to the question regarding to whom the proceeds of the sale should be distributed.

What will determine who receives the proceeds?

去年，一位买方和一位卖方就一宗不动产的销售签订了一份有效合同。该合同不包含任何附带条件。在该宗不动产被转让之前，卖方在一场车祸中丧生，但最终通过卖方遗产的个人代表以地契形式完成了交割。

卖方遗产的个人代表希望分配该不动产销售的收益。卖方的遗嘱在多年前订立，并已正式通过遗嘱认证。其遗嘱第5条将卖方的所有不动产留给其儿子，第6条将遗产的剩余部分留给其女儿。遗嘱中没有其他条款与销售收益应分配给谁的问题相关。

什么因素将决定谁能获得该收益？
options:
A. Whether Paragraph 5 refers specifically to the parcel of real property that was sold or simply to "all of my real property."
遗嘱第5条是特指被出售的那宗不动产，还是仅指“我所有的不动产”。

B. Whether the closing date originally specified in the contract was a date before or after the seller's death.
合同中最初指定的交割日期是在卖方去世之前还是之后。

C. Whether the jurisdiction has adopted the doctrine of equitable conversion.
该司法管辖区是否采纳了衡平法转换原则 (doctrine of equitable conversion)。

D. Whether the sale was completed in accordance with a court order.
该销售是否是根据法院命令完成的。
data.explanation:
The doctrine of equitable conversion controls the ownership and risk of loss of real property during the executory period. Under this doctrine, the buyer receives equitable title to the property once the parties enter a specifically enforceable land-sales contract (eg, one with no contingencies). In contrast, the seller retains legal title to the property and acquires the equitable right to receive the purchase price upon closing.

The buyer's equitable title is treated as a real property interest that is freely alienable, subject to the seller's equitable right to the purchase price. In contrast, the seller's right to the sale proceeds is treated as a personal property interest. Therefore, when the seller in this case died before closing, the doctrine of equitable conversion gave the right to the sale proceeds to his daughter, the beneficiary of his residuary estate.

(Choice A) Whether Paragraph 5 refers specifically to the parcel sold or simply to "all of my real property" is of no consequence since the seller's interest in the sale proceeds is a personal property (not real property) interest. The son had only a legal interest in the parcel that transferred to the buyer upon closing.

(Choice B) The sale proceeds would have passed to the daughter regardless of whether the closing date was scheduled before or after the seller's death.

(Choice D) The right to the sale proceeds depends on who had equitable title to the proceeds - not on the manner in which the sale was completed.

Educational objective: Under the doctrine of equitable conversion, the buyer acquires equitable title to the property ( real property interest) and the seller acquires an equitable right to the sale proceeds ( personal property interest). These interests will be distributed accordingly if either party dies before closing.



选项正确率统计：A选项 30%，B选项 23%，C选项 44%（正确选项），D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

衡平法转换原则 (doctrine of equitable conversion) 管控着不动产在待执行期间 (executory period) 的所有权和损失风险。根据该原则，一旦双方签订一份可强制执行的土地销售合同（例如，没有附带条件的合同），买方即获得该财产的衡平法所有权。相比之下，卖方保留财产的法定所有权，并获得在交割时收取购买价款的衡平法权利。

买方的衡平法所有权被视为一种可以自由转让的不动产权益，但受制于卖方收取购买价款的衡平法权利。相比之下，卖方对销售收益的权利被视为一种动产权益。因此，当本案中的卖方在交割前去世时，衡平法转换原则将销售收益的权利赋予了他的女儿，即其剩余遗产的受益人。

(选项 A) 遗嘱第5条是特指被出售的地块还是仅指“我所有的不动产”并不重要，因为卖方对销售收益的权益是动产权益（非不动产权益）。儿子对该地块仅拥有法定权益，该权益在交割时已转移给买方。

(选项 B) 无论交割日期安排在卖方去世之前还是之后，销售收益都将归女儿所有。

(选项 D) 销售收益的权利取决于谁对收益拥有衡平法所有权——而不在于销售完成的方式。

教学目标：根据衡平法转换原则 (doctrine of equitable conversion)，买方获得财产的衡平法所有权（不动产权益），而卖方获得收取销售收益的衡平法权利（动产权益）。如果任何一方在交割前去世，这些权益将相应地进行分配。

References

27A Am. Jur. 2d Equitable Conversion § 13 (2020) (equitable conversion of interests under land-sale contract).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property & Contracts

正确答案：C 决定因素在于该司法管辖区是否采纳了 衡平法转换原则 (Doctrine of Equitable Conversion)。
核心考点：衡平法转换 (Equitable Conversion)

这是美国财产法中关于不动产买卖最经典的考点之一。该原则的核心逻辑是：

一旦买卖双方签订了可强制执行的合同 (Specifically Enforceable Contract)，在衡平法 (Equity) 眼中，交易已经被视为“完成”。

合同签订时刻 (Signing)
↓
买方 (Buyer)
获得衡平法所有权 (Equitable Title)
视为拥有不动产 (Real Property)
卖方 (Seller)
保留法定所有权 (Legal Title) 作为担保
获得收取价款的权利
视为拥有动产 (Personal Property)
本案逻辑推演

题目问的是“谁获得销售收益（钱）”。这取决于卖方去世时，他名下的这个权益属于“不动产”还是“动产”。

  • 如果适用衡平法转换：
    卖方在去世时，其在该合同下的权益已经转换为“收取金钱的权利”，这属于动产 (Personal Property)。因此，这笔钱应根据遗嘱中的“剩余财产条款” (Residuary Clause) 分配给女儿。
  • 如果不适用衡平法转换：
    卖方去世时仍被视为拥有该土地（不动产）。因此，该土地（及随后的收益）应根据遗嘱中的“不动产条款”分配给儿子。

因此，选项 C 是决定性因素。该原则是否存在直接决定了财产的性质（动产 vs 不动产），进而决定了遗嘱中哪一条款适用。

干扰项排除
  • 选项 A (遗嘱措辞)：
    这是典型的干扰项。如果衡平法转换适用，该财产已经是“动产”，无论遗嘱第5条写得多么具体（“我的所有不动产”或“具体地块”），它都无法涵盖动产。这叫作 Ademption by Extinction（遗赠的废除）。
  • 选项 B (交割日期)：
    错误。衡平法转换发生在合同签订之时 (Execution of Contract)，而不是交割之时。只要合同在死者生前有效签订，转换就已经发生。
  • 选项 D (法院命令)：
    无关项。权利的性质取决于合同本身，而非是否涉及法院命令。
💡 MBE 实战技巧：

看到 "Land Sale Contract" + "Death of a Party" (一方在交割前死亡)，立刻联想 Equitable Conversion。

记住口诀：
  • Seller Dies: Interest = Money (Personal Property) → Goes to Residuary/Personal rep.
  • Buyer Dies: Interest = Land (Real Property) → Goes to Heirs/Devisees of Real Property.

questions.question:
A son entered into a valid written contract to sell a large tract of land to a friend. At that time, the tract was owned by the son's father. The son had no title to the tract and was not the agent of the father.
After the contract was executed and before the scheduled closing date, the father died intestate, leaving the son as his sole heir. Shortly thereafter, the son received an offer of purchase that was substantially higher than the purchase price in the contract with the friend. The son refused to close with the friend although she was ready, willing, and able to close pursuant to the contract.
The friend brought an appropriate action for specific performance against the son.
In that action, what should the friend be awarded?

choices.a: Judgment for specific performance, because the son acquired title before the scheduled closing.
choices.b: Judgment for specific performance, to prevent unjust enrichment of the son.
choices.c: Nothing, because the doctrine of after-acquired title does not apply to executory contracts.
choices.d: Nothing, because the son had no authority to enter into the contract with the friend.

The friend brought an appropriate action for specific performance against the son.

一个儿子与一位朋友签订了一份有效的书面合同，欲将一大片土地出售给该朋友。当时，这片土地归儿子的父亲所有。儿子对该土地没有所有权，也不是其父亲的代理人。

在合同签订后、预定交割日之前，父亲无遗嘱死亡，儿子成为其唯一继承人。此后不久，儿子收到了另一份购买要约，其价格远高于与朋友合同中的购买价。尽管朋友已准备好、愿意且能够根据合同进行交割，儿子却拒绝与她完成交易。

朋友对儿子提起了要求实际履行的适当诉讼。

在该诉讼中，朋友应获得何种判决？
options:
A. Judgment for specific performance, because the son acquired title before the scheduled closing.
判决实际履行，因为儿子在预定交割日之前取得了所有权。

B. Judgment for specific performance, to prevent unjust enrichment of the son.
判决实际履行，以防止儿子的不当得利。

C. Nothing, because the doctrine of after-acquired title does not apply to executory contracts.
不应获得任何东西，因为事后取得所有权原则不适用于待履行合同。

D. Nothing, because the son had no authority to enter into the contract with the friend.
不应获得任何东西，因为儿子没有权限与朋友签订合同。
data.explanation:
The sale of real property typically comprises three parts:

  • Execution of the sales contract - the buyer promises to pay the purchase price in exchange for the seller's promise to deliver title
  • Executory period - the buyer can inspect the property, secure a loan, and review title documents, AND the seller can repair the property or correct imperfections in the title
  • Closing - the seller formally transfers title by delivering the deed to the buyer and the buyer pays the purchase price


Once a sales contract is executed, the exchanged promises become binding. Therefore, if the seller acquires marketable title at closing but is unwilling to perform, the buyer can sue for breach of the contract or seek specific performance.

Here, the son did not have title to the tract when he entered the sales contract with the friend. However, he inherited title before the scheduled closing. As a result, the seller has marketable title and must perform his promise to transfer it to the friend. Since he is unwilling to do so, the friend should be awarded judgment for specific performance.

(Choice B) Specific performance is typically used when a monetary remedy cannot make the plaintiff whole. The goal is to adequately compensate the plaintiff - not to prevent unjust enrichment of the defendant.

(Choice C) The doctrine of after-acquired title (ie, estoppel by deed) would apply to executory contracts (eg, sales contracts for real estate) if a seller formally transferred title by warranty deed at closing and later acquired title to that property. Title would then automatically transfer to the buyer once the seller received it.

(Choice D) The son had the authority to enter into the contract with the friend but lacked the ability to perform until he inherited the tract. Once that occurred, he was obligated to sell the property to the friend.

Educational objective: Once a buyer and seller execute a sales contract, their exchanged promises become binding. Therefore, if the seller is able to transfer title upon closing but refuses to do so, the buyer can sue for breach of contract or seek specific performance.



选项正确率统计：A选项 78%（正确选项），B选项 9%，C选项 2%，D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

不动产的销售通常包含三个部分：

  • 销售合同的签订 - 买方承诺支付购买价款，以换取卖方承诺交付所有权
  • 待履行期间 - 买方可以检查房产、获得贷款、审查所有权文件，而卖方可以修缮房产或纠正所有权中的瑕疵
  • 交割 - 卖方向买方交付地契，从而正式转移所有权，买方支付购买价款


一旦销售合同签订，双方交换的承诺即具有约束力。因此，如果卖方在交割时取得了可销售的所有权，但不愿意履行，买方可以就违约提起诉讼或寻求实际履行。

在本案中，儿子与朋友签订销售合同时，对该土地并无所有权。但是，他在预定的交割日之前继承了所有权。因此，卖方拥有了可销售的所有权，必须履行其向朋友转让所有权的承诺。既然他不愿意这样做，朋友应当被判决获得实际履行。

(选项B) 当金钱赔偿无法完全弥补原告损失时，通常会采用实际履行。其目标是充分补偿原告，而不是防止被告的不当得利。

(选项C) 如果卖方在交割时通过附担保地契正式转让了所有权，而之后才取得该财产的所有权，那么事后取得所有权原则（即，deed estoppel/文书禁反言）将会适用于待履行合同（例如，不动产销售合同）。在这种情况下，一旦卖方获得所有权，该所有权将自动转移给买方。

(选项D) 儿子有权与朋友签订合同，但在继承该土地之前，他缺乏履行的能力。一旦继承发生，他就有义务将该房产出售给朋友。

教学目标：一旦买卖双方签订了销售合同，他们交换的承诺就具有约束力。因此，如果卖方在交割时能够转让所有权但拒绝这样做，买方可以提起违约之诉或寻求实际履行。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Estate Contracts (不动产合同)

核心考点：所有权的时间点

在不动产买卖合同中，卖方不需要在签订合同（Contract Execution）时就拥有所有权。

关键规则：
卖方只需在交割日（Closing Date）能够提供可转让的所有权（Marketable Title）即可。

如果卖方在签订合同时没有产权，但在交割前获得了产权，合同即为有效且必须履行。

本案时间线分析

阶段 1：签订合同
儿子承诺卖地给朋友。
(此时儿子无产权，但合同有效)
阶段 2：待履行期 (Executory Period)
父亲去世，儿子继承土地。
(儿子获得了产权!)
阶段 3：预定交割日
儿子拥有产权，必须履行合同。
(拒绝履行构成违约)

正确答案解析 (选项 A)

朋友应获得 实际履行 (Specific Performance) 的判决。

法律依据：

  • 合同的约束力： 双方签订书面合同时，交换的承诺（Promise to sell vs. Promise to pay）即产生法律效力。
  • 履行能力： 虽然签约时儿子无权，但他通过继承在交割前获得了所有权。此时他完全具备履行合同的能力。
  • 救济方式： 土地在法律上被视为是独一无二的 (Unique)。金钱赔偿通常不足以弥补买方的损失，因此法院会判决实际履行，强制卖方移交地契。

为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 B (不当得利)
虽然防止不当得利（Unjust Enrichment）是法律的一个原则，但在此类案件中，实际履行的基础是合同法（有效的承诺和土地的独特性），而不是为了惩罚儿子的获利。即使儿子没有收到更高的报价，只要他拒绝交割，朋友依然可以要求实际履行。

选项 C (事后取得所有权原则)
这是一个常见的干扰项。
区别在于：

  • Estoppel by Deed (文书禁反言/事后取得所有权)： 通常指某人先给出了地契 (Deed)，后来才获得产权，产权会自动转移。
  • 本案情况： 我们还在合同 (Contract) 阶段。合同法直接要求：只要你在交割日能给地，你就得给。不需要引用复杂的 Estoppel by Deed 原则来解释待履行合同。

选项 D (无权限)
一个人完全可以签订合同出售他不拥有的东西（例如期货、预售房），只要他确信能在交割日搞到手。这是一种商业风险。如果到期给不出来，就是违约；如果给得出来（如本案），就必须给。不需要父亲的“授权”来签订这份承诺。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

看到“卖方签约时无产权”不要慌：

  1. 检查在交割日 (Closing) 卖方是否搞到了产权。
  2. 如果是，买方通常可以强制交易 (Specific Performance)。
  3. 如果否，卖方违约 (Breach)，买方可以索赔。

记住：不动产合同看的是Closing时的状态，而不是Signing时的状态。

© MBE 备考助手 | Real Property

questions.question:
The owner of an undeveloped city lot and a developer executed a written document in which the owner agreed to sell the lot to the developer and the developer agreed to buy the lot for $100,000. The document did not provide for an earnest money down payment. The owner recorded the document, as authorized by statute. The owner orally gave the developer permission to park his car on the lot without charge prior to the closing. Thereafter, the developer frequently parked his car there.
Another property came on the market that the developer wanted more than the owner's lot. The developer decided to try to escape any obligation to the owner. The developer had been told that contracts for the purchase and sale of real property require consideration and concluded that because he had made no earnest money down payment, he could refuse to close and not be liable. The developer notified the owner of his intention not to close and, in fact, did refuse to close on the date set for the closing.
The owner brought an appropriate action to compel specific performance by the developer.
If the owner wins, what will be the likely reason?

choices.a: General contract rules regarding consideration apply to real estate contracts.
choices.b: The developer's use of the lot constitutes part performance.
choices.c: The doctrine of equitable conversion applies.
choices.d: The document was recorded.

If the owner wins, what will be the likely reason?

一名未开发城市地块的所有人与一名开发商签署了一份书面文件，其中所有人同意将该地块出售给开发商，开发商也同意以10万美元的价格购买该地块。该文件未规定定金预付款。所有人根据法规授权，对该文件进行了登记。在交割前，所有人以口头方式许可开发商免费在该地块上停车。此后，开发商频繁在此停车。

市场上出现了另一处房产，开发商对它的兴趣超过了所有人的地块。开发商决定试图逃避对所有人的任何义务。开发商被告知，不动产买卖合同需要对价，并得出结论：由于他没有支付任何定金，他可以拒绝交割且不承担责任。开发商通知所有人其不打算进行交割，并实际上在约定的交割日期拒绝了交割。

所有人提起了适当的诉讼，要求强制开发商履行特定履行。

如果所有人胜诉，最可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. General contract rules regarding consideration apply to real estate contracts.
关于对价的一般合同规则适用于不动产合同。

B. The developer's use of the lot constitutes part performance.
开发商对该地块的使用构成了部分履行。

C. The doctrine of equitable conversion applies.
衡平法转换原则（equitable conversion）适用。

D. The document was recorded.
该文件已被登记。
data.explanation:
A land-sale contract, like any other contract, is legally enforceable only if it is supported by valuable consideration. Valuable consideration is evidenced by a bargained-for exchange of legal positions between the parties. This requires that each party:
  • perform, or promise to perform, some act that is not legally required or
  • refrain, or promise to refrain, from performing some legally permissible act.
Land-sale contracts are supported by valuable consideration because the seller promises to convey title to the buyer, and in exchange the buyer promises to pay the seller the purchase price. A buyer can make an earnest money down payment to show a good faith intent to complete the purchase, but this is not needed to form a valid contract. Therefore, the reason the owner will win is that the contract meets the general contract rules regarding consideration.

(Choice B) Part performance allows a buyer to enforce an oral agreement if the buyer has taken possession of the property, made substantial improvements to it, and/or paid some or all of the purchase price. However, this exception to the statute of frauds does not apply here because the parties executed a written contract.

(Choice C) The doctrine of equitable conversion governs the ownership of property and risk of loss during the period between contract formation and closing. However, it has no relevance to whether a land-sale contract is valid and enforceable upon closing.

(Choice D) Recording acts protect buyers from subsequent purchasers claiming superior title to the property, but they have no bearing on whether the owner can compel specific performance by the developer under this land-sale contract.

Educational objective: Land-sale contracts are supported by valuable consideration because the seller promises to convey title to the buyer; in exchange, the buyer promises to pay the seller the purchase price.



选项正确率统计：A选项 31%（正确选项），B选项 19%，C选项 30%，D选项 18%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一份土地买卖合同（land-sale contract），与任何其他合同一样，只有在有有价对价的支持下才具有法律强制执行力。有价对价通过双方当事人法律地位的协议交换（bargained-for exchange）来证明。这要求每一方当事人：
  • 履行或承诺履行某些法律上不要求的行为，或者
  • 放弃或承诺放弃履行某些法律上允许的行为。
土地买卖合同受有价对价支持，因为卖方承诺将所有权转让给买方，而作为交换，买方承诺向卖方支付购买价款。买方可以支付定金以表示完成购买的善意，但这不是形成有效合同所必需的。因此，所有人会胜诉的原因是该合同符合关于对价的一般合同规则。

(选项B) 部分履行（Part performance）允许买方在占有该财产、对其进行重大改良和/或支付部分或全部购买价款的情况下，强制执行一份口头协议。然而，这一反欺诈法（statute of frauds）的例外情况在此不适用，因为双方当事人签署了一份书面合同。

(选项C) 衡平法转换原则（doctrine of equitable conversion）管辖的是合同成立至交割期间财产的所有权和损失风险。然而，它与土地买卖合同在交割时是否有效和可强制执行无关。

(选项D) 登记法案（Recording acts）保护买方免受后续购买者主张对该财产的优先所有权的侵害，但它们与所有人是否能根据此土地买卖合同强制开发商履行特定履行无关。

教学目标：土地买卖合同受有价对价支持，因为卖方承诺将所有权转让给买方；作为交换，买方承诺向卖方支付购买价款。

References

77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 24 (2020) (consideration).

MBE 考点解析

Real Estate Contracts | Consideration
🎯 核心考点

本题考察的是不动产买卖合同（Land-sale Contract）成立的必要条件，特别是对价（Consideration）的要求。

❓ 关键问题：
买方没有支付定金（Earnest Money），是否意味着合同缺乏对价而无效？
⚖️ 法律解析 (正确答案 A)

结论：所有人胜诉，因为合同符合关于对价的一般规则。

1. 对价的本质 (Nature of Consideration)
在普通法合同中，对价是“讨价还价的交换”（Bargained-for exchange）。在双务合同（Bilateral Contract）中，相互的承诺（Mutual Promises）本身就是充分的对价。
2. 不动产合同的应用
  • 卖方的对价：承诺转让地块的所有权（Convey title）。
  • 买方的对价：承诺支付购买价款（Promise to pay purchase price）。
3. 定金的误区 (Earnest Money Myth)
虽然在商业实践中，支付定金（Earnest Money Down Payment）非常普遍，用来表示诚意，但在法律上，它并不是形成有效不动产合同的必要条件。买方承诺在交割日支付 $100,000 这一承诺本身就已经构成了法律上的有效对价。
🚫 干扰项排除
选项 B 部分履行 (Part Performance)
Part performance 是《反欺诈法》（Statute of Frauds）的例外情况，用于强制执行口头合同。本题中双方已经签署了书面合同，因此不需要依赖部分履行原则来证明合同的存在。
选项 C 衡平法转换 (Equitable Conversion)
Equitable conversion 处理的是合同签署后到交割期间的风险承担（如房屋被烧毁谁承担损失）或所有权性质问题。它假定合同是有效的，但不能用来证明合同是否有效。
选项 D 文件已登记 (Recording)
登记法案（Recording Acts）的目的是保护买方对抗第三人（如后续购买者）。登记与否不影响合同在买卖双方当事人之间的有效性。
💡 备考小贴士

在 MBE 考试中，要区分“商业习惯”和“法律要求”。

虽然买房不付定金在现实中很少见，但只要有书面协议且包含相互承诺（一方卖，一方付钱），合同在法律上就是成立的。不要被“没有定金”这个事实迷惑。

questions.question:
A man owned a tract of land improved with a one-family house. His friend orally offered to pay the man $250,000 for the tract and the house, the fair market value, and the man accepted. The friend paid the man $5,000 down in cash and agreed to pay the balance of $245,000 at an agreed closing time and place.
Before the closing, the friend inherited another home and asked the man to return his $5,000. The man refused and, at the time set for the closing, the man tendered a good deed to the friend and declared his intention to vacate the house on the tract the next day. The man demanded that the friend complete the purchase. The friend refused. The fair market value of the tract has remained $250,000.
The man has brought an appropriate action against the friend for specific performance.
If the man loses, what is the most likely reason?

choices.a: Retaining the $5,000 down payment is the owner's exclusive remedy.
choices.b: The friend had a valid reason for not closing.
choices.c: The owner remained in possession on the day set for the closing.
choices.d: There was no written agreement.

Q86120

A man owned a tract of land improved with a one-family house. His friend orally offered to pay the man $250,000 for the tract and the house, the fair market value, and the man accepted. The friend paid the man $5,000 down in cash and agreed to pay the balance of $245,000 at an agreed closing time and place.

Before the closing, the friend inherited another home and asked the man to return his $5,000. The man refused and, at the time set for the closing, the man tendered a good deed to the friend and declared his intention to vacate the house on the tract the next day. The man demanded that the friend complete the purchase. The friend refused. The fair market value of the tract has remained $250,000.

The man has brought an appropriate action against the friend for specific performance.

If the man loses, what is the most likely reason?

一名男子拥有一块土地，上面建有一栋独栋房屋。他的朋友口头要约以25万美元（即公平市场价值）购买这块土地和房屋，该男子接受了此要约。朋友以现金支付了5000美元的定金，并同意在约定的过户时间和地点支付余款24.5万美元。

在过户之前，朋友继承了另一处房产，并要求该男子退还其5000美元。该男子拒绝了，并在设定的过户时间，向朋友提交了一份有效的地契，并声明他打算在第二天搬离该房屋。该男子要求朋友完成购买。朋友拒绝了。该土地的公平市场价值仍为25万美元。

该男子已对朋友提起适当的诉讼，要求强制履行合同（specific performance）。

如果该男子败诉，最可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. Retaining the $5,000 down payment is the owner's exclusive remedy.
保留5000美元的定金是所有人的唯一补救措施。

B. The friend had a valid reason for not closing.
朋友有正当理由不过户。

C. The owner remained in possession on the day set for the closing.
在设定的过户日，所有人仍占有该房产。

D. There was no written agreement.
没有书面协议。
data.explanation:
Statute of frauds requirements for real estate contracts


WritingPhysical or electronic document(s) containing reasonable basis to believe contract was formed

eg, receipt, check, emails
SignatureHandwritten signature from, or other mark identifying, party to be charged

eg, letterhead, electronic signature, initials
Essential termsTypically includes:
  • identity of parties
  • words of intent to buy or sell
  • property description
  • sales price
Real estate contracts are subject to the statute of frauds. As a result, such contracts are enforceable only if they are in writing , are signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought, and contain all essential terms. Since the man and the friend's agreement was oral , it is unenforceable. Therefore, the lack of a written agreement is the mostly likely reason the man will lose.

(Choice A) Most states allow sellers to retain the buyer's deposit if the buyer breaches the land-sale contract. However, most jurisdictions also allow a seller to seek specific performance to compel the buyer to pay the agreed-upon sales price.† But neither remedy is available here since the contract is unenforceable.

(Choice B) A buyer's failure to close may be excused by a contingency in the agreement (eg, when closing is conditioned on the buyer's ability to obtain a loan). However, inheriting another home is not a valid reason for not closing.

(Choice C) A seller must deliver a valid deed to the buyer at the time of closing. Delivery occurs when the deed is in the buyer's possession - even if the seller remains on the property at the time. Therefore, had there been an enforceable contract, the man would have satisfied his duty despite staying in the house until the following day.

†A minority of jurisdiction may deny specific performance to the seller if the land is not unique and monetary damages provide adequate compensation.

Educational objective: Under the statute of frauds, an oral agreement for the sale of land is unenforceable. Instead, the agreement must be in writing, be signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought, and contain all essential terms.

选项正确率统计：A选项 8%，B选项 1%，C选项 3%，D选项 86%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

关于不动产合同的Statute of Frauds要求


书面文件实体或电子文件，包含足以合理相信合同已成立的依据

例如：收据、支票、电子邮件
签名来自被诉方的手写签名或其他识别标记

例如：信头、电子签名、姓名首字母缩写
基本条款通常包括：
  • 当事方身份
  • 表明买卖意图的文字
  • 财产描述
  • 售价
不动产合同受statute of frauds的约束。因此，此类合同只有在采用书面形式、由被要求履行的一方签署，并包含所有基本条款的情况下，才具有强制执行力。由于该男子与朋友的协议是口头的，因此不具有强制执行力。因此，缺乏书面协议是该男子败诉最可能的原因。

(选项A) 大多数州允许卖方在买方违反土地买卖合同时保留其定金。然而，大多数司法管辖区也允许卖方寻求强制履行（specific performance），以迫使买方支付约定的售价。† 但由于该合同不具有强制执行力，此处两种补救措施均不适用。

(选项B) 买方未能过户可能因协议中的意外事件条款而免责（例如，当过户以买方能获得贷款为条件时）。然而，继承另一处房产并非不过户的正当理由。

(选项C) 卖方必须在过户时向买方交付有效的地契。当契约到达买方手中时，交付即告完成——即便当时卖方仍在该房产上。因此，如果存在一个可强制执行的合同，尽管该男子在房屋中待到第二天，他也已经履行了他的义务。

†少数司法管辖区可能会在土地并非独一无二且金钱赔偿足以提供充分补偿时，拒绝卖方的强制履行（specific performance）请求。

教学目标：根据statute of frauds，口头的土地买卖协议不具有强制执行力。相反，协议必须是书面的，由被要求履行的一方签署，并包含所有基本条款。

References

73 Am. Jur. 2d Statute of Frauds §§ 289, 305, 325, 329 (2020).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Estate Contracts & Statute of Frauds
⚖️ 核心法律规则：反欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds)

根据普通法和大多数州的法律，土地权益买卖合同 (Contract for the sale of an interest in land) 必须满足以下条件才能强制执行：

  • 必须是书面形式 (In writing)；
  • 必须由被诉方 (Party to be charged) 签署；
  • 必须包含基本条款 (Essential terms)：如当事人、土地描述、价格等。

📝 题目分析

本题的关键事实非常明确：

  1. 买卖双方达成的是口头协议 (Orally offered/accepted)。
  2. 虽然买方支付了 $5,000 定金，但没有签署任何书面文件。
  3. 卖方起诉要求强制履行 (Specific Performance)。

由于这是一份涉及土地买卖的合同，它受到 Statute of Frauds (SOF) 的管辖。因为没有书面协议，原则上该合同不可强制执行。

✅ 正确答案：选项 D

There was no written agreement. (没有书面协议)

这是卖方败诉的最直接原因。在没有书面证据的情况下，法院不会强制执行土地买卖合同。虽然存在“部分履行” (Part Performance) 的例外，但通常仅支付定金（即使是部分付款）不足以满足该例外。

注：Part Performance 通常需要满足以下三项中的两项：(1) 支付价款；(2) 占有土地；(3) 进行实质性改良。本题中买方仅支付了定金，未占有也未改良。

❌ 选项 A 错误

关于定金的保留

这个选项讨论的是“补救措施” (Remedy)。但在讨论补救措施之前，首先要确定合同是否有效。既然合同因违反 SOF 而无效，卖方既不能要求强制履行，通常也不能依据合同条款没收定金（尽管在某些情况下可能有不当得利等其他考量，但这并不是卖方败诉的主要法律依据）。

❌ 选项 B 错误

关于不过户的理由

继承了另一套房子属于买方的个人动机，并不是法律认可的履行抗辩 (Defense to performance)。这不构成“履行不能” (Impossibility) 或“合同目的落空” (Frustration of Purpose)。如果合同有效，这个理由是站不住脚的。

❌ 选项 C 错误

关于卖方仍占有房产

卖方在过户日当天仍住在房子里，并声明第二天搬走，这通常不构成实质性违约。只要卖方在过户时能够交付有效产权 (Marketable Title) 和合法的占有权（即地契交付），物理上的搬离可以在短时间内完成，或者视为微小的违约，不足以让买方解除合同。

💡 MBE 考试技巧：
当看到“土地买卖” (Sale of Land) + “口头协议” (Oral Agreement) 时，脑海中要立刻亮起红灯：Statute of Frauds (SOF)。

紧接着检查是否有 Part Performance (部分履行) 的例外情况。如果仅仅是付了定金 (Down payment)，通常不足以绕过 SOF 的要求。

questions.question:
A landlord leased a building to a tenant for a term of six years. The lease complied with the statute of frauds and was not recorded. During the lease term, the tenant sent an email to the landlord that stated: "I hereby offer to purchase for $250,000 the building that I am now occupying under a six-year lease with you." The tenant's name was placed below the word "signed" on the message.
In response, the landlord emailed the tenant: "That's fine. We'll close in 60 days." The landlord's name was placed below the word "signed" on the reply message.
Sixty days later, the landlord refused to tender the deed to the building when the tenant tendered the $250,000 purchase price. The tenant has sued for specific performance.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.a: The landlord, because formation of an enforceable contract to convey the building could not occur until after the lease term expired.
choices.b: The landlord, because the landlord's email response did not contain a sufficient signature under the statute of frauds.
choices.c: The tenant, because the email messages constitute an insufficient attornment of the lease.
choices.d: The tenant, because the email messages constitute a sufficient memorandum under the statute of frauds.

Q86147

A landlord leased a building to a tenant for a term of six years. The lease complied with the statute of frauds and was not recorded. During the lease term, the tenant sent an email to the landlord that stated: "I hereby offer to purchase for $250,000 the building that I am now occupying under a six-year lease with you." The tenant's name was placed below the word "signed" on the message.

In response, the landlord emailed the tenant: "That's fine. We'll close in 60 days." The landlord's name was placed below the word "signed" on the reply message.

Sixty days later, the landlord refused to tender the deed to the building when the tenant tendered the $250,000 purchase price. The tenant has sued for specific performance.

Who is likely to prevail?

一位房东将一栋建筑出租给一位租户，租期为六年。该租赁合同符合statute of frauds的规定，但未进行登记。在租赁期间，租户向房东发送了一封电子邮件，内容如下：“本人在此要约以250,000美元的价格，购买我目前根据与您的六年租约所占用的这栋建筑。”在该邮件中，租户的名字位于“已签署”字样下方。

作为回应，房东通过电子邮件回复租户：“好的。我们将在60天内完成交易。”在该回复邮件中，房东的名字位于“已签署”字样下方。

六十天后，当租户支付250,000美元的购买价款时，房东拒绝交付该建筑的契据。租户已提起诉讼，要求特定履行。

谁可能胜诉？
options:
A. The landlord, because formation of an enforceable contract to convey the building could not occur until after the lease term expired.
房东，因为在租赁期满之前，无法形成一份可强制执行的建筑转让合同。

B. The landlord, because the landlord's email response did not contain a sufficient signature under the statute of frauds.
房东，因为根据statute of frauds，房东的电子邮件回复中没有包含充分的签名。

C. The tenant, because the email messages constitute an insufficient attornment of the lease.
租户，因为电子邮件信息构成了对租赁合同不充分的权利承认（attornment）。

D. The tenant, because the email messages constitute a sufficient memorandum under the statute of frauds.
租户，因为根据statute of frauds，电子邮件信息构成了一份充分的备忘录。
data.explanation:
Statute of frauds requirements for real estate contracts


WritingPhysical or electronic document(s) containing reasonable basis to believe contract was formed
e.g., receipt, check, emails
SignatureHandwritten signature from, or other mark identifying, party to be charged
e.g., letterhead, electronic signature, initials
Essential termsTypically includes:
  • identity of parties
  • words of intent to buy or sell
  • property description
  • sales price
Under the statute of frauds, contracts for the sale of land must meet three requirements to be enforceable:
  • Writing - physical and electronic document(s) evidencing a contract (eg, the parties' emails)
  • Signature - an identifying mark from the party against whom enforcement is sought
  • Essential terms - the parties' identity, words of intent to buy and sell, land description, and price term (all of which appear in the parties' emails)


The signature requirement is met so long as the identifying mark reflects an intent to authenticate the writing. Here, the tenant's and the landlord's names were placed below the word "signed," so their signatures show their desire to be bound (Choice B). And since their emails fulfill the other statute of frauds requirements, they constitute an enforceable memorandum. Therefore, the tenant is likely to prevail in his suit for specific performance.

(Choice A) An enforceable contract to convey a building can be formed during the lease term (as seen here) or thereafter.

(Choice C) Attornment refers to a tenant's agreement to be bound by a lease when there is a new landlord (eg, by sale or foreclosure). Here, the tenant seeks to purchase the property, so attornment is not an issue in this case.

Educational objective: The signature requirement for the statute of frauds is met if an identifying mark from the party against whom enforcement is sought reflects an intent to authenticate the writing.

选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 6%，C选项 1%，D选项 85%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

statute of frauds对不动产合同的要求


书面文件包含可合理相信合同已成立之依据的实体或电子文件
例如：收据、支票、电子邮件
签名来自受约束方的亲笔签名或其他识别性标记
例如：信头、电子签名、姓名首字母
基本条款通常包括：
  • 当事人身份
  • 表示购买或出售意图的词语
  • 财产描述
  • 销售价格
根据statute of frauds，土地买卖合同必须满足三个要求方可强制执行：
  • 书面文件 - 证明合同存在的实体及电子文件（例如，当事人的电子邮件）
  • 签名 - 来自寻求强制执行所针对一方的识别性标记
  • 基本条款 - 当事人身份、表示购买和出售意图的词语、土地描述和价格条款（所有这些都出现在当事人的电子邮件中）


只要识别性标记反映了认证该书面文件的意图，签名要求即被满足。在此案中，租户和房东的名字都位于“已签署”字样下方，因此他们的签名表明了他们受合同约束的意愿（选项 B）。并且，由于他们的电子邮件满足了statute of frauds的其他要求，这些邮件构成了一份可强制执行的备忘录。因此，租户在其要求特定履行的诉讼中很可能胜诉。

（选项 A）一份可强制执行的建筑转让合同可以在租赁期间（如此处所示）或之后形成。

（选项 C）权利承认（Attornment）指的是当出现新房东时（例如，通过出售或止赎），租户同意受租赁合同约束。在此案中，租户寻求购买该房产，因此权利承认（attornment）并非本案的争议点。

教学目的：对于statute of frauds的签名要求，如果寻求强制执行所针对一方的识别性标记反映了认证该书面文件的意图，则该要求即被满足。

References

73 Am. Jur. 2d Statute of Frauds §§ 289, 305, 325, 329 (2020).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Estate Contracts & Statute of Frauds
✅ 正确答案：D (Tenant) 租户胜诉。因为双方的电子邮件往来构成了一份符合《反欺诈法》(Statute of Frauds) 要求的充分备忘录。
核心考点：反欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds)

根据普通法及现代法规，不动产买卖合同必须满足 Statute of Frauds (SOF) 才能具有强制执行力。这通常要求：

  • 书面形式 (Writing)： 必须有证明合同存在的书面文件。
  • 签名 (Signature)： 必须由被追诉方 (Party to be charged) 签署。
  • 基本条款 (Essential Terms)： 必须包含当事人身份、土地描述、价格以及买卖意图。
本案法律适用分析

1. 电子文件是否算“书面”？
是的。现代法律（如美国的 UETA 和 E-SIGN Act）承认电子邮件 (Emails) 满足 SOF 的“书面”要求。

2. 电子签名是否有效？
是的。题目中指出房东的名字位于“已签署 (signed)”字样下方。这表明了房东有认证该文件的意图 (Intent to authenticate)。不需要手写的墨水签名，电子形式的姓名输入即满足要求。

3. 条款是否充分？
租户的邮件明确了价格 ($250,000) 和房产描述 ("building that I am now occupying...")，房东的回复确认了接受。这些合并起来构成了完整的合同条款。

为什么其他选项是错的？

❌ 选项 A (Formation Timing)：
错误。法律不禁止在租赁期间形成买卖合同。只要双方达成合意 (Meeting of the minds)，合同即刻成立，无需等到租期结束。

❌ 选项 B (Signature)：
错误。这是本题最大的陷阱。考生可能误以为 SOF 需要正式的手写签名。实际上，只要有符号表明签署意图（如邮件落款），即符合要求。

❌ 选项 C (Attornment)：
错误。这是一个干扰项。

Attornment (承认新房东):
指当房产被出售给第三方时，现有租户同意承认新业主为房东并继续履行租约。本案是租户自己买房，不涉及 Attornment 问题。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在处理 SOF 问题时，永远先问：“谁是被告？” (Who is the party to be charged?)。

本案中，租户起诉房东，房东是被告。因此，我们只需要确认房东是否签署了包含基本条款的文件。房东回复了 "That's fine" 并署名，这就锁定了他的责任。

questions.question:
A seller and a buyer signed a contract for the sale of vacant land. The contract was silent concerning the quality of title, but the seller agreed in the contract to convey the land to the buyer by a warranty deed without any exceptions.
When the buyer conducted a title search for the land, she learned that the applicable zoning did not allow for her planned commercial use. She also discovered that there was a recorded restrictive covenant limiting the use of the land to residential use.
The buyer no longer wants to purchase the land. Must the buyer purchase the land?

choices.a: No, because the restrictive covenant renders the title unmarketable.
choices.b: No, because the zoning places a cloud on the title.
choices.c: Yes, because the buyer would receive a warranty deed without any exceptions.
choices.d: Yes, because the contract was silent regarding the quality of the title.

data.questionStem:
Q86124

A seller and a buyer signed a contract for the sale of vacant land. The contract was silent concerning the quality of title, but the seller agreed in the contract to convey the land to the buyer by a warranty deed without any exceptions.

When the buyer conducted a title search for the land, she learned that the applicable zoning did not allow for her planned commercial use. She also discovered that there was a recorded restrictive covenant limiting the use of the land to residential use.

The buyer no longer wants to purchase the land. Must the buyer purchase the land?

卖方和买方签订了一份空地买卖合同。合同中未提及产权质量问题，但卖方在合同中同意通过无任何例外条款的瑕疵担保契据（warranty deed）将土地转让给买方。

当买方对该土地进行产权调查时，她发现适用的区划法规（zoning）不允许她计划的商业用途。她还发现，有一项已登记的限制性契约（restrictive covenant），将该土地的用途限制为住宅用途。

买方不再希望购买该土地。买方必须购买该土地吗？
options:
A. No, because the restrictive covenant renders the title unmarketable.
否，因为限制性契约（restrictive covenant）导致产权不具可销售性。

B. No, because the zoning places a cloud on the title.
否，因为区划法规（zoning）给产权带来了瑕疵。

C. Yes, because the buyer would receive a warranty deed without any exceptions.
是，因为买方将收到一份无任何例外条款的瑕疵担保契据（warranty deed）。

D. Yes, because the contract was silent regarding the quality of the title.
是，因为合同中未提及产权质量问题。
data.explanation:
"Red flags" for marketable title


CovenantsEasementsLeasesLiensGaps in chain of titleBoundary disputesExisting zoning violationsAdverse possession
All land-sale contracts , unless otherwise provided, imply that the seller will convey the buyer marketable title on the date of closing. Title need not be perfect to be marketable. But it must be reasonably free from doubt and under no threat of litigation such that a reasonable person would accept and pay for it.

A restrictive covenant is a promise to restrict the use of one's land. Here, the covenant limits the use of the land to residential use. This allows a third party to enforce the covenant, thereby posing a threat of litigation. As a result, the restrictive covenant renders title unmarketable and the buyer need not purchase the land.

(Choice B) An existing zoning violation may render title unmarketable, but the mere existence of a zoning code does not.

(Choice C) A buyer is not required to accept a warranty deed if the seller cannot deliver marketable title upon closing. The reason is that the doctrine of merger will cause the deed, once accepted, to subsume the land-sale contract. Any title issues will then be based on the deed instead of the guarantees in the contract.

(Choice D) When, as here, a contract is silent regarding the quality of title, it is implied that the seller will convey marketable title.

Educational objective: It is generally implied that the seller will convey marketable title upon closing. Title is marketable if it is reasonably free from doubt and under no threat of litigation such that a reasonable person would accept and pay for it. Therefore, a restrictive covenant renders title unmarketable.

选项正确率统计：A选项 62%（正确选项），B选项 9%，C选项 17%，D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

影响可销售产权的“危险信号”


契约地役权租赁留置权产权链中断边界争议现存的区划违规侵权逆占
所有的土地买卖合同，除非另有规定，都默示卖方将在过户日向买方转让可销售产权（marketable title）。产权无需完美才具有可销售性。但它必须合理地无瑕疵且无诉讼威胁，以至于一个理性人愿意接受并为此付款。

限制性契约（restrictive covenant）是一项限制个人土地用途的承诺。在本案中，该契约将土地用途限制为住宅用途。这使得第三方可以强制执行该契约，从而构成诉讼威胁。因此，限制性契约导致产权不具可销售性，买方无需购买该土地。

（选项B）现存的区划法规违规可能会导致产权不具可销售性，但仅仅是区划法规的存在本身并不会。

（选项C）如果卖方在过户时无法交付可销售产权，买方没有义务接受瑕疵担保契据（warranty deed）。其原因是，合并原则（doctrine of merger）将导致契据一经接受，即取代土地买卖合同。此后任何产权问题都将基于该契据，而非合同中的担保。

（选项D）当合同如本案一样，未提及产权质量问题时，则默示卖方将转让可销售产权。

教学目标：通常情况下，土地买卖合同默示卖方将在过户时转让可销售产权。如果产权是合理地无瑕疵且无诉讼威胁，以至于一个理性人愿意接受并为此付款，则该产权具有可销售性。因此，限制性契约（restrictive covenant）导致产权不具可销售性。

References

77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 93 (2020) (marketable title).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Marketable Title
正确答案：A 买方不需要购买该土地。因为已登记的限制性契约（Restrictive Covenant）导致产权不具备可销售性（Unmarketable）。
核心法律规则：可销售产权

在所有的土地买卖合同中，除非另有明确约定，卖方都默示承诺（Implied Covenant）在过户日（Closing）提供可销售产权（Marketable Title）。

什么是 Marketable Title？

指一个理性买家愿意接受的产权。它不需要完美，但必须：

  • 合理地没有瑕疵（Reasonably free from doubt）；
  • 没有诉讼威胁（Free from threat of litigation）。
关键考点辨析：区划 vs. 契约

本题的难点在于区分“区划法规”（Zoning）和“限制性契约”（Restrictive Covenant）对产权可销售性的不同影响。

区划法规 (Zoning) 限制性契约 (Restrictive Covenant)
属于公法限制。 属于私法限制（产权负担）。
仅仅存在区划法规不会导致产权不可销售。 限制性契约的存在通常会导致产权不可销售（除非买方在合同中放弃）。
只有当现存状况违反区划法规时，产权才不可销售。 因为它赋予第三方起诉权，构成了诉讼威胁。
本题情况：土地是空地，尚未违反区划，只是买方计划受阻。产权仍是好的。 本题情况：契约限制了用途，这是产权上的瑕疵（Encumbrance）。
为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 B Zoning Cloud: 如上表所述，仅仅因为买方的商业计划不符合Zoning，并不代表产权有瑕疵。Zoning限制的是土地的使用权，而不是所有权（Title），除非已经存在违规建筑。
  • 选项 C Warranty Deed: 这是一个陷阱。虽然卖方承诺给Warranty Deed，但这不能强迫买方接受一个有瑕疵的产权。买方有权在过户前以“产权不可销售”为由解除合同。
  • 选项 D Silent Contract: 即使合同未提及产权质量，法律也会默示卖方必须提供Marketable Title。沉默不代表买方接受烂产权。
💡 MBE 实战技巧

看到 "Marketable Title" 的题目，请立即检查是否存在以下“红旗”（Red Flags）导致产权不可销售：

  1. 私法限制：抵押权（Mortgages）、地役权（Easements）、限制性契约（Covenants）。
  2. 现存违规：违反了Zoning法规（不仅仅是Zoning存在）。
  3. 产权链缺陷：如逆权侵占（Adverse Possession）获得的产权（除非已经过确权判决）。

记住：私法限制（如本题的Covenant）几乎总是让产权不可销售，除非合同里明确写了"Subject to easements/covenants of record"。

A seller entered into a written contract with a purchaser to sell a farm. The contract was dated June 19 and called for a closing date on August 19. There was no other provision in the contract concerning the closing date. The contract contained the following clause: "subject to the purchaser obtaining a satisfactory mortgage at the current rate." On the date provided for closing, the buyer advised the seller that he was unable to close because his mortgage application was still being processed by a bank. The seller desired to declare the contract at an end and consulted his attorney in regard to his legal position.
Which of the following are relevant in advising the seller of his legal position?

choices.a: Specific performance.
choices.b: Statute of frauds.
choices.c: Time is of the essence.
choices.d: All of the above.

一位卖方与一位买方签订了出售农场的书面合同。合同签订日期为6月19日，并要求在8月19日交割。合同中没有关于交割日的其他条款。合同包含以下条款：“以买方按现行利率获得满意的抵押贷款为前提。”在规定的交割日，买方告知卖方他无法完成交割，因为他的抵押贷款申请仍在银行处理中。卖方希望宣布合同终止，并就其法律地位咨询了他的律师。

在就卖方的法律地位提供建议时，以下哪项是相关的？
options:
A. Specific performance.
强制履行 (Specific performance)。

B. Statute of frauds.
Statute of frauds。

C. Time is of the essence.
时间至关重要 (Time is of the essence)。

D. All of the above.
以上所有选项。
data.explanation:
Under the statute of frauds , real estate contracts are enforceable only if they are in writing, are signed by the party to be charged, and contain all essential terms. As a result, this statute is relevant in advising the seller of his ability to enforce this contract for the sale and purchase of the farm (Choice B).

Real estate contracts need not include a closing date. However, a closing date will be strictly enforced when the contract includes express language that makes time of the essence or the circumstances strongly suggest that the parties intended it to be. Therefore, the buyer would have materially breached the contract by failing to obtain a mortgage loan from the bank by August 19 if this closing date is found to be a strict deadline (Choice C).

When a buyer has breached a contract, one of the seller's remedies includes specific performance. This allows the seller to seek an injunction ordering the buyer to pay the agreed purchase price in lieu of monetary damages. Since it is important to inform a client of all available remedies, specific performance is also relevant in advising the seller of his legal position (Choice A).

Educational objective: Real estate contracts must comply with the statute of frauds - ie, be in writing, be signed by the party to be charged, and contain all essential terms. A closing date is not an essential term, but it will be strictly enforced if the contract makes time of the essence or the circumstances strongly suggest that the parties intended it to be.

选项正确率统计：A选项 15%，B选项 3%，C选项 45%，D选项 34%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

根据 Statute of Frauds，房地产合同只有在采用书面形式、由应负责任方签署并包含所有基本条款的情况下才具有强制执行力。因此，该法规在就卖方是否有能力强制执行此农场买卖合同提供建议时具有相关性 (选项B)。

房地产合同无需包含交割日。但是，当合同中包含将时间至关重要作为条款的明确语言，或情况强烈表明双方均有此意图时，交割日将被严格执行。因此，如果该交割日被认定为严格的最后期限，那么买方未能在8月19日前从银行获得抵押贷款的行为将构成重大违约 (选项C)。

当买方违约时，卖方的救济措施之一包括强制履行 (specific performance)。这允许卖方寻求禁令 (injunction)，命令买方支付约定的购买价款，以代替金钱赔偿。由于告知客户所有可用的救济措施非常重要，因此，在就卖方的法律地位提供建议时，强制履行也具有相关性 (选项A)。

教学目标：房地产合同必须遵守 Statute of Frauds——即，必须是书面形式，由应负责任方签署，并包含所有基本条款。交割日并非一项基本条款，但如果合同规定了时间至关重要，或情况强烈表明双方均有此意图，则该日期将被严格执行。

References

73 Am. Jur. 2d Statute of Frauds §§ 289, 305, 325, 329 (2020).

77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 445 (2020) (seller's remedies).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：不动产合同

正确答案：D (以上所有选项)

本题考察律师在评估卖方解除合同权利时，必须考虑的所有法律因素。

卖方想要宣布合同终止（declare the contract at an end），律师需要全面评估合同的有效性、违约的性质以及可用的救济措施。以下是逐项解析：

⏱️ 时间至关重要
Time is of the Essence

这是本案最核心的争议点。在普通法的不动产合同中，除非合同中有明确条款（如 "Time is of the essence"）或环境表明双方有此意图，否则交割日期通常不被视为严格的最后期限。

本案中，合同仅规定了8月19日为交割日，未规定时间至关重要。因此，买方的迟延可能并不构成重大违约 (Material Breach)，卖方可能无权立即终止合同。律师必须对此进行评估。

📜 反欺诈法
Statute of Frauds (SOF)

这是合同执行的前提。不动产买卖合同必须是书面 (in writing) 的，并由被执行方签署。虽然题目提到有书面合同，但律师必须首先确认该书面文件是否满足 SOF 的所有形式要求（如包含基本条款：当事人、标的物、价格等）。如果合同本身因 SOF 无效，卖方自然可以终止交易。

⚖️ 强制履行
Specific Performance

这是不动产合同中常见的衡平法救济 (Equitable Remedy)。律师需要告知卖方：

  • 如果卖方错误地终止合同，买方可能会起诉要求强制履行（强迫卖方卖地）。
  • 反之，如果卖方改变主意想强迫买方付款（而非终止合同），卖方自己也可以寻求强制履行。

了解这一救济措施对于评估“法律地位”至关重要。

🎓 MBE 答题技巧

注意题目的提问方式："Which of the following are relevant...?"（以下哪项是相关的？）

这与问“谁会胜诉”不同。当题目问“相关性”时，只要该法律概念能帮助分析当事人的权利、义务或潜在风险，它就是正确选项。在本题中，A、B、C 都是分析不动产合同纠纷的标准法律框架，因此 D 是最佳答案。

questions.question:
Five years ago, a woman acquired a lot improved with a 15-year-old dwelling. This year, the woman listed the property (lot and dwelling) for sale with a licensed real estate broker. The woman informed the broker of several defects in the house that were not readily discoverable by a reasonable inspection, including a leaky basement, an inadequate water supply, and a roof that leaked.
A man responded to the broker's advertisement, was taken by the broker to view the property, and decided to buy it. The broker saw to it that the contract specified the property to be "as is," but neither the broker nor the woman pointed out the defects to the man, who did not ask about the condition of the dwelling. After closing and taking possession, the man discovered the defects, had them repaired, and demanded that the woman reimburse him for the cost of the repairs. The woman refused, and the man brought an appropriate action against the woman for damages.
If the woman wins, what is the likely reason?

choices.a: The "as is" provision in the contract controls the rights of the parties.
choices.b: The broker became the agent of both the man and the woman and thus knowledge of the defects was imputed to the man.
choices.c: The seller of a used dwelling that has been viewed by the buyer has no responsibility toward the buyer.
choices.d: The woman fulfilled the duty to disclose defects by disclosure to the broker.

data.questionStem:
Q86132

Five years ago, a woman acquired a lot improved with a 15-year-old dwelling. This year, the woman listed the property (lot and dwelling) for sale with a licensed real estate broker. The woman informed the broker of several defects in the house that were not readily discoverable by a reasonable inspection, including a leaky basement, an inadequate water supply, and a roof that leaked.

A man responded to the broker's advertisement, was taken by the broker to view the property, and decided to buy it. The broker saw to it that the contract specified the property to be "as is," but neither the broker nor the woman pointed out the defects to the man, who did not ask about the condition of the dwelling. After closing and taking possession, the man discovered the defects, had them repaired, and demanded that the woman reimburse him for the cost of the repairs. The woman refused, and the man brought an appropriate action against the woman for damages.

If the woman wins, what is the likely reason?

五年前，一名女子购得一块土地，其上建有一栋房龄15年的住宅。今年，该女子委托一名有执照的房地产经纪人挂牌出售该房产（土地和住宅）。该女子告知经纪人房屋存在几处无法通过合理检查轻易发现的瑕疵，包括地下室漏水、供水不足以及屋顶漏水。

一名男子回应了经纪人的广告，被经纪人带去查看该房产，并决定购买。经纪人确保合同中明确规定该房产按“现状”出售，但经纪人和该女子均未向该男子指出这些瑕疵，而该男子也未询问住宅的状况。在交易完成并占有房产后，该男子发现了这些瑕疵，进行了修理，并要求该女子赔偿其修理费用。该女子拒绝了，于是该男子对该女子提起了适当的损害赔償诉讼。

如果该女子胜诉，可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. The "as is" provision in the contract controls the rights of the parties.
合同中的“按现状”条款决定了双方的权利。

B. The broker became the agent of both the man and the woman and thus knowledge of the defects was imputed to the man.
经纪人成为了该男子和该女子双方的代理人，因此关于瑕疵的知情被归于该男子。

C. The seller of a used dwelling that has been viewed by the buyer has no responsibility toward the buyer.
已被买方查看过的二手住宅的卖方对买方不承担任何责任。

D. The woman fulfilled the duty to disclose defects by disclosure to the broker.
该女子通过向经纪人披露瑕疵，履行了披露瑕疵的义务。
data.explanation:
Seller's duty to disclose


Common law (minority) ruleCaveat emptor
No duty to disclose property defects unless otherwise provided
Commercial propertyMust disclose known material defects that buyer could not reasonably discover
Modern (majority) ruleResidential property
Must disclose known material defects that buyer could not reasonably discover

Exception: "as is" clause or specific disclaimers without seller's fraud
Under the common-law rule of caveat emptor, a seller had no duty to disclose property defects to the buyer. However, the majority of jurisdictions now require sellers of residential property to disclose material defects that are known to the seller and cannot be reasonably discovered by the buyer. A defect is material if it:

  • substantially affects the value of the residence
  • impacts the health or safety of a resident or
  • affects the desirability of the residence to the buyer.


The seller can disclaim the duty to disclose if
  • the disclaimer is clearly and specifically stated in the real estate contract and
  • the seller has not fraudulently misrepresented or concealed the condition of the property.


Here, the broker disclaimed the woman's duty to disclose by ensuring that the contract specified the property to be "as is." Since the man did not ask about the condition of the dwelling, the woman made no misrepresentations regarding its condition. Therefore, the woman will likely prevail because the "as is" provision in the contract controls the rights of the parties.

(Choice B) The real estate broker is the woman's agent since only she contracted with the broker to list the property. The broker would have been a dual agent representing both parties had the man also hired the broker. But dual representation would not have imputed knowledge of the defects to the man.

(Choice C) Unless otherwise provided, the seller of a used dwelling that has been viewed by the buyer still has a duty to disclose known material defects that cannot be reasonably discovered by the buyer.

(Choice D) Disclosure to the broker was not sufficient to fulfill this duty. The woman could have been vicariously liable for the broker's failure to disclose the defects had this duty not been disclaimed.

Educational objective: Sellers of residential property must disclose known material defects that the buyer cannot reasonably discover. However, the seller can disclaim this duty (eg, with an "as is" clause) so long as the seller has not fraudulently misrepresented or concealed the condition of the property.

选项正确率统计：A选项 48%（正确选项），B选项 6%，C选项 1%，D选项 42%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

卖方的披露义务


普通法（少数派）规则Caveat emptor（买方自慎）
除非另有规定，否则没有义务披露房产瑕疵
商业地产必须披露买方无法合理发现的已知重大瑕疵
现代（多数派）规则住宅房产
必须披露买方无法合理发现的已知重大瑕疵

例外：“按现状”条款或特定免责声明，且卖方无欺诈行为
根据普通法中的 caveat emptor（买方自慎）规则，卖方没有义务向买方披露房产瑕疵。然而，如今大多数司法管辖区要求住宅房产的卖方披露卖方已知且买方无法合理发现的重大瑕疵。如果瑕疵存在以下情况，则为重大瑕疵：

  • 实质性地影响住宅的价值
  • 影响住户的健康或安全 或
  • 影响该住宅对买方的合意性。


在以下情况下，卖方可以免除披露义务：
  • 免责声明在房地产合同中有明确具体的规定，并且
  • 卖方没有欺诈性地虚假陈述或隐瞒房产状况。


在本案中，经纪人通过确保合同中明确规定该房产按“现状”出售，从而免除了该女子的披露义务。由于该男子没有询问住宅的状况，该女子也未就其状况做出任何虚假陈述。因此，该女子很可能胜诉，因为合同中的“按现状”条款决定了双方的权利。

(选项B) 房地产经纪人是该女子的代理人，因为只有她与经纪人签订了挂牌出售房产的合同。如果该男子也雇佣了该经纪人，那么经纪人本应是代表双方的双重代理人。但双重代理关系并不会将瑕疵的知情归于该男子。

(选项C) 除非另有规定，已被买方查看过的二手住宅的卖方仍然有义务披露买方无法合理发现的已知重大瑕疵。

(选项D) 向经纪人披露不足以履行此项义务。如果这项义务没有被免除，该女子本可能因经纪人未能披露瑕疵而承担替代责任。

教学目标： 住宅房产的卖方必须披露买方无法合理发现的已知重大瑕疵。然而，只要卖方没有欺诈性地虚假陈述或隐瞒房产状况，卖方就可以免除此项义务（例如，通过“按现状”条款）。

References

77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 265 (2020) (discussing "as is" sales clauses).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：房产交易中的“按现状”出售

核心法律原则：
在住宅房地产销售中，卖方通常有义务披露已知的、买方无法轻易发现的潜在重大瑕疵 (Latent Material Defects)。

1. 法律规则演变

  • 传统规则： Caveat Emptor（买者自慎）。卖方无披露义务，除非存在积极隐瞒或欺诈。
  • 现代规则（多数管辖区）： 卖方必须披露已知的、买方通过合理检查无法发现的重大瑕疵。

2. “按现状”条款 (As Is Clause) 的效力

这是本题的解题关键。虽然现代规则要求披露，但法律允许双方通过合同条款来分配风险。

如果合同包含“按现状” (As Is) 条款，通常意味着：
  • 卖方免除了对房屋状况的默示担保。
  • 卖方免除了披露一般瑕疵的义务。
  • 买方同意承担房屋存在缺陷的风险。

例外情况（即“按现状”条款无效的情况）：

  • 卖方进行了积极隐瞒 (Active Concealment)（例如：粉刷墙壁以掩盖漏水痕迹）。
  • 卖方进行了欺诈性虚假陈述 (Fraudulent Misrepresentation)（例如：买方问“屋顶漏水吗？”，卖方撒谎说“不漏”）。

3. 本案案情分析

事实 1： 房屋存在潜在瑕疵（漏水等），卖方知情。
事实 2： 合同明确规定房屋“按现状” (As Is) 出售。
事实 3 (关键)： 买方没有询问房屋状况，卖方和经纪人也没有主动指出，但也没有撒谎或积极掩盖。

结论： 由于不存在欺诈（Fraud）或积极隐瞒（Active Concealment），仅仅是沉默（Non-disclosure），“按现状”条款有效并控制了双方的权利。

4. 选项解析

选项 A (正确)
“按现状”条款决定了双方的权利。
这是正确答案。在没有欺诈或故意隐瞒的情况下，具体的合同免责声明（Specific Disclaimer）如“As Is”条款，可以有效免除卖方披露潜在瑕疵的义务。
选项 B (错误)
关于代理权归属。
经纪人是卖方的代理人（Listing Agent），并非双重代理。即使是双重代理，经纪人的知识也不会自动归责于买方从而剥夺买方的追索权。这个选项混淆了代理法原则。
选项 C (错误)
关于卖方责任的绝对化。
这个选项过于绝对，反映的是旧的 Caveat Emptor 规则。在现代法律下，如果没有“按现状”条款，卖方对已知的潜在重大瑕疵是有披露责任的。
选项 D (错误)
关于向经纪人披露。
向自己的经纪人披露并不能免除对买方的披露义务。如果卖方有义务披露，必须确保信息传达给买方。本题胜诉的原因是“按现状”条款，而不是因为她告诉了经纪人。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

遇到 "As Is" 条款的题目时，请立即检查：
  1. 卖方是否撒谎了？（Affirmative Misrepresentation）
  2. 卖方是否积极掩盖了缺陷？（Active Concealment）
如果以上两个答案都是NO（即卖方只是保持沉默），那么“As Is”条款通常有效，卖方胜诉。

questions.question:
A seller contracted to sell land to a buyer for $300,000. The contract provided that the closing would be 60 days after the contract was signed and that the seller would convey to the buyer a "marketable title" by a quitclaim deed at closing. The contract contained no other provisions regarding the title to be delivered to the buyer.
A title search revealed that the land was subject to an unsatisfied $50,000 mortgage and a right-of-way easement over a portion of the land.
The buyer now claims that the title is unmarketable and has refused to close.
Is the buyer correct?

choices.a: No, because nothing under these facts renders title unmarketable.
choices.b: No, because the buyer agreed to accept a quitclaim deed.
choices.c: Yes, because the right-of-way easement makes the title unmarketable.
choices.d: Yes, because the unsatisfied mortgage makes the title unmarketable.

data.questionStem:
Q86801 A seller contracted to sell land to a buyer for $300,000. The contract provided that the closing would be 60 days after the contract was signed and that the seller would convey to the buyer a "marketable title" by a quitclaim deed at closing. The contract contained no other provisions regarding the title to be delivered to the buyer.

A title search revealed that the land was subject to an unsatisfied $50,000 mortgage and a right-of-way easement over a portion of the land.

The buyer now claims that the title is unmarketable and has refused to close.

Is the buyer correct? 卖方与买方签订合同，以30万美元的价格出售土地。合同规定，过户将在合同签订后60天进行，届时卖方将通过一份产权放弃契据 (quitclaim deed) 向买方转让“可销售的产权” (marketable title)。合同中没有关于将交付给买方的产权的其他规定。

产权调查显示，该土地上存在一笔未偿还的5万美元抵押贷款，以及一部分土地上的通行地役权 (right-of-way easement)。

买方现在声称产权不具可销售性，并拒绝过户。

买方的说法正确吗？
options:
A. No, because nothing under these facts renders title unmarketable.
不正确，因为根据这些事实，没有任何情况会使产权不具可销售性。

B. No, because the buyer agreed to accept a quitclaim deed.
不正确，因为买方同意接受产权放弃契据。

C. Yes, because the right-of-way easement makes the title unmarketable.
正确，因为通行地役权使产权不具可销售性。

D. Yes, because the unsatisfied mortgage makes the title unmarketable.
正确，因为未偿还的抵押贷款使产权不具可销售性。
data.explanation:
Every land sale contract contains an implied warranty that the seller will provide marketable title at closing. Marketable title is title reasonably free from doubt and the threat of litigation. [4] Here, the contract explicitly requires the seller to deliver "marketable title," so this duty is a core term of the agreement.

Choice B is incorrect because the buyer's agreement to accept a quitclaim deed relates to the type of deed used at closing, which contains no warranties of title. It does not waive the seller's separate contractual obligation to provide marketable title at the time of closing.

Choice D is incorrect because an unsatisfied mortgage, while an encumbrance, generally does not render title unmarketable before closing. The seller has the right to satisfy the mortgage at or before the closing, often using the proceeds from the sale itself. As long as the purchase price is sufficient to cover the mortgage, and the seller intends to do so, the buyer cannot refuse to close on this basis alone.

The primary issue involves the right-of-way easement, which leads to differing views among legal commentators:

  • NCBE/Tomato View (The Basis for the Official Answer): This view holds that an easement that burdens the property and reduces its value, such as a right-of-way for another's benefit, renders the title unmarketable. Unlike a mortgage, an easement cannot simply be paid off at closing. It is a persistent encumbrance on the land. Therefore, its presence is a violation of the promise to deliver marketable title, and the buyer is correct to refuse to close. For bar exam purposes, this is the critical logic to apply.

  • Emanuel/Barbri & Common Law View: These sources often argue that the result depends on whether the easement was open and visible at the time the contract was signed. Many courts hold that a buyer is presumed to have known about and accepted visible easements (e.g., a visible path or utility lines) and that they do not make title unmarketable. Emanuel's analysis of this specific question suggests the title would be marketable, assuming the easement was apparent.

Conclusion for the Exam: While the real-world application might be more nuanced, for the MBE, you should follow the NCBE's position. A burdensome encumbrance like a right-of-way easement renders title unmarketable, justifying the buyer's refusal to perform. Thus, the buyer's claim is correct.

所有土地销售合同都隐含一项保证，即卖方将在过户时提供可销售的产权。可销售的产权指的是产权不存在合理疑问或诉讼威胁。本案合同明确要求卖方交付“可销售的产权”，因此这是一项核心合同义务。

选项B错误，因为买方同意接受产权放弃契据，这仅涉及过户时使用的契据类型（该类型契据不包含产权担保），但这并不意味着买方放弃了卖方在过户时提供可销售产权的合同义务。

选项D错误，因为尽管未偿还的抵押贷款是一种产权负担，但它通常不会在过户前使产权变得不具可销售性。卖方有权在过户时或之前清偿该抵押贷款，并且在实务中通常会使用出售所得的款项来清偿。只要购房款足以支付抵押贷款，卖方也准备这样做，买方就不能仅以此为由拒绝过户。

本题的核心争议在于通行地役权，对此各机构观点不一：

  • NCBE/Tomato的观点（官方答案所依据的逻辑）：此观点认为，地役权，特别是像通行权这样给地产带来负担并降低其价值的地役权，会使产权不具可销售性。与抵押贷款不同，地役权不能在过户时简单地用钱清除，它是一个持续存在的产权负担。因此，地役权的存在违反了卖方提供可销售产权的承诺，买方拒绝过户是正确的。在准备律师资格考试时，应遵循此逻辑。

  • Emanuel/Barbri及部分判例的观点：这些机构和许多法院认为，结果取决于该地役权在签订合同时是否是公开且可见的。如果地役权是可见的（例如一条明显的道路或电线），法院通常会推定买方已经知晓并接受了该地役权的存在，因此它不会使产权不具可销售性。 Emanuel在解析此题时就指出，假如地役权是显而易见的，则产权应被视为可销售的。

应试结论：尽管在现实世界的法律实践中情况可能更复杂，但在 MBE 考试中，应当采纳 NCBE 的观点。像通行地役权这类具有负担性质的产权瑕疵会使产权不具可销售性，因此买方的拒绝是合法的。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Marketable Title

核心法律原则

在每一个土地销售合同中，除非另有约定，卖方都默示保证在过户（Closing）时提供可销售产权 (Marketable Title)。

所谓“可销售产权”，是指产权没有合理的疑问，且不会让买方面临诉讼的风险。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 C)

地役权 (Easement) 导致产权不可销售。

本题中，产权调查显示土地上存在一个通行地役权 (Right-of-way easement)。这是一种产权负担 (Encumbrance)，它限制了买方对土地的完全使用权，并可能降低土地价值。

根据 MBE 的一般规则（NCBE 观点）：

  • 未在合同中披露或豁免的地役权，会使产权变得“不可销售”。
  • 因此，买方有权以此为由拒绝过户 (Refuse to close)。
❌ 陷阱一：产权放弃契据 (选项 B)

考点：合同义务 vs. 契据类型

很多考生看到买方同意接受 Quitclaim Deed（产权放弃契据/无担保契据），就误以为买方放弃了对产权质量的要求。

这是错误的。 Quitclaim Deed 仅决定了过户后卖方对产权承担什么责任（即无担保责任）。但是，在过户前，卖方仍然必须履行合同中的承诺——即交付“可销售的产权”。契据的形式不能免除合同中关于产权质量的明示或默示条款。

❌ 陷阱二：抵押贷款 (选项 D)

考点：可补救的缺陷 (Curable Defect)

虽然未偿还的抵押贷款 (Mortgage) 也是一种产权负担，但它通常不会导致产权在过户前被视为不可销售。

理由： 法律允许卖方在过户当天，使用买方支付的购房款来清偿抵押贷款。只要购房款足够支付这笔 $50,000 的贷款，这就是一个“可补救”的缺陷。买方不能仅因为存在尚未注销的抵押贷款就拒绝过户。

💡 MBE 实战技巧

区分“地役权”与“抵押贷款”：

  • 抵押贷款 (Mortgage)：通常可以用钱解决。只要卖方打算用卖房款还债，产权就是可销售的。
  • 地役权 (Easement)：通常不能单方面用钱解决（需要第三方同意放弃）。如果合同没提到它，它就是产权瑕疵，买方可以跑路。

注意： 尽管现实中有些法院认为“可见的地役权”不影响产权销售，但在 MBE 考试中，除非题目明确说买方知情或豁免，否则应认定未披露的地役权导致产权不可销售。

questions.question:
A widow owned a house in fee simple. Three years ago, the widow and her sister agreed to a month-to-month tenancy with the sister paying the widow rent each month. After six months of the sister's occupancy, the widow suggested to the sister that she could buy the house for a monthly payment of no more than her rent. The widow and the sister orally agreed that the sister would pay $25,000 in cash, the annual real estate taxes, the annual fire insurance premiums, the costs of maintaining the house, plus the monthly mortgage payments that the widow owed on the house. They further orally agreed that within six years, the sister could pay whatever mortgage balances were then due and the widow would give the sister a warranty deed to the property.
The sister fully complied with all the obligations she had undertaken. She made structural modifications to the house that increased its value by more than 50% compared to when the widow and the sister made their oral agreement. The sister then made her financing arrangements and was ready to complete the purchase of the house, but the widow refused to close.
The sister brought an appropriate action for specific performance against the widow to enforce the agreement.
Who will likely prevail?

choices.a: The sister, because the doctrine of part performance applies.
choices.b: The sister, because the statute of frauds does not apply to oral purchase and sale agreements between landlords and tenants in possession.
choices.c: The widow, because the agreements were oral and violated the statute of frauds.
choices.d: The widow, subject to the return of the $25,000, because the arrangement was still a tenancy.
