Q86138

A widow owned a house in fee simple. Three years ago, the widow and her sister agreed to a month-to-month tenancy with the sister paying the widow rent each month. After six months of the sister's occupancy, the widow suggested to the sister that she could buy the house for a monthly payment of no more than her rent. The widow and the sister orally agreed that the sister would pay $25,000 in cash, the annual real estate taxes, the annual fire insurance premiums, the costs of maintaining the house, plus the monthly mortgage payments that the widow owed on the house. They further orally agreed that within six years, the sister could pay whatever mortgage balances were then due and the widow would give the sister a warranty deed to the property.

The sister fully complied with all the obligations she had undertaken. She made structural modifications to the house that increased its value by more than 50% compared to when the widow and the sister made their oral agreement. The sister then made her financing arrangements and was ready to complete the purchase of the house, but the widow refused to close.

The sister brought an appropriate action for specific performance against the widow to enforce the agreement.

Who will likely prevail?

一位寡妇以完全所有权(fee simple)拥有一栋房屋。三年前，该寡妇和她的妹妹达成了一份按月租赁协议，由妹妹每月向寡妇支付租金。妹妹居住了六个月后，寡妇向妹妹提议，她可以以不超过其租金的月付款购买该房屋。寡妇和妹妹口头约定，妹妹将支付25,000美元现金、每年的房产税、每年的火灾保险费、房屋的维护费用，以及寡妇所欠的每月抵押贷款。她们还进一步口头约定，在六年内，妹妹可以支付届时到期的任何抵押贷款余额，寡妇将向妹妹提供一份有担保的房契(warranty deed)。

妹妹完全履行了她所承担的所有义务。她对房屋进行了结构性改造，与寡妇和妹妹达成口头协议时相比，房屋价值增加了50%以上。随后，妹妹做好了融资安排，准备完成房屋的购买，但寡妇拒绝成交。

妹妹对寡妇提起了要求强制履行(specific performance)的适当诉讼，以执行该协议。

谁可能会胜诉？
options:
A. The sister, because the doctrine of part performance applies.
妹妹，因为部分履行原则(doctrine of part performance)适用。

B. The sister, because the statute of frauds does not apply to oral purchase and sale agreements between landlords and tenants in possession.
妹妹，因为反欺诈法(statute of frauds)不适用于占有房产的房东和租户之间的口头买卖协议。

C. The widow, because the agreements were oral and violated the statute of frauds.
寡妇，因为协议是口头的，违反了反欺诈法(statute of frauds)。

D. The widow, subject to the return of the $25,000, because the arrangement was still a tenancy.
寡妇，但须返还25,000美元，因为该安排仍然是租赁关系。
data.explanation:
Statute of frauds requirements for real estate contracts


WritingPhysical or electronic document(s) containing reasonable basis to believe contract was formed

eg, receipt, check, emails
SignatureHandwritten signature from, or other mark identifying, party to be charged

eg, letterhead, electronic signature, initials
Essential termsTypically includes:
  • identity of parties
  • words of intent to buy or sell
  • property description
  • sales price
The statute of frauds applies to all real estate contracts - including purchase and sale agreements between landlords and tenants in possession - and requires that the contract (1) be in writing, (2) be signed by the party against whom it is to be enforced, and (3) contain all essential terms. Therefore, the widow and the sister's oral agreement regarding the sale and purchase of the house violates this statute (Choice B).

However, an oral agreement may still be enforceable if it falls within the doctrine of part performance. This exception to the statute of frauds applies when the buyer has done the following:
  • taken possession of the property (eg, the sister continued to live in the house)
  • made substantial improvements to the property (eg, the sister's modification increased its value by 50%) and/or
  • paid some or all of the purchase price† (eg, the sister's $25,000 cash payment and monthly payments)
The buyer can then enforce the oral agreement in equity, typically by seeking specific performance. As a result, the sister will likely prevail (Choice C).

†Payment of some or all of the purchase price is not independently sufficient to establish part performance.

(Choice D) Although the arrangement started as a tenancy, it transformed into an enforceable real estate contract when the sister fully complied with her contractual obligations and was ready to purchase the home. As a result, the sister has the right to enforce the agreement under the doctrine of part performance.

Educational objective: Part performance is an exception to the statute of frauds. This exception entitles the buyer to equitable relief (eg, specific performance) if the buyer has (1) taken possession of the property, (2) substantially improved the property, and/or (3) paid any amount of the purchase price.

选项正确率统计：A选项 78%（正确选项），B选项 3%，C选项 15%，D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

反欺诈法(Statute of frauds)对不动产合同的要求


书面形式包含可合理相信合同已成立之依据的实体或电子文件

例如：收据、支票、电子邮件
签名被执行方的手写签名或其他识别标记

例如：信头、电子签名、姓名首字母缩写
基本条款通常包括：
  • 当事人身份
  • 表示购买或出售意图的词语
  • 财产描述
  • 销售价格
反欺诈法(statute of frauds)适用于所有不动产合同——包括占有房产的房东和租户之间的买卖协议——并要求合同（1）必须是书面形式，（2）必须由被执行方签署，并且（3）必须包含所有基本条款。因此，寡妇和妹妹关于房屋买卖的口头协议违反了该法(选项 B)。

然而，如果口头协议符合部分履行原则(doctrine of part performance)，则仍可强制执行。反欺诈法的这一例外适用于买方已完成以下行为的情况：
  • 占有该财产（例如，妹妹继续居住在该房屋中）
  • 对财产进行了重大改良（例如，妹妹的改造使其价值增加了50%）和/或
  • 支付了部分或全部购买价款†（例如，妹妹支付的25,000美元现金和每月付款）
买方随后可以依据衡平法(equity)强制执行该口头协议，通常通过寻求强制履行(specific performance)的方式。因此，妹妹可能会胜诉(选项 C)。

†支付部分或全部购买价款本身并不足以构成部分履行。

(选项 D) 尽管该安排最初是租赁关系，但当妹妹完全履行了其合同义务并准备购买房屋时，它已转变为一份可强制执行的不动产合同。因此，妹妹有权根据部分履行原则(doctrine of part performance)强制执行该协议。

教学目标：部分履行(Part performance)是反欺诈法(statute of frauds)的一项例外。如果买方（1）已占有该财产，（2）已对该财产进行重大改良，和/或（3）已支付任何金额的购买价款，则该例外赋予买方获得衡平法救济（例如，强制履行）的权利。

References

73 Am. Jur. 2d Statute of Frauds §§ 289, 305, 325, 329 (2020).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Estate Contracts / Property
核心考点：反欺诈法与部分履行
通常情况下，土地买卖合同必须是书面的才能执行（依据 Statute of Frauds）。

但是，如果买方已经进行了部分履行 (Part Performance)，即使是口头协议，法院也可以基于衡平法 (Equity) 强制执行合同。

部分履行的认定标准

大多数司法管辖区要求满足以下三项中的至少两项，即可证明口头合同的存在：

✓
1. 支付价款 (Payment)
Payment of all or part of the purchase price.
✓
2. 占有房产 (Possession)
Taking possession of the property.
✓
3. 重大改良 (Improvements)
Making substantial improvements.

本案事实分析

在本题中，尽管寡妇和妹妹之间只有口头协议，但妹妹的行为完全符合“部分履行”的要求：

  • 💰 支付：妹妹支付了$25,000现金、房产税、保险费及抵押贷款。
  • 🏠 占有：妹妹继续居住在该房屋中。
  • 🔨 改良：这是最关键的一点。妹妹进行了结构性改造，使房屋增值50%。

注意：普通的租户通常不会支付房产税或进行使房屋大幅增值的结构性改造。这些行为“无可辩驳地指向”(Unequivocally referable) 买卖合同的存在，而非租赁关系。

正确答案：A
妹妹胜诉，因为部分履行原则适用。

为什么其他选项是错的？

  • 选项 B：错误。反欺诈法(Statute of Frauds)确实适用于房东和租户之间的买卖协议，并没有此类豁免。
  • 选项 C：错误。虽然违反了反欺诈法的书面要求，但“部分履行”是该法的重要例外。
  • 选项 D：错误。妹妹的行为已经超出了租赁关系的范畴（特别是支付房产税和重大装修），法律上已视为买卖合同的履行。
💡 MBE 考试技巧
当题目出现“口头土地买卖合同”时，第一反应是“无效（违反反欺诈法）”。
但紧接着要看买方是否做了三件事：给钱、住进去、大装修。如果做了其中两项（特别是大装修），这就是部分履行，合同有效！

questions.question:
A man owned a tract of land in fee simple. He and the owner of a neighboring tract entered into a written agreement under which the neighbor agreed to buy the man's tract for $100,000, its fair market value. The agreement contained all the essential terms of a real estate contract to sell and buy, including a date for closing. The neighbor made the required $50,000 down payment that, pursuant to the contract, the man could retain as liquidated damages in the event of the neighbor's breach.
Before the date set for the closing in the contract, the neighbor died. After the closing date, the neighbor's daughter was duly qualified as administrator of the estate and immediately made demand for return of the $50,000 deposit. The man responded by stating that he took such demand to be a declaration that the daughter did not intend to complete the contract and that he considered the contract at an end. The man further asserted that he was entitled to retain, as liquidated damages, the $50,000. The reasonable market value of the disputed tract had increased to $110,000 by this time.
The daughter brought an appropriate action against the man to recover the $50,000. In his answer, the man made no affirmative claim but asserted that he was entitled to retain the $50,000 as liquidated damages as provided in the contract.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.a: The daughter, because the neighbor's death terminated the contract as a matter of law.
choices.b: The daughter, because the provision relied upon by the man is unenforceable.
choices.c: The man, because the court should enforce the express agreement of the contracting parties.
choices.d: The man, because the doctrine of equitable conversion prevents termination of the contract upon the death of a party.

data.questionStem:
Q86135

A man owned a tract of land in fee simple. He and the owner of a neighboring tract entered into a written agreement under which the neighbor agreed to buy the man's tract for $100,000, its fair market value. The agreement contained all the essential terms of a real estate contract to sell and buy, including a date for closing. The neighbor made the required $50,000 down payment that, pursuant to the contract, the man could retain as liquidated damages in the event of the neighbor's breach.

Before the date set for the closing in the contract, the neighbor died. After the closing date, the neighbor's daughter was duly qualified as administrator of the estate and immediately made demand for return of the $50,000 deposit. The man responded by stating that he took such demand to be a declaration that the daughter did not intend to complete the contract and that he considered the contract at an end. The man further asserted that he was entitled to retain, as liquidated damages, the $50,000. The reasonable market value of the disputed tract had increased to $110,000 by this time.

The daughter brought an appropriate action against the man to recover the $50,000. In his answer, the man made no affirmative claim but asserted that he was entitled to retain the $50,000 as liquidated damages as provided in the contract.

Who is likely to prevail?

一名男子以完全所有权 (fee simple) 拥有一块土地。他与邻近地块的所有人签订了一份书面协议，根据该协议，邻居同意以10万美元（该土地的公平市场价值）购买该男子的土地。该协议包含了房地产买卖合同的所有必要条款，包括一个交割日期。邻居支付了合同规定的5万美元定金，根据合同，如果邻居违约，该男子可以保留这笔款项作为违约金 (liquidated damages)。

在合同规定的交割日期之前，邻居去世了。交割日期过后，邻居的女儿被正式指定为遗产管理人，并立即要求返还5万美元的定金。该男子回应称，他将此要求视为其女儿不打算履行合同的声明，并认为合同已经终止。该男子进一步声称，他有权保留这5万美元作为违约金。

此时，争议地块的合理市场价值已增至11万美元。

女儿对该男子提起了适当的诉讼，以追回这5万美元。在其答辩中，该男子没有提出积极性请求权主张，但声称他有权根据合同规定保留这5万美元作为违约金。

谁可能胜诉？
options:
A. The daughter, because the neighbor's death terminated the contract as a matter of law.
女儿，因为邻居的死亡依法终止了合同。

B. The daughter, because the provision relied upon by the man is unenforceable.
女儿，因为该男子所依据的条款是不可强制执行的。

C. The man, because the court should enforce the express agreement of the contracting parties.
该男子，因为法院应当强制执行合同当事人的明示协议。

D. The man, because the doctrine of equitable conversion prevents termination of the contract upon the death of a party.
该男子，因为衡平法转换原则 (doctrine of equitable conversion) 阻止了合同因一方当事人的死亡而终止。
data.explanation:
The doctrine of equitable conversion applies during the period between contract formation and closing. During this executory period, the seller acquires the equitable right to the purchase price and the buyer acquires equitable title to the property. Since equitable title is treated as an interest in real property, it can be transferred like any other property interest - subject to the seller's equitable lien for the purchase price. So when the neighbor died, equitable title passed to the beneficiary of his estate and the contract remained in effect (Choices A & D).

The daughter, as the administrator of the neighbor's estate, then breached the land-sale contract when she demanded return of the $50,000 deposit in lieu of completing the contract. The deposit constitutes liquidated damages since the contract allows the seller to retain this money in the event of the neighbor's breach. Liquidated damages are recoverable only if they reasonably compensate the injured party. As a result, they are not recoverable if they constitute a penalty - eg, when the liquidated amount exceeds 15% of the purchase price.

Here, the neighbor's $50,000 down payment is equivalent to 50% of the purchase price. This means that the court will likely hold that the liquidated damages constitute a penalty and that this express contractual provision is unenforceable (Choice C). As a result, the daughter is likely to prevail.

Educational objective: Equitable conversion allows a buyer's equitable title to be transferred upon his/her death, thereby keeping the land-sale contract in effect. Liquidated damages under the contract are recoverable only if they reasonably compensate the injured party - eg, if the liquidated amount is less than 15% of the purchase price.



选项正确率统计：A选项 19%，B选项 39%（正确选项），C选项 18%，D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

衡平法转换原则 (doctrine of equitable conversion) 适用于合同成立与交割之间的期间。在此待履行期间，卖方获得收取购买价款的衡平法上的权利，而买方则获得该财产的衡平法上的所有权 (equitable title)。由于衡平法上的所有权被视为一种不动产权益，它可以像任何其他财产权益一样被转让——但须受制于卖方对购买价款的衡平法上的留置权。因此，当邻居去世时，衡平法上的所有权转移给了其遗产的受益人，合同仍然有效（选项 A 和 D）。

作为邻居遗产的管理人，其女儿要求返还5万美元的定金以代替履行合同，此行为违反了土地买卖合同。由于合同允许卖方在邻居违约时保留这笔款项，该定金构成了违约金 (liquidated damages)。违约金只有在能合理补偿受损害方的情况下才是可获赔偿的。因此，如果违约金构成罚金 (penalty)——例如，当违约金的数额超过购买价款的15%时——它们就是不可获赔偿的。

在本案中，邻居支付的5万美元定金相当于购买价款的50%。这意味着法院很可能会裁定该违约金构成罚金，并且这一明示的合同条款是不可强制执行的（选项 C）。因此，女儿可能会胜诉。

教学目标：衡平法转换原则 (Equitable conversion) 允许买方在死亡时将其衡平法上的所有权转移，从而使土地买卖合同保持有效。合同项下的违约金只有在能合理补偿受损害方的情况下才是可获赔偿的——例如，如果违约金数额低于购买价款的15%。

References

  • 77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 478 (2020) (seller's recovery of liquidated damages).
  • 27A Am. Jur. 2d Equitable Conversion § 13 (2020) (equitable conversion under land-sale contracts).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Estate Contracts & Remedies

✅ 正确答案：B

女儿胜诉。因为该男子所依据的没收5万美元定金的条款属于罚金性质，在法律上是不可强制执行的 (Unenforceable)。

⚖️ 核心法律规则解析
1. 违约金 vs. 罚金 (Liquidated Damages vs. Penalty)

这是本题的决定性考点。合同中约定的违约金条款若要有效，必须满足两个条件：

  • 预估的困难性：在签约时，实际损失很难准确估算。
  • 金额的合理性：约定的金额必须是对预期损失的合理预测 (Reasonable forecast)。

如果约定的金额过高，不成比例，法院会将其视为罚金 (Penalty)，并拒绝执行。通常在房地产合同中，超过售价 10%-15% 的定金没收条款常被视为具有惩罚性。

2. 衡平法转换 (Equitable Conversion)

虽然这解释了为什么合同没有因邻居死亡而终止，但它不是决定谁赢得这笔钱的关键。

根据该原则，买方死后，其不动产权益（衡平法所有权）转移给继承人/遗产。因此，合同依然有效。这也是为什么选项 A 错误的原因。

🔍 案情具体分析

在本案中，法院会判决女儿胜诉，理由如下：

  • 比例过高：定金为 $50,000，占总价 $100,000 的 50%。这远远超过了通常被认为是合理的违约金比例（通常为10%左右）。
  • 无实际损失：土地的市场价值在违约时已经上涨到了 $110,000。卖方（该男子）不仅没有损失，反而因为保留了土地而获益。
  • 结论：允许卖方保留50%的房款且毫无实际损失，构成了对买方的惩罚，而非对卖方的补偿。因此，该条款无效。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？

选项 A (合同终止)：错误。根据 Equitable Conversion，买方死亡不终止土地买卖合同，义务转移给遗产。

选项 C (强制执行)：错误。法院不会仅仅因为条款写在合同里就强制执行它。公共政策禁止合同中的惩罚性条款。

选项 D (衡平法转换)：错误。虽然原则陈述正确（合同未终止），但结论错误。正是因为合同未终止且女儿拒绝履行（违约），我们才需要分析违约金条款。而因为该条款是罚金，所以男子不能保留这笔钱。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧：

遇到 Liquidated Damages 的题目，请立即检查两个指标：
  1. 比例：定金是否超过总价的 10-15%？如果是，很可能是 Penalty。
  2. 实际损失：卖方是否真的亏了？如果卖方后来以更高价格卖出（或市价上涨），法院通常不愿意执行巨额的违约金没收。

questions.question:
A niece inherited vacant land from her uncle. She lived in a distant state and decided to sell the land to a colleague who was interested in purchasing the land as an investment. They orally agreed upon a price, and, at the colleague's insistence, the niece agreed to provide him with a warranty deed without any exceptions. The price was paid, the warranty deed was delivered, and the deed was promptly recorded. Neither the niece nor the colleague had, at that point, ever seen the land.
After recording the deed, the colleague visited the land for the first time and discovered that it had no access to any public right-of-way and that none of the surrounding lands had ever been held in common ownership with any previous owner of the land. The colleague sued the niece for damages.
For whom will the court find?

choices.a: The colleague, because lack of access makes title unmarketable.
choices.b: The colleague, because the covenants of warranty and quiet enjoyment in the deed were breached.
choices.c: The niece, because no title covenants were breached.
choices.d: The niece, because the agreement to sell was oral.

data.questionStem:
Q86140

A niece inherited vacant land from her uncle. She lived in a distant state and decided to sell the land to a colleague who was interested in purchasing the land as an investment. They orally agreed upon a price, and, at the colleague's insistence, the niece agreed to provide him with a warranty deed without any exceptions. The price was paid, the warranty deed was delivered, and the deed was promptly recorded. Neither the niece nor the colleague had, at that point, ever seen the land.

After recording the deed, the colleague visited the land for the first time and discovered that it had no access to any public right-of-way and that none of the surrounding lands had ever been held in common ownership with any previous owner of the land. The colleague sued the niece for damages.

For whom will the court find?

一位侄女从她叔叔那里继承了一片闲置土地。她住在一个遥远的州，决定将这片土地卖给一位有意购买该土地作为投资的同事。他们口头约定了一个价格，并且在该同事的坚持下，侄女同意向他提供一份没有任何例外的通用担保契据（warranty deed）。价款已支付，通用担保契据已交付，并且该契据被及时登记。在那时，侄女和同事都从未见过这片土地。

在登记契据后，同事第一次实地查看该土地，发现它没有任何通往公共通行道路的通道，并且周围的土地从未与该土地的任何前任所有者共同拥有过。同事起诉侄女要求损害赔偿。

法院将支持哪一方？
options:
A. The colleague, because lack of access makes title unmarketable.
支持同事，因为缺乏通行权导致产权不具可售性（unmarketable）。

B. The colleague, because the covenants of warranty and quiet enjoyment in the deed were breached.
支持同事，因为契据中的担保契约（covenant of warranty）和安宁享有契约（covenant of quiet enjoyment）被违反了。

C. The niece, because no title covenants were breached.
支持侄女，因为没有产权契约被违反。

D. The niece, because the agreement to sell was oral.
支持侄女，因为出售协议是口头的。
data.explanation:
Covenants of title

(warranty & special warranty deeds)
Present covenants
(breached at time of conveyance)
SeisinGrantor owns interest being conveyed
Right to conveyGrantor has legal right to convey interest
Against encumbrancesNo encumbrances (eg, easements, mortgages) against interest conveyed
Future covenants
(breached upon interference with possession)
WarrantyGrantor will defend & compensate grantee for lawful claims made against grantee's title
Quiet enjoymentGrantee's possession & enjoyment will not be disturbed by another's lawful claim of title
Further assurancesGrantor will take any actions reasonably necessary to perfect grantee's title
Unless otherwise stated, contracts for the sale of land impliedly warrant that the seller will convey marketable title to the buyer upon closing. To be marketable, title must be reasonably free from doubt and under no threat of litigation, such that a reasonable person would accept and pay for it. Lack of access to a public road may render title unmarketable.† However, the time for the buyer to object to marketability of title is prior to delivery and acceptance of the deed - which have already occurred here (Choice A).

Once a deed is delivered to and accepted by the buyer, the sales contract merges with the deed and the seller is no longer liable on the implied warranty of marketable title. If a problem arises with title thereafter, the buyer's remedy , if any, would be under an express provision or a covenant of title in the deed (listed above).

Lack of access to a public road is not a breach of warranty, quiet enjoyment, or any other title covenant. The reason is that the colleague's lack of access does not detract from his ownership rights in the land or create a superior claim to the land by a third party (Choice B). As a result, the court will find in favor of the niece.

†Courts are split as to whether lack of access to a public road is an encumbrance that makes title to property unmarketable.

(Choice D) The statute of frauds requires that land-sale contracts be in writing to be enforceable. But since the oral land-sale contract has been executed and the colleague has accepted the deed, he can seek relief only under the deed.

Educational objective: Under the merger doctrine, a contract for the sale of land merges with the deed once the deed has been delivered to and accepted by the buyer. If any problems with title arise thereafter, the buyer must rely on the covenants of title or other provisions contained within the deed.

选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 8%，C选项 67%（正确选项），D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

产权契约（Covenants of title）

（通用担保契据和特殊担保契据）
即时契约（Present covenants）
（在转让时即告违反）
Seisin（所有权契约）出让人拥有所转让的权益
Right to convey（转让权契约）出让人拥有转让该权益的合法权利
Against encumbrances（无负担契约）所转让的权益上不存在任何产权负担（如地役权、抵押权）
未来契约（Future covenants）
（在占有受到干涉时才告违反）
Warranty（担保契约）出让人将为受让人进行辩护，并就针对受让人产权的合法索赔进行赔偿
Quiet enjoyment（安宁享有契约）受让人的占有和享有将不会被他人合法的产权主张所干扰
Further assurances（补正契约）出让人将采取任何合理必要的行动来完善受让人的产权
除非另有规定，土地销售合同默示保证卖方将在交易完成时向买方转让可售产权（marketable title）。要具备可售性，产权必须合理地无疑问，且不受诉讼威胁，以至于一个理性人会接受并为此付款。缺乏通往公共道路的通道可能导致产权不具可售性。†然而，买方对产权可售性提出异议的时间是在契据交付和接受之前——而在此案中，这一程序已经完成（选项A）。

一旦契据交付给买方并被其接受，销售合同即与契据合并（merges with the deed），卖方不再对可售产权的默示保证承担责任。如果此后产权出现问题，买方的救济措施（如有）将依据契据中的明确条款或产权契约（如上所列）。

缺乏通往公共道路的通道并不构成对担保契约、安宁享有契约或任何其他产权契约的违反。其原因是，该同事缺乏通行权并未减损其对土地的所有权，也未产生第三方对该土地的优先权利主张（选项B）。因此，法院将裁定支持侄女。

†关于缺乏通往公共道路的通道是否构成使产权不具可售性的产权负担，法院存在分歧。

（选项D）《防止欺诈法》（Statute of Frauds）要求土地销售合同必须以书面形式订立方可执行。但由于口头土地销售合同已经履行，且同事已接受契据，他只能根据该契据寻求救济。

教学目标：根据合并原则（merger doctrine），一旦契据交付给买方并被其接受，土地销售合同即与契据合并。如果此后产权出现任何问题，买方必须依赖契据中包含的产权契约或其他条款。

References

77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 227 (2020) (merger doctrine).

77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 143 (2020) (lack of access to land).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考题解析

Real Property: Deeds & Covenants
正确答案：C (The niece)

本题考察的是不动产交易中非常核心的两个概念：合并原则 (Merger Doctrine) 以及 契据中的契约 (Covenants of Title) 的范围。

核心法律规则
1. 合并原则 (Merger Doctrine) 一旦契据（Deed）被交付并接受，土地买卖合同（Contract）中的条款就“合并”进了契据中。此时，合同中关于“可售产权”(Marketable Title)的默示保证终止。买方只能依据契据中的条款进行索赔。
2. 担保契据的范围 (Scope of Warranty Deed) 通用担保契据保证产权没有瑕疵（如第三方拥有所有权、未披露的抵押权等）。但是，土地缺乏进出通道 (Lack of access / Landlocked) 通常被视为物理缺陷或经济缺陷，而非“产权”缺陷。
逻辑推演步骤
1
时间点判断：契据已经交付并登记（Deed delivered and recorded）。这意味着交易已经完成（Closing），我们不再看合同阶段的权利，只看契据阶段的权利。
2
排除合同救济：虽然缺乏通道可能导致产权在合同阶段“不可售”(Unmarketable)，但买方没有在过户前提出异议。过户后，该权利已消灭。
3
分析契据责任：买方起诉的理由是土地“没有通道”。
  • 这是否违反了所有权契约 (Seisin)？没有，侄女确实拥有土地。
  • 这是否违反了无负担契约 (Against Encumbrances)？大多数法院认为，缺乏通道不是产权负担，而是土地价值的减损。
  • 这是否违反了安宁享有契约 (Quiet Enjoyment)？没有，因为没有第三方跳出来主张对土地拥有优越的权利。
4
结论：既然没有违反契据中的任何契约，侄女无需承担赔偿责任。
易错项辨析
选项 A 错误 (Marketable Title)
这是最大的干扰项。如果在过户前（合同阶段），买方确实可以因为土地无法进入而主张产权不可售并拒绝交易。但一旦过户（Closing），“可售产权”的保证就失效了（被合并了）。
选项 B 错误 (Breach of Covenants)
Warranty 和 Quiet Enjoyment 是未来契约，只有当买方的占有被拥有“优越产权”(Superior Title)的第三方干扰时才会被违反。这里只是买方自己进不去，并没有别人来抢地，所以没有违约。
选项 D 错误 (Statute of Frauds)
虽然土地合同必须书面（防止欺诈法），但该原则不适用于已经完全履行(Fully Executed)的合同。钱已付，地已过户，买方不能再拿“口头协议”作为理由来推翻交易或索赔。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 看到 "Deed was delivered" 或 "Closing"，立即划掉所有关于 "Marketable Title" 的选项。过户后，只谈 Deed Covenants（契据契约）。记住：Lack of access（没路走）通常不属于 Title Defect（产权瑕疵）。
© MBE Property Law Review

questions.question:
For 22 years, the land records have shown a man as the owner of an 80-acre farm. The man has never physically occupied the land.
Nineteen years ago, a woman entered the farm. The character and duration of the woman's possession of the farm caused her to become the owner of the farm under the adverse possession law of the jurisdiction.
Three years ago, when the woman was not present, a neighbor took over possession of the farm. The neighbor repaired fences, put up "no trespassing" signs, and did some plowing. When the woman returned, she found the neighbor in possession of the farm. The neighbor vigorously rejected the woman's claimed right to possession and threatened force. The woman withdrew.
The woman then went to the man and told him of the history of activity on the farm. The woman orally told the man that she had been wrong to try to take his farm. She expressly waived any claim she had to the land. The man thanked her.
Last month, unsure of the effect of her conversation with the man, the woman executed a deed purporting to convey the farm to her son. The son promptly recorded the deed.
The period of time to acquire title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years.
Who now owns the farm?

choices.a: The man, because the woman's later words and actions released title to the man.
choices.b: The neighbor, because the neighbor succeeded to the woman's adverse possession title by privity of possession.
choices.c: The son, because he succeeded to the woman's adverse possession title by privity of conveyance.
choices.d: The woman, because she must bring a quiet title action to establish her title to the farm before she can convey the farm to her son.

data.questionStem:
Q86131

For 22 years, the land records have shown a man as the owner of an 80-acre farm. The man has never physically occupied the land.

Nineteen years ago, a woman entered the farm. The character and duration of the woman's possession of the farm caused her to become the owner of the farm under the adverse possession law of the jurisdiction.

Three years ago, when the woman was not present, a neighbor took over possession of the farm. The neighbor repaired fences, put up "no trespassing" signs, and did some plowing. When the woman returned, she found the neighbor in possession of the farm. The neighbor vigorously rejected the woman's claimed right to possession and threatened force. The woman withdrew.

The woman then went to the man and told him of the history of activity on the farm. The woman orally told the man that she had been wrong to try to take his farm. She expressly waived any claim she had to the land. The man thanked her.

Last month, unsure of the effect of her conversation with the man, the woman executed a deed purporting to convey the farm to her son. The son promptly recorded the deed.

The period of time to acquire title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years.

Who now owns the farm?

22年来，土地记录显示一名男子是占地80英亩农场的所有者。该男子从未实际占有该土地。

19年前，一名女子进入该农场。该女子占有农场的性质和持续时间，使她根据该司法管辖区的侵权逆占法成为了该农场的所有者。

三年前，当该女子不在场时，一位邻居接管并占有了该农场。邻居修理了栅栏，竖起了“禁止侵入”的标志，并进行了一些耕作。当该女子返回时，她发现邻居占有着该农场。邻居强烈拒绝了该女子声称的占有权，并以武力相威胁。该女子退让了。

随后，该女子找到该男子，告诉了他农场上活动的历史。该女子口头告诉该男子，她试图占有他的农场是错误的。她明确放弃了对该土地的任何权利主张。该男子感谢了她。

上个月，由于不确定她与该男子对话的效力，该女子签署了一份契约，意图将农场转让给她的儿子。儿子立即登记了该契约。

在该司法管辖区，通过侵权逆占获得所有权的时效期为10年。

现在谁拥有该农场？
options:
A. The man, because the woman's later words and actions released title to the man.
该男子，因为该女子后来的言语和行为将所有权归还给了该男子。

B. The neighbor, because the neighbor succeeded to the woman's adverse possession title by privity of possession.
邻居，因为邻居通过占有之关联继承了该女子的侵权逆占所有权。

C. The son, because he succeeded to the woman's adverse possession title by privity of conveyance.
儿子，因为他通过转让之关联继承了该女子的侵权逆占所有权。

D. The woman, because she must bring a quiet title action to establish her title to the farm before she can convey the farm to her son.
该女子，因为她必须在将农场转让给儿子之前，提起确认产权诉讼以确立她对农场的所有权。
data.explanation:
Contracts subject to statute of frauds


Marriage - promise in consideration of marriage
Year - contract cannot be completed within one year
Land - sale or other transfer of real property
Executor - promise to pay estate's debt from executor's personal funds
Goods - sale of goods for $500 or more
Suretyship - promise to pay another's debt
Mnemonic: MY LEGS

The statute of frauds requires that a conveyance of real property:

  • be in writing
  • identify the parties and property and
  • be signed by the donor (the person conveying the property).


Here, the woman acquired title to the man's farm by adverse possession. Although the woman later apologized to the man and orally waived her claim to the farm (Choice A), the man did not regain title because the woman's oral statement did not satisfy the statute of frauds since there was no signed writing. Therefore, the woman still owned the farm when she conveyed it to her son.

(Choice B) The neighbor did not succeed the woman's adverse possession title because they lacked privity - a mutual or successive interest in the same property right. Instead, the neighbor took possession of the farm without the woman's permission and excluded her from the property.

But since the neighbor has only possessed the farm for 3 years, he has not acquired title by adverse possession and he has no other ownership interest.

(Choice D) The woman could have brought a quiet title action to establish her title to the farm (acquired by adverse possession) above all others before conveying it, but was not required to do so.

Educational objective: The statute of frauds requires that a conveyance of real property (1) be in writing, (2) identify the parties and property, and (3) be signed by the donor.

选项正确率统计：A选项 15%，B选项 5%，C选项 50%（正确选项），D选项 29%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

受反欺诈法(statute of frauds)约束的合同


Marriage (婚姻) - 因婚姻而作出的承诺
Year (年份) - 无法在一年内完成的合同
Land (土地) - 不动产的买卖或其他转让
Executor (遗嘱执行人) - 承诺用遗嘱执行人的个人资金支付遗产债务
Goods (货物) - 价值500美元或以上的货物销售
Suretyship (保证) - 承诺支付他人债务
助记词: MY LEGS

反欺诈法(statute of frauds)要求不动产的转让必须：

  • 以书面形式
  • 指明当事人和财产并且
  • 由赠与人（转让财产的人）签署。


在本案中，该女子通过侵权逆占获得了该男子农场的所有权。尽管该女子后来向该男子道歉，并口头放弃了她对农场的权利主张（选项A），但该男子并未重新获得所有权，因为该女子的口头声明不满足反欺诈法的要求，即没有经签署的书面文件。因此，当该女子将农场转让给她的儿子时，她仍然拥有该农场。

（选项B）邻居没有继承该女子的侵权逆占所有权，因为他们之间缺乏关联关系(privity)——即对同一财产权的共同或连续的利益。相反，邻居未经该女子许可占有了农场，并将她排除在财产之外。

但由于邻居只占有了该农场3年，他尚未通过侵权逆占获得所有权，也没有其他所有权权益。

（选项D）该女子本可以在转让农场之前提起确认产权诉讼(quiet title action)，以确立她（通过侵权逆占获得的）对农场的所有权，使其高于所有其他人，但法律并未要求她必须这样做。

教学目标：反欺诈法(statute of frauds)要求不动产的转让必须（1）以书面形式进行，（2）指明当事人和财产，以及（3）由赠与人签署。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Wills & Other Donative Transfers § 6.3 (Am. Law Inst. 2003) (gifts of land subject to statute of frauds).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Adverse Possession

核心考点 (Key Principle) 一旦时效占有（Adverse Possession）的法定时间届满，占有人即自动获得完整的所有权 (Legal Title)。此后，要将土地归还给原所有者，必须遵守反欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds)，即必须通过书面契约转让。
1 所有权何时转移？

题目指出该司法管辖区的时效期为 10 年。该女子在 19 年前进入农场，且其占有符合时效占有的所有要素。

这意味着，在 9 年前（19 - 10 = 9），该女子已经获得了农场的法律所有权 (Legal Title)。此时，原来的“土地记录所有者”（该男子）的所有权已被依法剥夺。

2 口头放弃有效吗？

这是本题最大的陷阱。该女子后来感到愧疚，口头告诉男子她放弃权利。但在法律上，她此时已经是“所有者”。

根据反欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds)，不动产权益的转让必须通过签署的书面文件 (Signed Writing) 进行。仅仅是口头道歉或口头放弃 (Oral Waiver) 是无效的。

✘ 选项 A 错误：因为没有书面契约，所有权并没有回流给该男子。
3 邻居是否获得了所有权？

邻居强行驱逐了该女子并占有了 3 年。虽然邻居的行为是敌对的，但时间太短（仅 3 年，未满 10 年）。

此外，邻居不能利用该女子的占有时间来凑够 10 年（即所谓的 Tacking / 叠加），因为 Tacking 需要占有人之间存在关联关系 (Privity)（如买卖、继承）。邻居是强行驱逐 (Ouster)，不存在 Privity。

✘ 选项 B 错误：邻居既没有 Privity，也没有占有足够的时间。
4 确认产权诉讼是必须的吗？

虽然该女子获得的头衔是“不可通过记录查询的” (Unmarketable title)，但这并不影响她拥有“法律所有权” (Legal Title)。

她可以提起确认产权诉讼 (Quiet Title Action) 来使产权变得可市场化 (Marketable)，但这并不是她转让财产的先决条件。她完全可以签署契约将她拥有的权益转让给儿子，只是儿子得到的也是一个有产权瑕疵风险的头衔，但这不影响所有权的转移本身。

✘ 选项 D 错误：诉讼不是转让所有权的必要条件。
5 结论

该女子是合法所有者。她的口头放弃无效。她签署契约将农场转让给儿子，该契约有效。因此，儿子 (The Son) 现在拥有农场。

正确答案：C

MBE Property Law Tip: Always check if the statutory period has already run. If yes, title has shifted!

questions.question:
The builder of a new house sold the house to a buyer, conveying it to the buyer by warranty deed. One year later, the buyer sold the house to a woman for $50,000 more than the buyer had paid, conveying it to the woman by a quitclaim deed.
Four months after moving in, the woman discovered a number of latent defects in the foundation that caused the house's basement to take on water during heavy rains. The woman contacted the builder about the problem. Toward the end of their heated conversation, the builder yelled at her, "So get it fixed!"
After the woman had the foundation repaired by a cement contractor at a cost of $25,000, she successfully sued the builder to recover that amount from him.
What is the most likely reason that the woman was successful?

choices.a: The court found an implied warranty of habitability from the builder to the buyer that was enforceable by a subsequent buyer.
choices.b: The court found that by paying the buyer $50,000 more for the house than the buyer had paid the builder, the woman did not get the benefit of her bargain.
choices.c: The court found that by yelling at the woman to "get it fixed," the builder had committed himself to paying for the repair.
choices.d: The court found that the defects in the foundation were a breach of the covenant of further assurances in the warranty deed from the builder to the buyer.

data.questionStem:
Q86815 The builder of a new house sold the house to a buyer, conveying it to the buyer by warranty deed. One year later, the buyer sold the house to a woman for $50,000 more than the buyer had paid, conveying it to the woman by a quitclaim deed.

Four months after moving in, the woman discovered a number of latent defects in the foundation that caused the house's basement to take on water during heavy rains. The woman contacted the builder about the problem. Toward the end of their heated conversation, the builder yelled at her, "So get it fixed!"

After the woman had the foundation repaired by a cement contractor at a cost of $25,000, she successfully sued the builder to recover that amount from him.

What is the most likely reason that the woman was successful? 一栋新房的建造商将房屋出售给了一位买方，并通过担保契约将房屋转让给该买方。一年后，该买方以比其支付价高出50,000美元的价格将房屋出售给了一名女子，并通过免责契约将房屋转让给她。

搬入四个月后，该女子发现地基存在多处潜在缺陷，导致房屋地下室在暴雨期间进水。该女子就此问题联系了建造商。在他们激烈的交谈快结束时，建造商对她大喊：“那就去修好它！”

在该女子花费25,000美元请水泥承包商修复地基后，她成功起诉建造商，要求其赔偿该笔费用。

该女子胜诉最可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. The court found an implied warranty of habitability from the builder to the buyer that was enforceable by a subsequent buyer.
法院认定，建造商对买方存在一项可居住性默示担保，且该担保可由后续买方强制执行。

B. The court found that by paying the buyer $50,000 more for the house than the buyer had paid the builder, the woman did not get the benefit of her bargain.
法院认定，由于该女子为房屋支付的价比买方向建造商支付的价高出50,000美元，她没有获得其交易的预期利益。

C. The court found that by yelling at the woman to "get it fixed," the builder had committed himself to paying for the repair.
法院认定，建造商对该女子大喊“去修好它”，即表示他已承诺支付维修费用。

D. The court found that the defects in the foundation were a breach of the covenant of further assurances in the warranty deed from the builder to the buyer.
法院认定，地基的缺陷违反了建造商向买方出具的担保契约中的进一步保证条款。
data.explanation:
Implied warranty of habitability

(ie, implied warranty of fitness or suitability, quality, workmanlike construction)

Implied promise by builder, developer, or other commercial seller of new house that house was built in reasonably workmanlike manner & is suitable for living

Builder, developer, or other commercial seller liable for defects that interfere with buyer's ability to live in home

Buyer's damages based on cost of repairs to bring house into compliance with warranty

Under the implied warranty of habitability (ie, implied warranty of fitness or suitability), the builder of a new home impliedly guarantees that the home is habitable and fit for its intended purposes when sold. This allows buyers to recover damages for losses caused by the builder's defective construction or poor workmanship. And in most jurisdictions, this warranty extends to subsequent purchasers as to latent construction defects.

Here, the buyer purchased a new home from the builder and later sold it to the woman. After moving in, the woman discovered latent defects in the foundation that caused the house's basement to take on water during heavy rains (habitability concerns). Therefore, the most likely reason that the woman was successful against the builder is that the court found an implied warranty of habitability that was enforceable by her (a subsequent buyer).

(Choice B) Damages for breach of the implied warranty of habitability are based on the cost of repairs to bring the home into compliance with the warranty. Therefore, the additional $50,000 the woman paid to the buyer for the home does not affect her ability to recover $25,000 in repair costs from the builder for breach of this warranty.

(Choice C) The builder did not commit to paying for the repair by telling the woman to "get it fixed." Instead, he must pay for the repair because he is liable for latent construction defects under the implied warranty of habitability.

(Choice D) A warranty deed contains certain covenants of title, including the covenant of further assurances—ie, the grantor's promise to take any actions reasonably necessary to cure defects in title. But since defects in the foundation affect the physical condition (not title) of the property, this covenant does not apply.

Educational objective: The implied warranty of habitability guarantees that a new home is habitable and fit for its intended purposes. This allows buyers to recover for losses caused by poor workmanship and, in most jurisdictions, allows subsequent purchasers to recover for losses caused by latent construction defects.

可居住性默示担保

（即，适用性或适宜性、质量、工艺精良施工的默示担保）

由新房的建造商、开发商或其他商业销售商作出的默示承诺，保证房屋以合理的精良工艺建造且适合居住

建造商、开发商或其他商业销售商对妨碍买方居住的缺陷承担责任

买方的损害赔偿基于为使房屋符合担保标准所需的维修费用

根据可居住性默示担保（即，适用性或适宜性默示担保），新房的建造商默示保证房屋在出售时是可居住的且适合其预期用途。这使得买方能够就因建造商的有缺陷的施工或劣质工艺所造成的损失获得赔偿。并且，在大多数司法管辖区，此担保延伸至后续购买者，涵盖潜在的建筑缺陷。

在本案中，买方从建造商处购买了一栋新房，之后将其出售给该女子。搬入后，该女子发现了地基中的潜在缺陷，导致房屋地下室在暴雨时进水（涉及可居住性问题）。因此，该女子对建造商胜诉最可能的原因是，法院认定存在一项可居住性默示担保，且她（作为后续购买者）可以强制执行该担保。

（选项B）违反可居住性默示担保的损害赔偿基于使房屋符合担保标准所需的维修费用。因此，该女子向买方多支付的50,000美元购房款，并不影响她因建造商违反此担保而向其追偿25,000美元维修费用的能力。

（选项C）建造商告诉该女子“去修好它”，并不构成他承诺支付维修费用。相反，他必须支付维修费用是因为根据可居住性默示担保，他需对潜在的建筑缺陷负责。

（选项D）担保契约包含某些产权保证条款，其中包括进一步保证的条款——即，转让人承诺采取任何合理必要的行动来纠正产权瑕疵。但由于地基的缺陷影响的是房产的物理状况（而非产权），因此该条款不适用。

教学目的： 可居住性默示担保保证了新房是可居住的且适合其预期用途。这使得买方能够就因劣质工艺造成的损失获得赔偿，并且在大多数司法管辖区，允许后续购买者就因潜在建筑缺陷造成的损失获得赔偿。

References
13 Am. Jur. 2d Building and Construction Contracts § 10 (2018) (duties implied by law).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：不动产法

Real Property: Implied Warranties

核心考点：可居住性默示担保 Implied Warranty of Habitability / Fitness

在普通法传统规则（买者自负 Caveat Emptor）下，房屋销售通常没有担保。但现代法律对新房建造商设立了例外：

  • 适用对象：新房的建造商或商业开发商。
  • 担保内容：房屋施工工艺精良，且适合居住。
  • 关键延伸：该担保通常延伸至后续买方 (Subsequent Purchasers)，只要在合理期限内发现潜在缺陷。
本题逻辑链条分析

1. 建造商身份：被告是新房建造商 (Builder of a new house)，属于该担保的责任主体。

2. 缺陷性质：地基缺陷导致进水，属于严重的潜在缺陷 (Latent Defects)，且影响居住 (Habitability)。

3. 原告身份：原告是二手买家 (Subsequent Buyer)。虽然她与建造商之间没有直接合同关系 (Privity of Contract)，但现代法院倾向于保护后续买家，因为建造商处于控制建筑质量的最佳位置。

4. 契约类型无关性：虽然原告是通过“免责契约” (Quitclaim Deed) 买房，但这只免除了中间卖家的产权担保责任，并不切断建造商对房屋物理质量的法定担保责任。

选项深度解析
选项 A (正确答案)
法院认定存在可居住性默示担保，且该担保可由后续买方强制执行。

理由：这是现代不动产法的多数规则。对于潜在的建筑缺陷，建造商的责任不因房屋转手而消失。
选项 B (错误)
关于“交易预期利益” (Benefit of Bargain)。

理由：买贵了或者买便宜了，与建造商是否违约无关。损害赔偿是基于修复成本，而非买卖差价。
选项 C (错误)
关于“口头承诺”。

理由：建造商气急败坏喊出的 "Get it fixed" 缺乏合同成立的意图 (Intent)，不足以构成新的有约束力的口头合同。
选项 D (错误 - 常见陷阱)
关于“进一步保证条款” (Covenant of Further Assurances)。

理由：这是产权担保 (Title Covenant) 的一部分，用于解决产权瑕疵（如签字遗漏、文件错误），不适用于房屋的物理状况或建筑质量。
💡 MBE 抢分技巧

区分“产权”与“质量”：

看到题目中出现 Warranty Deed 或 Quitclaim Deed 时，首先判断题目考的是产权归属/瑕疵 (Title Issues) 还是房屋物理缺陷 (Physical Defects)。

  • 如果是物理缺陷（如本题的地基、漏水），通常适用 Implied Warranty of Habitability，Deed 的类型通常是干扰项。
  • 如果是产权纠纷（如抵押权未清除），才需要分析 Deed 中的 Covenants。

questions.question:
A seller who owned land entered into a valid written agreement to sell the land to a buyer by installment purchase. The contract stipulated that the seller would deliver to the buyer, upon payment of the last installment due, "a warranty deed sufficient to convey a fee simple title." The contract contained no other provision that could be construed as referring to title.
The buyer entered into possession of the land. After making 10 of the 300 installment payments obligated under the contract, the buyer discovered that there was outstanding a valid and enforceable mortgage on the land, securing the payment of a debt in the amount of 25 percent of the purchase price that the buyer had agreed to pay. There was no evidence that the seller had ever been late in payments due under the mortgage, and there was no evidence of any danger of insolvency of the seller. The value of the land was then four times the amount due on the debt secured by the mortgage.
The buyer quit possession of the land, stopped making payments on the contract, and demanded that the seller repay the amounts that the buyer had paid under the contract. After the seller refused the demand, the buyer sued the seller to recover damages for the seller's alleged breach of the contract.
Should damages be awarded to the buyer?

choices.a: No, because an installment purchase contract is treated as a security device.
choices.b: No, because the time for the seller to deliver marketable title has not arrived.
choices.c: Yes, because an installment purchase contract is treated as a mortgage, and the outstanding mortgage impairs the buyer's equity of redemption.
choices.d: Yes, because in the absence of a contrary express agreement, an obligation to convey marketable title is implied.

data.questionStem:
Q86144

A seller who owned land entered into a valid written agreement to sell the land to a buyer by installment purchase. The contract stipulated that the seller would deliver to the buyer, upon payment of the last installment due, "a warranty deed sufficient to convey a fee simple title." The contract contained no other provision that could be construed as referring to title.

The buyer entered into possession of the land. After making 10 of the 300 installment payments obligated under the contract, the buyer discovered that there was outstanding a valid and enforceable mortgage on the land, securing the payment of a debt in the amount of 25 percent of the purchase price that the buyer had agreed to pay. There was no evidence that the seller had ever been late in payments due under the mortgage, and there was no evidence of any danger of insolvency of the seller. The value of the land was then four times the amount due on the debt secured by the mortgage.

The buyer quit possession of the land, stopped making payments on the contract, and demanded that the seller repay the amounts that the buyer had paid under the contract. After the seller refused the demand, the buyer sued the seller to recover damages for the seller's alleged breach of the contract.

Should damages be awarded to the buyer?

一位拥有土地的卖方与一位买方签订了一份有效的书面协议，以分期付款购买的方式向其出售该土地。合同规定，卖方应在买方付清最后一期应付款项后，向买方交付“一份足以转让完全所有权（fee simple title）的产权保证书（warranty deed）”。合同中没有其他可被解释为与所有权相关的条款。

买方占有了该土地。在支付了合同规定的300期分期付款中的10期后，买方发现该土地上存在一笔有效且可强制执行的抵押，该抵押担保了一笔债务的偿还，债务金额为买方同意支付的购买价格的25%。没有证据表明卖方曾延迟支付抵押贷款的到期款项，也没有证据表明卖方有任何破产的风险。当时该土地的价值是抵押所担保债务到期金额的四倍。

买方放弃了对土地的占有，停止支付合同款项，并要求卖方退还买方根据合同已支付的款项。在卖方拒绝该要求后，买方起诉卖方，以卖方涉嫌违约为由要求损害赔偿。

买方应否获得损害赔偿？
options:
A. No, because an installment purchase contract is treated as a security device.
不应，因为分期付款购买合同被视为一种担保工具。

B. No, because the time for the seller to deliver marketable title has not arrived.
不应，因为卖方交付可售所有权（marketable title）的时间尚未到来。

C. Yes, because an installment purchase contract is treated as a mortgage, and the outstanding mortgage impairs the buyer's equity of redemption.
是的，因为分期付款购买合同被视为一种抵押，而未偿还的抵押损害了买方的赎回权（equity of redemption）。

D. Yes, because in the absence of a contrary express agreement, an obligation to convey marketable title is implied.
是的，因为在没有相反明确约定的情况下，转让可售所有权（marketable title）的义务是默示的。
data.explanation:
"Red flags" for marketable title


Covenants
Easements
Leases
Liens
Gaps in chain of title
Boundary disputes
Existing zoning violations
Adverse possession
All land-sale contracts have an implied warranty that the seller will convey marketable title to the buyer upon closing unless otherwise stated. Title does not have to be perfect to be marketable. However, it must be reasonably free from doubt and under no threat of litigation, such that a reasonable person would accept and pay for it. In the case of an installment land contract - ie, one in which the buyer takes possession of the property and pays the purchase price over time - the seller need not deliver marketable title until the price is fully paid.

Here, after making 10 of the 300 installment payments, the buyer discovered that there was an outstanding mortgage on the land. Although an existing mortgage can render title unmarketable, the seller does not need to deliver marketable title until the buyer has made all installment payments. Therefore, damages should not be awarded to the buyer because the time for the seller to deliver marketable title has not arrived (Choice D).

(Choice A) The fact that an installment land contract is treated as a security device (namely, a mortgage) does not prevent the buyer from recovering damages if the seller is unable to deliver marketable title when it is due (not seen here).

(Choice C) An installment land contract is often treated as a mortgage, so the seller can bring a foreclosure action to regain possession of the property if the buyer defaults on payments. Although the buyer stopped making payments here, the seller has not yet attempted to enforce the contract. As a result, the buyer's equity of redemption (ie, pre-foreclosure right to cure the default by paying the entire past-due amount) is not at issue.

Educational objective: Under an installment land contract, the seller does not need to deliver marketable title until the purchase price is fully paid.



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 81%（正确选项），C选项 6%，D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

可售所有权（marketable title）的“危险信号”


契约
地役权
租赁
留置权
产权链中的空白
边界争议
现有的区划违规
侵权逆占
除非另有规定，否则所有土地销售合同都包含一项默示担保，即卖方将在交易完成时向买方转让可售所有权（marketable title）。所有权不必是完美的才算可售。但是，它必须合理地无疑问，且不受诉讼威胁，以至于一个理性人会接受并为此付款。在分期付款土地合同的情况下——即买方占有财产并随时间支付购买价款的合同——卖方无需交付可售所有权，直到价款完全付清。

在本案中，在支付了300期分期付款中的10期后，买方发现该土地上存在一笔未偿还的抵押。尽管现有的抵押可能导致所有权不可售，但卖方无需交付可售所有权，直到买方付清所有分期款项。因此，不应向买方判给损害赔偿，因为卖方交付可售所有权的时间尚未到来（选项D）。

（选项A）分期付款土地合同被视为一种担保工具（即抵押）这一事实，并不妨碍在卖方到期无法交付可售所有权时，买方获得损害赔偿（本案情况并非如此）。

（选项C）分期付款土地合同通常被视为一种抵押，因此如果买方拖欠付款，卖方可以提起止赎诉讼以收回财产占有。尽管本案中买方停止了付款，但卖方尚未试图强制执行合同。因此，买方的赎回权（即在止赎前通过支付全部逾期款项来补救违约的权利）在此不成问题。

教学目的：根据分期付款土地合同，卖方无需交付可售所有权，直到购买价款完全付清为止。



References

  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 3.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (installment land contracts).
  • 77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 93 (2020) (marketable title).

MBE 考点解析

Real Estate Contracts / Marketable Title

核心法律原则：交付时间 在分期付款土地合同 (Installment Land Contract) 中，卖方交付可售所有权 (Marketable Title) 的义务，通常只有在买方支付完最后一笔款项时才产生，而不是在合同签订时。

合同签订 (Day 1)

买方开始占有土地，卖方保留法定所有权 (Legal Title)。

第 10 期付款 (现状)

买方发现抵押贷款。关键点：此时卖方尚无义务交付无瑕疵产权。

第 300 期付款 (未来)

交付日 (Law Day)：这是卖方必须清除抵押并交付产权保证书的时刻。

案情深度分析

本题考察的是“预期违约”与“履行时间”的界限。

1. 现状并非违约： 只要卖方在最后交割日（第300期付款时）能提供可售所有权，中间存在的抵押并不构成违约。卖方完全有权利用买方的分期付款来偿还自己的抵押贷款。

2. 无破产风险： 题目特意指出卖方没有破产风险 (insolvency) 且土地价值远高于债务。这意味着卖方有能力在未来清除产权瑕疵。

3. 买方反应过度： 买方在第10期就要求退款并起诉，属于过早行动。因为卖方交付产权的时间（Time for performance）尚未到来。

✅ 正确答案：B
不应赔偿，因为卖方交付可售所有权的时间尚未到来。

关于选项 D 的误区：
虽然合同确实默示了“可售所有权”的义务（选项D的前半部分正确），但该选项忽略了时间要素。默示义务是存在的，但它只有在合同约定的交付时间（即付清全款时）才需要被履行。

💡 MBE 考试技巧
遇到 Installment Land Contract 的题目时，请记住：
  • 这不同于普通的房屋买卖（Closing通常在30-60天）。
  • 分期合同可能持续数十年。
  • 只要卖方不是“无可救药地破产”或存在欺诈，买方通常不能因为中间存在的留置权（Lien）或抵押（Mortgage）而解除合同，因为卖方有权在最后一刻“修补”产权。

questions.question:
A buyer validly contracted in writing to buy improved land from a seller. The contract had no contingencies and was silent as to risk of loss if there was damage to, or destruction of, property improvements between contract and closing, and as to any duty to carry insurance. As soon as the parties signed the contract, the seller (who had already moved out) canceled her insurance covering the land. The buyer did not know this and did not obtain insurance. A few days later, three weeks before the agreed closing date, the building on the land was struck by lightning and burned to the ground.
There is no applicable statute.
In an appropriate action, the buyer asserted the right to cancel the contract and to recover his earnest money. The seller said that because the risk of fire loss had passed to the buyer before the fire, the buyer must perform.
If the seller prevails, what will be the most likely explanation?

choices.a: Once the parties signed the contract, only the buyer had an insurable interest and so could have protected against this loss.
choices.b: The buyer's constructive possession arising from the contract gave him the affirmative duty of protecting against loss by fire.
choices.c: The seller's cancellation of her casualty insurance caused the risk of loss to transfer to the buyer.
choices.d: Upon execution of the contract, the buyer became the equitable owner of the land under the doctrine of equitable conversion.

买方与卖方签订了一份有效的书面合同，购买一块已改良的土地。该合同没有附带任何意外事件条款，并且对于合同签订日至交割日期间，若财产改良物受损或被毁的损失风险，以及购买保险的义务，均未作规定。合同一经双方签署，卖方（其已搬离）便取消了该土地的保险。买方对此并不知情，也未购买保险。几天后，在约定的交割日期前三周，该土地上的建筑物被闪电击中，并被夷为平地。

本案没有适用的成文法。

在适当的诉讼中，买方主张有权解除合同并要求返还其定金。卖方称，由于火灾损失的风险在火灾发生前已转移给买方，因此买方必须履行合同。

如果卖方胜诉，最可能的解释是什么？
options:
A. Once the parties signed the contract, only the buyer had an insurable interest and so could have protected against this loss.
一旦双方签订合同，只有买方拥有可保利益，因此本可以投保以防范此项损失。

B. The buyer's constructive possession arising from the contract gave him the affirmative duty of protecting against loss by fire.
由合同产生的买方的推定占有，使其负有防止火灾损失的积极义务。

C. The seller's cancellation of her casualty insurance caused the risk of loss to transfer to the buyer.
卖方取消其灾害保险的行为，导致损失风险转移给了买方。

D. Upon execution of the contract, the buyer became the equitable owner of the land under the doctrine of equitable conversion.
合同一经签署，根据衡平法转换原则 (doctrine of equitable conversion)，买方即成为该土地的衡平法上的所有权人。
data.explanation:
A majority of jurisdictions apply the doctrine of equitable conversion when a land-sale contract is silent regarding the risk of loss (as seen here). Under this doctrine, the risk of loss is placed on the party with equitable title at the time the property was destroyed. The buyer receives equitable title once the contract is formed and can be specifically enforced. If no conditions/contingencies appear in the contract (eg, a condition that the buyer secure financing before closing), the contract is specifically enforceable as soon as it is formed. Therefore, the seller likely prevailed because the buyer was the equitable owner of the land when the building was destroyed.

(Choices A, B & C) Unless otherwise provided, a land-sale contract does not impose a duty on either the seller or the buyer to carry property insurance. Therefore, neither the signing of the contract nor the seller's cancellation of the insurance transferred the risk of loss to the buyer.

Educational objective: Unless otherwise provided, the doctrine of equitable conversion places the risk of loss on the buyer once the land-sale contract is formed and can be specifically enforced.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 7%，C选项 3%，D选项 84%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当土地买卖合同对损失风险未作规定时（如本案所示），大多数司法管辖区会适用衡平法转换原则 (equitable conversion)。根据此原则，损失风险由财产被毁时拥有衡平法上所有权的一方承担。买方在合同成立且可被强制履行时，即获得衡平法上的所有权。如果合同中没有出现条件/意外事件条款（例如，买方在交割前获得融资的条件），则合同一经成立即可被强制履行。因此，卖方很可能胜诉，因为在建筑物被毁时，买方是该土地的衡平法上的所有权人。

（选项 A, B & C）除非另有规定，土地买卖合同不为卖方或买方设定购买财产保险的义务。因此，无论是合同的签署还是卖方取消保险的行为，都未将损失风险转移给买方。

教学目的：除非另有规定，衡平法转换原则 (doctrine of equitable conversion) 将损失风险置于买方身上，前提是土地买卖合同已成立且可被强制履行。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Risk of Loss
核心考点：衡平法转换原则 (Doctrine of Equitable Conversion)

这是普通法（Common Law）中的一项重要原则。其核心思想是：一旦双方签订了可强制执行（Specifically Enforceable）的土地买卖合同，衡平法将视“应做之事为已做之事”（Equity regards as done that which ought to be done）。

合同签署 (Contract Signed)
此时发生所有权分离：
1. 买方获得衡平法所有权 (Equitable Title)
2. 卖方保留法定所有权 (Legal Title) 作为收款担保
风险转移 (Risk of Loss)
根据普通法，损失风险随衡平法所有权转移。因此，买方承担房屋损毁的风险。
交割 (Closing)
法定所有权最终转移给买方。

为什么选项 D 是正确的？

正确答案 D

解析：题目明确指出“没有适用的成文法”（There is no applicable statute）。这意味着我们必须适用普通法规则。

根据衡平法转换原则，只要合同没有意外事件条款（Contingencies）且可强制执行，买方在签字那一刻就成为了土地的衡平法所有权人 (Equitable Owner)。

因此，即使卖方还持有法定地契（Legal Title），房屋被闪电击毁的风险（Risk of Loss）已经转移给了买方。买方必须履行合同支付全款，尽管房子已经没了。

其他选项为什么错误？

选项 A 错误

可保利益 (Insurable Interest)： 双方都有可保利益。卖方有法定所有权，买方有衡平法所有权。并不是“只有”买方可以投保。

选项 B 错误

占有 (Possession)： 风险转移的依据是所有权 (Title) 的性质，而不是占有。即使买方还没有搬进去（没有占有），根据普通法，风险依然转移了。

选项 C 错误

保险义务： 除非合同另有规定，普通法下卖方没有义务为买方的利益维持保险。卖方取消保险的行为虽然冷酷，但在法律上并没有改变风险承担的规则。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧：

注意题目中的关键词 "There is no applicable statute"。

在现实生活中，许多州采用了《统一卖方与买方风险法》(Uniform Vendor and Purchaser Risk Act, UVPRA)，该法规定风险在交付占有或转移法定所有权时才转移。

但 MBE 题目如果排除了成文法，就是在考你古老的普通法规则 (Common Law Rule)：签字即转移风险。

questions.question:
A man owned a residential lot improved with a dwelling and conveyed it for a valuable consideration to a buyer. The dwelling had been constructed by a prior owner. The buyer had inspected the dwelling prior to the purchase and discovered no defects. After moving in, the buyer became aware that sewage seeped into the basement when the toilets were flushed. The man said that this defect had been present for years and that he had taken no steps to hide this fact from the buyer. The buyer paid for the necessary repairs and brought an appropriate action against the man to recover his cost of repair.
If the buyer wins, what will be the likely reason?

choices.a: The buyer made a proper inspection.
choices.b: The man breached the implied warranty of habitability and fitness for purpose.
choices.c: The man failed to disclose a latent defect.
choices.d: The situation constitutes a health hazard.

The buyer had inspected the dwelling prior to the purchase and discovered no defects. After moving in, the buyer became aware that sewage seeped into the basement when the toilets were flushed. The man said that this defect had been present for years and that he had taken no steps to hide this fact from the buyer. The buyer paid for the necessary repairs and brought an appropriate action against the man to recover his cost of repair.

If the buyer wins, what will be the likely reason?

一名男子拥有一块建有住宅的住宅用地，并以有价对价将其转让给了一位买方。该住宅由前一任所有者建造。买方在购买前检查了该住宅，并未发现任何瑕疵。搬入后，买方发现冲马桶时，污水会渗入地下室。该男子称，此瑕疵已存在多年，且他未采取任何措施向买方隐瞒这一事实。买方支付了必要的维修费用，并对该男子提起了适当的诉讼，以追回其维修成本。

如果买方胜诉，最可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. The buyer made a proper inspection.
买方进行了适当的检查。

B. The man breached the implied warranty of habitability and fitness for purpose.
该男子违反了默示的可居住性与适用性保证。

C. The man failed to disclose a latent defect.
该男子未能披露一个潜在瑕疵。

D. The situation constitutes a health hazard.
该情况构成了健康危害。
data.explanation:
Seller's duty to disclose


Common law (minority) ruleModern (majority) rule
Caveat emptor
No duty to disclose property defects unless otherwise provided		Commercial property
Must disclose known material defects that buyer could not reasonably discover
Residential property
Exception: "as is" clause or specific disclaimers without seller's fraud
The majority of jurisdictions impose a duty on sellers of residential property to disclose any material defects that are known to the seller and cannot be reasonably discovered by the buyer. A defect is material if it:

  • substantially affects the value of the residence
  • impacts the health or safety of a resident or affects the desirability of the residence to the buyer.


Here, the man admitted that he had known for years that sewage seeped into the basement when the toilets were flushed. This clearly material defect could not be, and was not, reasonably discovered by the buyer after inspecting the dwelling. Therefore, the buyer will likely win because the man breached his duty to disclose this latent defect.

(Choice A) A proper or reasonable inspection may not unearth every defect with a property. As a result, the duty to disclose defects that are not readily discoverable applies even when a buyer conducts an inspection.

(Choice B) The warranty of habitability and fitness† is implied in almost all jurisdictions in a contract for the sale of a newly constructed residence, so it does not apply here.

†This is also referred to as the implied warranty of suitability, quality, or workmanlike construction.

(Choice D) The mere fact that the defect in question poses a health hazard is not enough to impose liability on the seller. For example, the man would not be liable for the hazardous defect if he had been unaware of the defect or if he had included an "as is" clause to disclaim the duty to disclose.

Educational objective: A seller of residential property has a duty to disclose any known material defects that cannot be reasonably discovered by the buyer.

选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 14%，C选项 79%（正确选项），D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

卖方的披露义务


普通法（少数派）规则现代（多数派）规则
Caveat emptor (买方自慎)
除非另有规定，否则没有披露财产瑕疵的义务		商业地产
必须披露买方无法合理发现的已知重大瑕疵
住宅地产
例外：“按现状”条款或在卖方没有欺诈情况下的特定免责声明
大多数司法管辖区要求住宅地产的卖方有义务披露任何卖方已知且买方无法合理发现的重大瑕疵。如果一个瑕疵符合以下条件，则被视为重大瑕疵：

  • 严重影响住宅的价值
  • 影响居民的健康或安全或影响住宅对买方的合意性。


在本案中，该男子承认他多年来一直知道冲马桶时污水会渗入地下室。这一明显的重大瑕疵，买方在检查住宅后无法也未能合理地发现。因此，买方很可能会胜诉，因为该男子违反了他披露此潜在瑕疵的义务。

(选项A) 一次适当或合理的检查可能无法发现房产的所有瑕疵。因此，即使买方进行了检查，披露那些不易发现的瑕疵的义务仍然适用。

(选项B) 可居住性与适用性保证†在几乎所有司法管辖区都是在新建住宅的销售合同中默示的，因此不适用于本案。

†这也被称为默示的适宜性、质量或工艺精良保证。

(选项D) 所涉瑕疵构成健康危害这一事实本身，不足以让卖方承担责任。例如，如果该男子不知道该瑕疵，或者他在合同中加入了“按现状”条款以豁免披露义务，那么他将不对该危险瑕疵负责。

教学目标：住宅地产的卖方有义务披露任何买方无法合理发现的已知重大瑕疵。

MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Contracts
正确答案：C 该男子未能披露一个潜在瑕疵。
(The man failed to disclose a latent defect.)
核心考点：卖方的披露义务

本题考察的是住宅房地产销售中，卖方对房屋瑕疵的披露责任。在现代法律规则下，这一领域发生了从“买者自慎”到“强制披露”的转变。

传统普通法
(Common Law)		 现代多数派规则
(Modern Majority Rule)
Caveat Emptor
(买者自慎)		 披露义务
(Duty to Disclose)
卖方无义务披露瑕疵，除非存在积极隐瞒或欺诈。 卖方必须披露已知的、重大的、且买方无法合理发现的潜在瑕疵。
本案逻辑推理

要让买方胜诉，必须满足现代规则下的三个要素：

  1. 已知 (Known): 题目明确指出卖方知道该问题已存在多年。
  2. 重大 (Material): 污水渗入地下室属于严重的卫生和结构问题，显然是重大瑕疵。
  3. 潜在/不易发现 (Latent/Not reasonably discoverable): 题目指出买方进行了检查但未发现（因为只有冲水时才发生，且可能需要特定条件），这属于潜在瑕疵 (Latent Defect)。

结论： 尽管卖方没有积极隐瞒（Active Concealment），但在现代规则下，他对已知的潜在重大瑕疵保持沉默（Silence）本身就构成了违约或欺诈性不披露。

为什么其他选项是错误的？

❌ 选项 A：买方进行了适当检查
虽然买方进行了检查，但这只是证明瑕疵是“潜在的”一个前提条件。买方胜诉的法律依据是卖方“未披露”，而不是买方“已检查”。

❌ 选项 B：默示的可居住性保证 (Implied Warranty of Habitability)
这是本题最大的陷阱。
该保证通常只适用于新房销售（由建筑商/开发商出售给第一任买家）。本题中，房屋是由“前任所有者”建造的，且卖方只是普通房主（二手房交易），因此不适用此默示保证。

❌ 选项 D：构成健康危害
“健康危害”说明了瑕疵的重大性 (Materiality)，但仅有危害本身并不足以让卖方承担责任。如果卖方自己也不知道这个危害，或者买方很容易就能发现这个危害，卖方可能就不承担责任。责任的来源是“知情不报”。

💡 MBE 备考锦囊 遇到二手房交易的瑕疵问题时，请按以下步骤思考：
  1. 是谁在卖？ 如果是建筑商(Builder-Vendor)，优先考虑“默示可居住性保证”。如果是普通二手房主，该保证通常不适用。
  2. 瑕疵是否明显？ 如果是显性瑕疵(Patent Defect)，买方有义务自己发现。如果是潜在瑕疵(Latent Defect)，看卖方是否知情。
  3. 卖方是否知情？ 现代规则要求披露已知的潜在重大瑕疵。

questions.question:
A grantor executed an instrument in the proper form of a warranty deed purporting to convey a tract of land to his church. The granting clause of the instrument ran to the church "and its successors forever, so long as the premises are used for church purposes." The church took possession of the land and used it as its site of worship for many years. Subsequently, the church decided to relocate and entered into a valid written contract to sell the land to a buyer for a substantial price. The buyer wanted to use the land as a site for business activities and objected to the church's title. The contract contained no provision relating to the quality of title the church was bound to convey.
There is no applicable statute.
When the buyer refused to close, the church sued the buyer for specific performance and properly joined the grantor as a party.
Is the church likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the grantor's interest prevents the church's title from being marketable.
choices.b: No, because the quoted provision is a valid restrictive covenant.
choices.c: Yes, because a charitable trust to support religion will attach to the proceeds of the sale.
choices.d: Yes, because the grantor cannot derogate from his warranty to the church.

Is the church likely to prevail?

一位出让人以担保契据的适当形式签署了一份文书，意图将其一片土地转让给其教会。该文书的授予条款规定，土地授予教会“及其永久继承人，只要该处所被用于教会目的”。教会占有了该土地，并多年将其用作礼拜场所。后来，教会决定搬迁，并签订了一份有效的书面合同，以可观的价格将该土地出售给一位买方。买方希望将该土地用作商业活动场所，并对教会的产权提出了异议。合同中没有包含关于教会必须转让的产权质量的条款。

没有适用的成文法。

当买方拒绝完成交易时，教会起诉买方要求强制履行，并适当地将出让人列为当事人。

教会可能胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the grantor's interest prevents the church's title from being marketable.
不会，因为出让人的权益使得教会的产权不具可售性。

B. No, because the quoted provision is a valid restrictive covenant.
不会，因为所引用的条款是一个有效的限制性契约。

C. Yes, because a charitable trust to support religion will attach to the proceeds of the sale.
会，因为支持宗教的慈善信托将附加于销售收益上。

D. Yes, because the grantor cannot derogate from his warranty to the church.
会，因为出让人不能减损其对教会的担保。
data.explanation:
Fee simple estates


TypeLanguageFuture interest
IndefeasibleFee simple absolute
"To A""To A and his heirs"		None
Defeasible (Durational)Fee simple determinable
"so long as" "during" "until"		Grantor's possibility of reverter
Third party's executory interest (ie, fee simple subject to executory limitation)
Defeasible (Conditional)Fee simple subject to condition subsequent
"but if" "provided that" "unless"		Grantor's right of entry
In a land-sale contract, the seller promises to deliver marketable title to the buyer upon closing. Title is marketable if it is reasonably free from doubt and under no threat of litigation such that a reasonable person would accept and pay for it. If the seller fails to satisfy this promise, the buyer can rescind the contract and refuse to close.

Here, the church has a defeasible fee because its title will automatically terminate if the specified event or condition occurs - ie, when the land is no longer used for church purposes. If the buyer were to purchase the land and use it for business purposes, the specified event would occur. The buyer's title would then terminate and revert back to the grantor. As a result, the church cannot deliver marketable title and its suit against the buyer will likely fail.

(Choice B) A restrictive covenant is a promise to do or not do something on one's land that has no impact on title. Since the quoted provision will divest the church (or its assigns) of title if the land is no longer used for church purposes, it is not a restrictive covenant but a defeasible fee.

(Choice C) Attaching the sale proceeds to a charitable trust will have no impact on the church's ability to convey marketable title. This merely means that a trustee will hold those proceeds at the church's request for some charitable purpose and title will still terminate if the specified condition occurs.

(Choice D) The grantor cannot and has not derogated any warranty (ie, covenant of title) to the church. He had the right to convey the church a defeasible fee and the right to retain a possibility of reverter in that land.

Educational objective: Marketable title is title that is reasonably free from doubt and under no threat of litigation such that a reasonable person would accept and pay for it. The owner of a defeasible fee cannot convey marketable title since title will automatically terminate upon the happening of a specified event or condition.

选项正确率统计：A选项 71%（正确选项），B选项 22%，C选项 2%，D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

可继承的完全所有权地产 (Fee simple estates)


类型措辞未来权益
不可废止的绝对的完全所有权 (Fee simple absolute)
“授予A”
“授予A及其继承人”		无
可废止的（期限性）可决定的完全所有权 (Fee simple determinable)
“只要” “在...期间” “直到”		出让人的复归可能性
第三方的待执行权益（即，附待执行限制的完全所有权 (fee simple subject to executory limitation)）
可废止的（条件性）附带后决条件的完全所有权 (Fee simple subject to condition subsequent)
“但如果” “条件是” “除非”		出让人的进入权
在土地销售合同中，卖方承诺在交易完成时向买方交付可售产权 (marketable title)。如果产权合理地没有疑问，且没有诉讼威胁，以至于一个理性的人会接受并为此付款，那么该产权就是可售的。如果卖方未能履行这一承诺，买方可以撤销合同并拒绝完成交易。

在本案中，教会拥有的是可废止的所有权 (defeasible fee)，因为如果特定事件或条件发生——即土地不再用于教会目的时，其产权将自动终止。如果买方购买该土地并将其用于商业目的，那么特定事件就会发生。买方的产权届时将终止，并复归于出让人。因此，教会无法交付可售产权，其对买方的诉讼很可能会失败。

(选项B) 限制性契约 (restrictive covenant) 是对在自己的土地上做或不做某事的承诺，它对产权没有影响。由于所引用的条款规定，如果土地不再用于教会目的，将剥夺教会（或其受让人）的产权，因此它不是一个限制性契约，而是一种可废止的所有权。

(选项C) 将销售收益附加于慈善信托，并不会影响教会转让可售产权的能力。这仅仅意味着，受托人将应教会的请求为某一慈善目的持有这些收益，而如果特定条件发生，产权仍将终止。

(选项D) 出让人不能也未曾减损其对教会的任何担保（即产权契约 (covenant of title)）。他有权向教会转让可废止的所有权，并有权在该土地上保留复归可能性。

教学目标：可售产权是指合理地没有疑问、没有诉讼威胁，以至于一个理性的人会接受并为此付款的产权。可废止的所有权的所有人无法转让可售产权，因为一旦特定事件或条件发生，产权将自动终止。

References

77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 93 (2020) (marketable title).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Marketable Title
核心考点：可售产权 (Marketable Title)

在每一份土地销售合同中（除非另有说明），卖方都默示承诺提供可售产权。这意味着产权必须合理地没有疑问，且没有诉讼风险。

案件逻辑分析

1. 确定产权类型：
出让人使用的语言是“so long as”（只要），这是典型的期限性语言 (Durational Language)。这创造了可决定的完全所有权 (Fee Simple Determinable)。

这意味着：如果土地不再用于教会目的，产权将自动终止并复归给原出让人。原出让人保留了复归可能性 (Possibility of Reverter)。

2. 评估产权质量：
教会拥有的不是绝对的完全所有权 (Fee Simple Absolute)，而是随时可能因为违反条件而丧失的产权。

3. 结合买方意图：
买方明确表示要将土地用于“商业活动”。一旦交易完成并改变用途，出让人的“复归可能性”就会被触发，买方将立即失去土地。这使得该产权面临极大的诉讼风险和实质性缺陷。

✅ 正确答案：选项 A

"No, because the grantor's interest prevents the church's title from being marketable."

解析：
由于出让人保留了复归可能性（Grantor's interest），教会无法向买方提供一个完整的、没有被没收风险的产权。一个理性的买家不会接受这种只要一使用（商业用途）就会自动丧失的土地。因此，教会违反了默示的可售产权 (Marketable Title) 承诺，无法强制买方履行合同。

为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 B (Restrictive Covenant)
限制性契约通常只导致损害赔偿或禁令，而不会导致产权丧失（Forfeiture）。本题中的措辞导致产权自动复归，这是地产权 (Estate) 的缺陷，而不仅仅是契约限制。
❌ 选项 C (Charitable Trust)
虽然慈善信托法（如 Cy Pres 原则）有时可以改变捐赠用途，但这需要法院判决，且具有不确定性。这种不确定性本身就使产权变得“不可售”。此外，条件是附着在土地上的，不仅仅是收益。
❌ 选项 D (Warranty)
出让人的担保仅限于他所转让的权益（即那个有缺陷的、可废止的产权）。他并没有担保这是一个绝对的完全所有权。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

1. 识别关键词： 看到 "So long as", "Until", "While" ➝ 立即反应这是 Fee Simple Determinable，伴随 Possibility of Reverter。

2. 区分阶段：
• 合同阶段 (Contract Stage)： 核心是 Marketable Title（产权是否有瑕疵）。
• 交割后阶段 (Deed Stage)： 核心是 Covenants of Title（契据中的担保）。
本题买方拒绝交割 (refused to close)，所以处于合同阶段，适用 Marketable Title 规则。

questions.question:
A seller and a purchaser signed a contract for the sale of a 60-year-old house. The contract required a warranty deed to be given at closing. The contract was silent regarding the condition of the house, and the purchaser did not ask. The purchaser received a warranty deed with all covenants of title at the closing and promptly recorded the deed. Approximately one month after the closing, the furnace in the house stopped working, the basement flooded, and the roof leaked so badly that the second floor could not be occupied. The seller, when told of the house's condition, was genuinely surprised.
There is no applicable statute.
The purchaser has sued the seller for damages. Will the purchaser likely be successful?

choices.a: No, because of the doctrine of merger.
choices.b: No, because the seller gave no warranty regarding the condition of the house.
choices.c: Yes, based on the covenants of title contained in the deed the purchaser received.
choices.d: Yes, because with a conveyance of residential real property, a warranty of fitness is implied.

Q86130

A seller and a purchaser signed a contract for the sale of a 60-year-old house. The contract required a warranty deed to be given at closing. The contract was silent regarding the condition of the house, and the purchaser did not ask. The purchaser received a warranty deed with all covenants of title at the closing and promptly recorded the deed. Approximately one month after the closing, the furnace in the house stopped working, the basement flooded, and the roof leaked so badly that the second floor could not be occupied. The seller, when told of the house's condition, was genuinely surprised.

There is no applicable statute.

The purchaser has sued the seller for damages. Will the purchaser likely be successful?

一位卖方和一位买方就一栋有60年房龄的房屋签订了销售合同。合同要求在交割时提供一份保证契据。合同对房屋的状况保持沉默，买方也未曾询问。买方在交割时收到了一份包含所有产权契约的保证契据，并立即对该契据进行了登记。交割后大约一个月，房屋内的暖炉停止工作，地下室被水淹没，屋顶漏水严重以至于二楼无法居住。卖方在被告知房屋状况时，表现得十分惊讶。

本案没有适用的成文法。

买方已起诉卖方要求损害赔偿。买方是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because of the doctrine of merger.
不会，因为合并原则（doctrine of merger）。

B. No, because the seller gave no warranty regarding the condition of the house.
不会，因为卖方未就房屋状况提供任何保证。

C. Yes, based on the covenants of title contained in the deed the purchaser received.
会，基于买方收到的契据中所包含的产权契约。

D. Yes, because with a conveyance of residential real property, a warranty of fitness is implied.
会，因为在住宅不动产的转让中，默示了适宜性保证（warranty of fitness）。
data.explanation:
Seller's duty to disclose


Common law (minority) ruleCaveat emptor
No duty to disclose property defects unless otherwise provided
Modern (majority) ruleCommercial property
Must disclose known material defects that buyer could not reasonably discover
Residential property
Exception: "as is" clause or specific disclaimers without seller's fraud
The majority of jurisdictions have enacted statutes that require sellers of residential property to disclose any known material defects that cannot be reasonably discovered by the buyer. But since there is no applicable statute in this jurisdiction, the common-law rule of caveat emptor controls. This rule (meaning "let the buyer beware") provides that sellers have no duty to disclose property defects to the buyer unless otherwise agreed.

Here, the seller gave no warranties and the contract was silent as to the condition of the house, so the seller had no duty to disclose these defects to the buyer. Furthermore, the seller did not know about the defects in the house because she was "genuinely surprised" when she was told of the house's condition. So even if this jurisdiction had enacted a statute that followed the majority rule, the seller would not have breached any duty to disclose.

(Choice A) Under the doctrine of merger, all obligations as to title contained within the land-sale contract merge into the deed once it is delivered to and accepted by the buyer. This doctrine does not relate to issues having to do with the physical condition of the property.

(Choice C) The covenants in a warranty deed relate to the title of the property, not its physical condition.

(Choice D) A warranty of fitness or suitability† is implied in almost all jurisdictions in a contract for the sale of a newly constructed residence, so it does not apply to the sale of this 60-year-old house.

†This is also referred to as the implied warranty of quality, workmanlike construction, and habitability.

Educational objective: The common-law doctrine of caveat emptor provides that a seller has no duty to disclose property defects to the buyer unless otherwise agreed.

选项正确率统计：A选项 26%，B选项 41%（正确选项），C选项 17%，D选项 14%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

卖方的披露义务


普通法（少数派）规则Caveat emptor（买方自慎）
除非另有规定，否则无义务披露财产瑕疵
现代（多数派）规则商业地产
必须披露买方无法合理发现的已知重大瑕疵
住宅地产
例外：“按现状”条款或在卖方无欺诈情况下的特定免责声明
大多数司法管辖区已颁布成文法，要求住宅地产的卖方披露任何买方无法合理发现的已知重大瑕疵。但由于本案所在司法管辖区没有适用的成文法，因此适用普通法上的caveat emptor（买方自慎）规则。该规则（意为“买方当心”）规定，除非另有约定，卖方没有义务向买方披露财产瑕疵。

在本案中，卖方未提供任何保证，合同也对房屋状况保持沉默，因此卖方没有义务向买方披露这些瑕疵。此外，卖方并不知道房屋存在瑕疵，因为当她被告知房屋状况时，她表现得“十分惊讶”。因此，即使该司法管辖区采纳了遵循多数派规则的成文法，卖方也没有违反任何披露义务。

(选项A) 根据合并原则（doctrine of merger），土地销售合同中包含的所有关于产权的义务，在契据交付给买方并被其接受后，即合并到契据中。该原则不涉及与财产的物理状况有关的问题。

(选项C) 保证契据中的契约涉及财产的产权，而非其物理状况。

(选项D) 在几乎所有司法管辖区，新建住宅的销售合同中都默示了适宜性或适用性保证†，因此该保证不适用于这栋有60年房龄的房屋的销售。

†这也称为默示的质量保证、精工建造保证和可居住性保证。

教学目标：普通法上的caveat emptor（买方自慎）原则规定，除非另有约定，否则卖方没有义务向买方披露财产瑕疵。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Contracts
正确答案：B
买方不会胜诉，因为卖方未就房屋状况提供任何保证。
核心考点：买方自慎 (Caveat Emptor)

本题的核心在于普通法下的 Caveat Emptor（买方自慎）原则。

在没有成文法（Statute）特别规定的情况下，对于二手住宅（Used Residential Property）的销售：

  • 卖方对房屋的物理状况（Physical Condition）没有默示保证。
  • 除非卖方在合同中做出了明确的明示保证（Express Warranty），否则买方需自行承担房屋瑕疵的风险。

本案关键事实：
1. 合同对房屋状况保持沉默（无明示保证）。
2. 卖方对瑕疵并不知情（Genuinely surprised），因此不存在欺诈（Fraud）或隐瞒已知潜在瑕疵（Failure to disclose known latent defects）的行为。

因此，卖方没有违反任何义务，买方无法获得赔偿。

陷阱选项分析
选项 C 错误：关于保证契据 (Warranty Deed)

这是 MBE 中最常见的混淆点。Warranty Deed 中的六大契约（Covenants of Title）仅担保产权（Title）的完整性（例如：卖方确实拥有房产、房产无未披露的抵押权等），它不担保房屋的物理状况（如屋顶漏水、暖炉损坏）。

选项 D 错误：关于适宜性默示保证 (Implied Warranty of Fitness)

适宜性或宜居性默示保证（Implied Warranty of Habitability/Fitness）通常仅适用于建筑商销售的新房（New Construction）。本案中的房屋已有 60 年房龄，不适用此规则。

选项 A 错误：关于合并原则 (Doctrine of Merger)

虽然合并原则（合同条款在交割后合并入契据）是一个有效的法律概念，但它不是本案买方败诉的根本原因。买方败诉是因为从一开始就没有关于房屋状况的保证，而不是因为该保证被合并消失了。

MBE 答题技巧

遇到房屋瑕疵（Defects）问题时，请按以下步骤思考：
1. 新房还是旧房？ 新房找 Builder 可能有默示保证；旧房通常适用 Caveat Emptor。
2. 卖方是否知情？ 如果卖方知道且隐瞒（Fraud/Concealment），卖方赔；如果卖方不知情（Surprised），通常不赔。
3. 区分 Title 和 Condition： 题目提到 "Warranty Deed" 通常是想诱导你认为它包含物理质量保证，切记它只管产权！

questions.question:
A man owned a tract of land. His friend wanted to buy the tract and offered $20,000 for it. The man knew that the friend was insolvent but replied, "As a favor to you as an old friend, I will sell my tract to you for $20,000, even though it is worth much more, if you can raise the money within one month." The friend wrote the following words, and no more, on a piece of paper: "I agree to sell my tract to [the friend] for $20,000." The man then signed the piece of paper and gave it to the friend.
Three days later, the man received an offer of $40,000 for the tract. He asked the friend if he had raised the $20,000. When the friend answered, "Not yet," the man told him that their deal was off and that he was going to accept the $40,000 offer.
The next week, the friend secured a bank commitment to enable him to purchase the tract. The friend immediately brought an appropriate action against the man to compel the man to convey the tract to the friend.
Who will likely prevail?

choices.a: The friend, because he has equitable title.
choices.b: The friend, because the parties' antecedent agreement is enforceable.
choices.c: The man, because the man's performance was excused by the friend's anticipatory breach.
choices.d: The man, because the terms of the parties' fully integrated written agreement control.

一名男子拥有一块土地。他的朋友想购买这块土地，并出价20,000美元。该男子知道他的朋友没有偿付能力，但回答说：“看在老朋友的情分上，我愿意以20,000美元的价格将我的土地卖给你，尽管它的价值远不止于此，前提是你能在一个月内筹到这笔钱。”朋友在一张纸上写下了以下文字，仅此而已：“我同意以20,000美元的价格将我的土地卖给[朋友]。”然后，该男子在这张纸上签了字，并将其交给了朋友。

三天后，该男子收到了一个以40,000美元购买该土地的要约。他问朋友是否已经筹集到20,000美元。当朋友回答“还没有”时，该男子告诉他他们的交易取消了，他将接受那个40,000美元的要约。

接下来的一周，朋友获得了一项银行承诺，使其能够购买这块土地。朋友立即对该男子提起了适当的诉讼，要求强制该男子将土地转让给朋友。

谁可能会胜诉？
options:
A. The friend, because he has equitable title.
朋友，因为他拥有衡平法上的所有权。

B. The friend, because the parties' antecedent agreement is enforceable.
朋友，因为双方的先前协议是可强制执行的。

C. The man, because the man's performance was excused by the friend's anticipatory breach.
男子，因为朋友的预期违约免除了该男子的履行义务。

D. The man, because the terms of the parties' fully integrated written agreement control.
男子，因为双方完全整合的书面协议条款具有约束力。
data.explanation:
Statute of frauds requirements for real estate contracts


WritingPhysical or electronic document(s) containing reasonable basis to believe contract was formed

eg, receipt, check, emails
SignatureHandwritten signature from, or other mark identifying, party to be charged

eg, letterhead, electronic signature, initials
Essential termsTypically includes:
  • identity of parties
  • words of intent to buy or sell
  • property description
  • sales price
Contracts for the sale of land are enforceable only if they comply with the statute of frauds. This statute requires that land-sale contracts be in writing , be signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought , and contain all essential terms. Essential terms often include:

  • the identity of the parties (eg, "I," "the friend," and the man's signature)
  • words of intent to buy or sell (eg, "I agree to sell")
  • a description of the property (eg, "my tract") and
  • the sales price (eg, $20,000).


Therefore, the antecedent agreement - ie, the piece of paper on which the friend wrote "I agree to sell my tract to [the friend] for $20,000" and that the man signed - is enforceable against the man under the statute of frauds. Therefore, the friend will likely prevail.

(Choice A) The doctrine of equitable conversion relates to the ownership of property and the risk of loss in the period between contract formation and closing. However, it does not impact the validity of, or the ability to enforce, a land-sale contract.

(Choice C) Anticipatory repudiation arises when a party to a contract clearly and unequivocally expresses an unwillingness to perform. The other party may then treat that repudiation as a breach. But here, the friend's statement that he had "not yet" raised the $20,000 expressed his willingness to perform, so no anticipatory repudiation occurred.

(Choice D) The parol evidence rule generally bars the use of extrinsic evidence of a prior or contemporaneous agreement that contradicts the written terms of a fully integrated contract. As a result, the terms of a final written agreement will control. But since the friend is able to perform under that contract, this will not help the man prevail.

Educational objective: Under the statute of frauds, a contract for the sale of land is enforceable only if it is in writing, is signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought, and contains all essential terms - ie, identifies the parties, contains words of intent to buy or sell, describes the property, and lists the sales price.

选项正确率统计：A选项 17%，B选项 63%（正确选项），C选项 8%，D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

不动产合同的Statute of Frauds要求


书面文件实体或电子文件，包含足以合理相信合同已成立的依据

例如，收据、支票、电子邮件
签名被请求执行方的手写签名或其他身份标识

例如，信头、电子签名、姓名首字母缩写
基本条款通常包括：
  • 当事人身份
  • 买卖意向的表述
  • 财产描述
  • 销售价格
土地买卖合同只有在符合statute of frauds的情况下才可强制执行。该法规要求土地买卖合同必须是书面形式，由被请求执行的一方签署，并包含所有基本条款。基本条款通常包括：

  • 当事人的身份（例如，“我”、“朋友”和该男子的签名）
  • 买卖意向的表述（例如，“我同意出售”）
  • 财产的描述（例如，“我的土地”）以及
  • 销售价格（例如，20,000美元）。


因此，该先前协议——即朋友写下“我同意以20,000美元的价格将我的土地卖给[朋友]”并且该男子签了字的那张纸——根据statute of frauds，对该男子是可强制执行的。因此，朋友可能会胜诉。

（选项A）衡平法转换原则（doctrine of equitable conversion）涉及合同成立至交割期间财产的所有权和损失风险。然而，它并不影响土地买卖合同的有效性或可执行性。

（选项C）预期性毁约（Anticipatory repudiation）发生于合同一方明确无误地表示不愿意履行合同时。另一方随后可将该毁约视作违约。但在此案中，朋友声称他“还没有”筹到20,000美元，这表达了他履行的意愿，因此并未发生预期性毁约。

（选项D）口头证据规则（parol evidence rule）通常禁止使用与完全整合合同的书面条款相矛盾的先前或同期协议的外部证据。因此，最终书面协议的条款将具有约束力。但由于朋友能够履行该合同，这并不能帮助该男子胜诉。

教学目标：根据statute of frauds，土地买卖合同只有在满足以下条件时才可强制执行：以书面形式订立，由被请求执行的一方签署，并包含所有基本条款——即明确当事人身份、包含买卖意向的表述、描述财产并列明销售价格。

MBE 考点解析

Real Estate Contracts & Statute of Frauds
正确答案：B 朋友胜诉，因为双方的先前协议（即那张纸）是可强制执行的。
核心考点：反欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds)

本题的核心在于判断那张简单的手写纸条是否构成了一份有效的、可强制执行的土地买卖合同。

根据普通法和大多数司法管辖区的规定，土地买卖合同必须满足 Statute of Frauds (SoF) 的要求才能执行。一份有效的书面文件（Memorandum）必须具备以下要素：

  • 书面形式 (Writing)： 任何形式的物理记录。
  • 基本条款 (Essential Terms)：
    ① 识别当事人 (Parties)
    ② 描述土地 (Description of Land)
    ③ 价格 (Price)
    ④ 买卖意图 (Intent to sell)
  • 签名 (Signature)： 必须由被请求执行方 (Party to be charged) 签署。

案情应用：

在本案中，朋友起诉男子（男子是被告，即 "Party to be charged"）。

  • 朋友写下的纸条包含了价格（$20,000）、当事人（“我”和朋友）、土地描述（“我的土地/my tract”）。
  • 最关键的是，男子在这张纸上签了字。

因此，这份简陋的文件满足了 Statute of Frauds 的所有要求，构成了一份具有约束力的合同。

为何男子的抗辩无效？

男子试图以“朋友还没筹到钱”为由取消合同，这涉及两个法律概念：

1. 预期违约 (Anticipatory Repudiation)

男子声称交易取消（Deal is off），但这站不住脚。预期违约要求一方明确且毫不含糊地 (unequivocally) 表示将不履行合同。

朋友只是说“还没有 (Not yet)”筹到钱，但他还有一个月的期限。在期限届满前说“还没完成”，并不代表“我不打算完成”。因此，朋友没有违约，男子的单方面解约构成了违约。

2. 完整整合协议 (Integration) - 选项D辨析

即使如选项D所述，书面协议是“完全整合”的（即排除了口头约定的“一个月期限”），这对男子也没有帮助。因为书面协议本身就是“我同意卖给你”，这是一个有效的承诺。朋友最终筹到了钱并要求履行，完全符合书面合同的条款。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

遇到“餐巾纸合同”或“便条合同”的题目时，不要因为文件看起来非正式就认为它无效。

只要检查三个要素： 1. Writing (书面) 2. Essential Terms (基本条款) 3. Signed by Defendant (被告签名)

如果满足，这就是一份铁案如山的合同 (Enforceable Contract)。

questions.question:
A seller owned a house situated on a two-acre lot in an area zoned for single-family residential uses only. Although it was not discernible from the outside, the house had been converted by the seller from a single-family house to a structure that contained three separate apartments, in violation of the zoning ordinance. The conversion was also in violation of the building code.
The seller and a buyer entered into a valid written contract for the purchase and sale of the house. The contract provided that the seller was to convey to the buyer marketable title. The contract was silent as to zoning. The buyer then fully inspected the house.
Prior to the closing, the buyer learned that the house did not conform to the zoning ordinance and refused to close although the seller was ready, willing, and able to perform his contract obligations. The seller brought an appropriate action for specific performance against the buyer.
Is the seller likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the illegal conversion of the house creates the risk of litigation.
choices.b: No, because the illegal conversion of the house was done by the seller rather than by a predecessor.
choices.c: Yes, because the buyer was charged with knowledge of the zoning ordinance prior to entering the contract.
choices.d: Yes, because the seller was able to convey a marketable title.

The conversion was also in violation of the building code.
