Prior to the closing, the buyer learned that the house did not conform to the zoning ordinance and refused to close although the owner was ready, willing, and able to perform his contract obligations. The owner brought an appropriate action for specific performance against the buyer.

Is the owner likely to prevail?

一位卖方拥有一栋房屋，该房屋坐落于一块两英亩的土地上，该区域被划定为仅限单户住宅用途。尽管从外部无法辨别，但该房屋已被卖方从单户住宅改建为一个包含三个独立公寓的建筑，这违反了区域规划条例。该改建也违反了建筑法规。

卖方和一位买方就该房屋的买卖签订了一份有效的书面合同。合同规定，卖方应向买方转让可售卖的产权（marketable title）。合同对区域规划问题未作规定。随后，买方对房屋进行了全面检查。

在过户前，买方了解到该房屋不符合区域规划条例，因此拒绝完成交易，尽管所有权人已经准备好、愿意且能够履行其合同义务。所有权人对买方提起了要求强制履行（specific performance）的适当诉讼。

该所有权人是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the illegal conversion of the house creates the risk of litigation.
不会，因为房屋的非法改建带来了诉讼风险。

B. No, because the illegal conversion of the house was done by the owner rather than by a predecessor.
不会，因为房屋的非法改建是由该所有权人而非前手所为。

C. Yes, because the buyer was charged with knowledge of the zoning ordinance prior to entering the contract.
会，因为在签订合同前，买方被推定知晓区域规划条例。

D. Yes, because the owner was able to convey a marketable title.
会，因为该所有权人能够转让可售卖的产权（marketable title）。
data.explanation:
"Red flags" for marketable title


CovenantsEasementsLeasesLiensGaps in chain of titleBoundary disputesExisting zoning violationsAdverse possession
The warranty of marketable title is implied in all real estate contracts unless otherwise provided. This guarantees that, upon closing, the seller will convey the buyer title that is reasonably free from doubt and under no threat of litigation such that a reasonable person would accept and pay for it. This does not mean that title must be free from any defect, but it should assure peaceable and quiet enjoyment of the property.

An existing violation of a zoning ordinance exposes the real estate owner to potential litigation, so such a violation renders title unmarketable.† This means that the seller's illegal conversion of the house in violation of the zoning ordinance prevents him from delivering marketable title to the buyer (Choice D). Therefore, his action for specific performance to compel the buyer to purchase the house will likely fail.

†While existing zoning violations render title unmarketable, courts have consistently held that existing building code violations do not.

(Choice B) The illegal conversion of the house renders title unmarketable regardless of whether the conversion was done by the owner or a predecessor.

(Choice C) Although the buyer was charged with knowledge of the zoning ordinance prior to entering the contract, the buyer was not charged with knowing whether the house complied with that ordinance. Instead, the buyer could rely on the implied warranty of marketability in the land- sale contract and inspect the property for noncompliance prior to closing.

Educational objective:

Marketable title exists when title is reasonably free from doubt and under no threat of litigation such that a reasonable person would accept and pay for it. Therefore, an existing zoning violation renders title unmarketable.

选项正确率统计：A选项 79%（正确选项），B选项 5%，C选项 2%，D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

可售卖产权（marketable title）的“危险信号”


Covenants (契约)Easements (地役权)Leases (租约)Liens (留置权)Gaps in chain of title (产权链瑕疵)Boundary disputes (边界争议)Existing zoning violations (现存的区域规划违规)Adverse possession (侵权逆占)
可售卖产权的担保（warranty of marketable title）在所有房地产合同中都是默示的，除非另有规定。此担保保证，在过户时，卖方将向买方转让不存在合理疑点且没有诉讼威胁的产权，以至于一个理性人愿意接受并为此付款。这并不意味着产权必须没有任何瑕疵，但它应能保证对财产的和平与安宁的享有。

一项现存的对区域规划条例的违反会使房地产所有权人面临潜在的诉讼，因此这种违反行为使得产权不具有可售卖性（unmarketable）。† 这意味着卖方违反区域规划条例非法改建房屋的行为，使其无法向买方交付可售卖的产权（选项D）。因此，他要求强制履行以迫使买方购买房屋的诉讼很可能会败诉。

†尽管现存的区域规划违规行为使产权不具有可售卖性，但法院一贯认为，现存的建筑法规违规行为则不会。

（选项B）房屋的非法改建使产权不具有可售卖性，无论该改建是由所有权人还是由前手所为。

（选项C）尽管买方在签订合同前被推定知晓区域规划条例，但买方并未被推定知晓该房屋是否遵守了该条例。相反，买方可以依赖土地买卖合同中默示的可售卖产权担保，并在过户前检查房产是否存在违规情况。

教学目标：

当产权不存在合理疑点、没有诉讼威胁，以至于一个理性人愿意接受并为此付款时，该产权即为可售卖的产权。因此，现存的区域规划违规行为会使产权不具有可售卖性。

References

77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 93 (2020) (marketable title).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Marketable Title
正确答案
选项 A
不会胜诉，因为房屋的非法改建带来了诉讼风险。
核心考点：可售卖产权 (Marketable Title)

在每一份土地买卖合同中，除非另有约定，卖方都默示担保提供Marketable Title。

定义：
可售卖产权是指不存在合理疑点（reasonably free from doubt）且没有诉讼威胁（threat of litigation）的产权。

如果产权存在使买方在过户后面临被起诉风险的瑕疵，该产权即为“不可售卖”（Unmarketable）。买方有权拒绝过户（Closing）。

关键区分：规划限制 vs. 规划违规

这是MBE考试中极易混淆的考点，请务必区分：

情况 对产权适销性的影响
Zoning Restrictions
(仅存在规划条例本身)
例：该地块被划定为仅限单户住宅。 		✅ 不影响
产权仍是 Marketable 的。买方必须接受土地受法律管辖的事实。
Existing Zoning Violation
(现存的违规行为)
例：在单户住宅区建了三户公寓。 		❌ 导致 Unmarketable
因为政府可能起诉买方，要求拆除或罚款。这构成了诉讼风险。
本案逻辑推演
  1. 现状：卖方将单户住宅改建为三户公寓，违反了 Zoning Ordinance。
  2. 后果：这属于 Existing Zoning Violation。
  3. 法律效力：这种违规行为使买方面临被政府强制执行（如强制拆除改建部分）的诉讼风险。
  4. 结论：产权是 Unmarketable 的。
  5. 结果：卖方无法提供合同要求的产权，因此无法强制买方履行合同（Specific Performance）。
为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 B (前手行为)： 错误。产权是否有瑕疵看的是“现状”。无论是谁造成的违规，只要违规存在，买方就面临风险。
  • 选项 C (买方知情)： 错误。买方被推定知晓“法律”（即该地有规划条例），但不被推定知晓“事实”（即房屋违反了该条例）。买方有权依赖卖方的默示担保。
  • 关于建筑法规 (Building Code)： 题目虽然提到也违反了建筑法规，但在MBE中，通常只有违反Zoning才直接导致产权不可售卖；单纯违反建筑法规（如电线布线错误）通常不影响产权适销性，除非合同另有规定。但本题中Zoning违规是决定性因素。

Focus: Marketable Title & Zoning

questions.question:
A seller owns a 400-acre tract of land with 5,000 feet of frontage on a county highway. The seller and a buyer entered into a written agreement for the sale of a portion of the tract identified only as "a parcel of land, containing not less than 100 acres and having not less than 1,000 feet of frontage on the county highway, whose exact location and dimensions are to be determined by the parties hereto, at a price of $8,000 per acre."
Shortly after the execution of the agreement, the parties met to stake out the parcel of land to be sold, but they could not agree. The disagreement intensified, and the seller repudiated the contract.
The buyer has sued the seller for specific performance. The seller has asserted all available defenses.
Is the buyer entitled to specific performance of the contract?

choices.a: No, because a contract for the sale of real property that requires further agreement on an essential element cannot be specifically enforced.
choices.b: No, because the purchase price was not fixed by, nor determinable under, the contract terms.
choices.c: Yes, because the contract bound the parties to act in good faith and to agree upon the specific land to be conveyed.
choices.d: Yes, because the equity powers of the court enable the court to appoint a master, or to take other appropriate action, to identify the land to be conveyed.

一名卖方拥有一片400英亩的土地，该土地有5000英尺的临郡公路路段。卖方与一名买方签订了一份书面协议，出售该片土地的一部分，该部分土地仅被描述为“一块土地，面积不小于100英亩，临郡公路路段不小于1000英尺，其确切位置和尺寸将由本协议双方决定，价格为每英亩8000美元。”

协议签订后不久，双方会面以确定待售土地的界限，但未能达成一致。分歧加剧，卖方拒绝履行合同。

买方已起诉卖方，要求强制履行。卖方已提出所有可用的抗辩。

买方是否有权要求强制履行该合同？
options:
A. No, because a contract for the sale of real property that requires further agreement on an essential element cannot be specifically enforced.
不可以，因为一份要求就某一基本要素进行进一步协商的不动产销售合同，不能被强制履行。

B. No, because the purchase price was not fixed by, nor determinable under, the contract terms.
不可以，因为购买价格既没有在合同中固定，也无法根据合同条款确定。

C. Yes, because the contract bound the parties to act in good faith and to agree upon the specific land to be conveyed.
可以，因为合同约束双方本着善意行事，并就待转让的具体土地达成一致。

D. Yes, because the equity powers of the court enable the court to appoint a master, or to take other appropriate action, to identify the land to be conveyed.
可以，因为法院的衡平法权力使其能够指定一名主事官，或采取其他适当行动，以确定待转让的土地。
data.explanation:
Under the statute of frauds, contracts for the sale of land (ie, real estate contracts) are enforceable only if they are in writing, are signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought, and contain all essential terms. Essential terms include:
  • the identity of the parties
  • words of intent to buy or sell
  • a description of the property and
  • the sales price.


Although courts may liberally construe the property-description requirement, the writing must contain some evidence of the specific property to be sold. Here, the writing expressly stated that the parties had yet to agree on what land was to be conveyed. Therefore, the statute of frauds makes the contract unenforceable.

(Choice B) The sales price is also an essential term. It can be listed in gross (eg, at a set price) or determined by the actual quantity of land sold (eg, at a per-acre price). Therefore, the agreement to purchase the land "at a price of $8,000 per acre" satisfies this requirement.

(Choices C & D) The statute of frauds requires that a contract for the sale of land identify the land to be sold. Good faith and equity cannot provide relief for this omission.

Educational objective: The statute of frauds requires that land-sale contracts contain all essential terms - ie, the identity of the parties, words of intent to buy or sell, a description of the property, and the sales price.



选项正确率统计：A选项 75%（正确选项），B选项 8%，C选项 9%，D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

根据防止欺诈法 (statute of frauds)，土地销售合同（即不动产合同）仅在以下情况下可强制执行：合同为书面形式，由被要求执行的一方签署，并包含所有基本条款。基本条款包括：
  • 当事人身份
  • 买卖意向的表述
  • 财产的描述以及
  • 销售价格。


尽管法院可能对财产描述的要求进行宽泛解释，但书面文件必须包含一些关于待售特定财产的证据。在本案中，书面文件明确指出，双方尚未就待转让的土地达成一致。因此，防止欺诈法 (statute of frauds) 使该合同不可强制执行。

(选项 B) 销售价格也是一项基本条款。它可以是总价（例如，一个固定价格）或根据出售土地的实际数量确定（例如，每英亩的价格）。因此，以“每英亩8000美元的价格”购买土地的协议满足了这一要求。

(选项 C 和 D) 防止欺诈法 (statute of frauds) 要求土地销售合同必须明确指出待售土地。善意和衡平法不能对此遗漏提供救济。

教学目标：防止欺诈法 (statute of frauds) 要求土地销售合同必须包含所有基本条款——即当事人身份、买卖意向的表述、财产的描述以及销售价格。

References

73 Am. Jur. 2d Statute of Frauds §§ 289, 305, 325, 329 (2020).

MBE 考点解析

不动产合同与防止欺诈法
核心法律规则：防止欺诈法

根据防止欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds, SOF)，土地销售合同必须满足以下条件才具有可执行性：

  • 必须是书面形式 (in writing)；
  • 由被执行方签署 (signed by the party to be charged)；
  • 包含所有基本条款 (essential terms)。
为什么本案合同不可执行？

1. 财产描述是基本条款

在不动产合同中，"基本条款"必须包括对财产的充分描述 (sufficient description of the property)。法院需要能够根据合同内容明确辨认出具体要转让哪一块土地。

2. "协议达成一致" (Agreement to Agree) 的陷阱

本案中，合同虽然规定了面积（100英亩）和临路长度（1000英尺），但明确写道：

"确切位置和尺寸将由本协议双方决定" (exact location and dimensions are to be determined by the parties)

这被称为"Agreement to Agree"（即约定未来再达成协议）。由于双方未能就这一核心要素达成一致，法院无法代替双方做出决定。法院无法强制执行一个连标的物都不确定的合同。

结论：由于缺少对土地的具体描述这一基本条款，合同不满足防止欺诈法的要求，因此买方无法获得强制履行 (Specific Performance) 的救济。

干扰项辨析
❌ 选项 B (关于价格)：
虽然价格也是基本条款，但它不需要是一个具体的总数字。只要价格是可确定的 (determinable) 即可。本案中 "$8,000 per acre" 结合具体的英亩数是可以算出价格的，因此价格条款本身没有问题。
❌ 选项 C & D (关于善意与衡平法)：
虽然合同法强调善意 (good faith)，衡平法 (equity) 也有补救功能，但它们不能用来修补防止欺诈法所要求的核心书面要素的缺失。如果合同根本没有确定卖哪块地，法院不能凭空"创造"一个合同来执行。
MBE 答题技巧

在处理不动产合同题目时，如果看到"从大块土地中出售一部分"的情节，立即检查合同是否明确界定了这部分土地的位置。

如果合同说"位置由双方日后商定"且双方后来闹翻了，这通常意味着合同因缺乏基本条款（描述不详）而不可执行。

questions.question:
A seller had promised a buyer that, if at any time the seller decided to sell his summer cottage property, he would give the buyer the opportunity to purchase the cottage.
At a time when the buyer was serving overseas with the United States Navy, the seller decided to sell the cottage for $200,000 and spoke to the buyer's mother. Before the buyer sailed, he had arranged for the mother to become a joint owner of his various bank accounts so that the mother would be able to pay his bills when he was gone. When she heard from the seller, the mother took the necessary funds from the buyer's account and paid the seller $200,000. Two weeks later, the seller executed and delivered to the mother a deed in the proper form purporting to convey the cottage to the buyer. The mother promptly and properly recorded the deed.
Shortly thereafter, the mother learned that the buyer had been killed in an accident at sea one week before the delivery of the deed. The buyer's last will, which has now been duly probated, leaves his entire estate to his church. The mother is the sole heir-at-law of the buyer.
There is no statute dealing with conveyances to dead persons.
Who has title to the cottage?

choices.a: The church.
choices.b: The mother.
choices.c: The seller.
choices.d: The seller, subject to a lien to secure $200,000 to the buyer's estate.

data.questionStem:
Q86129

A seller had promised a buyer that, if at any time the seller decided to sell his summer cottage property, he would give the buyer the opportunity to purchase the cottage.

At a time when the buyer was serving overseas with the United States Navy, the seller decided to sell the cottage for $200,000 and spoke to the buyer's mother. Before the buyer sailed, he had arranged for the mother to become a joint owner of his various bank accounts so that the mother would be able to pay his bills when he was gone. When she heard from the seller, the mother took the necessary funds from the buyer's account and paid the seller $200,000. Two weeks later, the seller executed and delivered to the mother a deed in the proper form purporting to convey the cottage to the buyer. The mother promptly and properly recorded the deed.

Shortly thereafter, the mother learned that the buyer had been killed in an accident at sea one week before the delivery of the deed. The buyer's last will, which has now been duly probated, leaves his entire estate to his church. The mother is the sole heir-at-law of the buyer.

There is no statute dealing with conveyances to dead persons.

Who has title to the cottage?

卖方曾向买方承诺，如果卖方在任何时候决定出售其避暑小屋的房产，他将给予买方购买该小屋的机会。

在买方于 United States Navy 海外服役期间，卖方决定以20万美元的价格出售该小屋，并与买方的母亲进行了交谈。在买方出海前，他已安排其母亲成为他多个银行账户的共同所有人，以便在他离开期间，母亲能够支付他的账单。当她从卖方处得知消息后，母亲从买方的账户中取出所需资金，并向卖方支付了20万美元。两周后，卖方签署并向母亲交付了一份格式正确的地契，意图将小屋转让给买方。母亲及时并妥善地登记了该地契。

此后不久，母亲得知买方在地契交付一周前于一次海上事故中丧生。买方的最终遗嘱现已经过正式认证，将其全部遗产留给了他的教会。母亲是买方的唯一法定继承人。

没有处理向死者转让财产的成文法。

谁拥有该小屋的产权？
options:
A. The church.
教会。

B. The mother.
母亲。

C. The seller.
卖方。

D. The seller, subject to a lien to secure $200,000 to the buyer's estate.
卖方，但其产权附带一项为买方遗产担保20万美元的留置权。
data.explanation:
Although the buyer left his entire estate to the church, the cottage would only be part of that estate if the buyer had an interest in the cottage when he died. He did not have legal title upon death since the seller had not yet delivered the deed. But under the doctrine of equitable conversion, the buyer did have equitable title - ie, the right to obtain full ownership of the property (ie, legal and equitable title) upon closing. That is because an enforceable sales contract was formed when the buyer's mother exercised the option to buy the cottage on his behalf.

Since equitable title is a real property interest, it passed to the church under the buyer's will. The church then obtained legal title to, and full ownership of, the cottage upon closing - when the seller delivered the deed to the mother (Choices B & C).

(Choice D) If a buyer conveys his/her equitable title before the purchase price has been paid, that title will be subject to the seller's equitable lien. But here, the mother paid the purchase price ($200,000) before the cottage was devised to the church. Therefore, the seller has no lien on the church's title or any other interest in the cottage.

Educational objective: Under the doctrine of equitable conversion, a purchaser receives equitable title to property when he/she enters an enforceable sales contract (eg, by paying the sale price). Equitable title is a real property interest that gives the purchaser the right to obtain full ownership of the property upon closing (eg, when the seller delivers the deed).



选项正确率统计：A选项 53%（正确选项），B选项 13%，C选项 16%，D选项 16%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

尽管买方将全部遗产留给了教会，但只有当买方在去世时对小屋拥有权益，该小屋才能成为其遗产的一部分。由于卖方尚未交付地契，他在去世时并不拥有法定产权。但是，根据衡平法转换原则 (doctrine of equitable conversion)，买方确实拥有衡平法上的产权——即，在交割时获得财产完全所有权（即法定产权和衡平法产权）的权利。这是因为，当买方的母亲代表他行使购买小屋的选择权时，一份可强制执行的买卖合同已经成立。

由于衡平法产权是一种不动产权益，它根据买方的遗嘱转移给了教会。随后，在交割时——即卖方向母亲交付地契时，教会获得了该小屋的法定产权和完全所有权（选项 B 和 C）。

（选项 D）如果买方在支付购房款前转让其衡平法产权，该产权将受制于卖方的衡平法留置权。但在本案中，母亲在小屋通过遗嘱转让给教会之前，已经支付了购房款（20万美元）。因此，卖方对教会的产权不享有任何留置权，也不对该小屋拥有任何其他权益。

教学目标：根据衡平法转换原则 (doctrine of equitable conversion)，当买方签订可强制执行的买卖合同（例如，通过支付售价）时，即获得财产的衡平法产权。衡平法产权是一种不动产权益，它赋予买方在交割时（例如，当卖方交付地契时）获得财产完全所有权的权利。

References

77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 26 (2018) (option contract).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Equitable Conversion

💡 核心原则：衡平法转换 (Equitable Conversion)

一旦签订了可强制执行的不动产买卖合同（enforceable contract），买方在衡平法上即被视为土地的所有者（拥有 Equitable Title），而卖方仅保留法定所有权（Legal Title）作为收取价款的担保。

📅 案件时间线梳理
第一阶段
合同成立 (Contract Formed)
母亲代表买方支付 $200,000。
👉 此时买方获得 Equitable Title。
第二阶段
买方去世 (Buyer Dies)
买方在海上事故中丧生。
👉 其 Equitable Title 作为不动产权益进入遗产。
第三阶段
地契交付 (Deed Delivered)
卖方将地契交给母亲。
👉 此时完成 Legal Title 的转移。
⚖️ 法律逻辑推演

1. 为什么合同有效？
卖方提供了购买机会，母亲作为买方的代理人（通过共同账户授权）支付了全款。这一行为构成了对卖方要约的承诺（Acceptance），形成了可强制执行的合同。

2. 衡平法转换 (Equitable Conversion) 的效力
在合同成立的那一刻，根据衡平法转换原则，买方（Buyer）成为了房屋的衡平法所有人 (Equitable Owner)。这种权益属于不动产 (Real Property)。

3. 死亡与遗嘱 (Death & Will)
买方去世时，他拥有该房屋的衡平法产权。根据他的遗嘱（Will），所有遗产（entire estate）都留给了教会。因此，教会继承了这部分不动产权益。

4. 谁拥有最终产权？
由于购房款已经全额支付，卖方不再拥有任何权益（连担保权都没有了）。虽然地契是在买方死后交付的（普通法下向死者交付地契通常无效），但这不影响教会已经通过遗嘱继承了衡平法上的所有权。教会作为衡平法所有人，有权要求获得法定产权（Legal Title）。因此，在实质上，教会拥有该小屋。

❌ 干扰项排除
A. 教会 (The Church)
正确。买方的衡平法产权属于不动产，根据遗嘱条款，由教会继承。
B. 母亲 (The Mother)
错误。母亲是法定继承人（Heir-at-law），但当存在有效遗嘱时，遗嘱优先于法定继承。买方的遗嘱将所有财产留给了教会。
C. 卖方 (The Seller)
错误。卖方已经收到了全款，合同已履行。卖方仅持有“裸法定产权”(Bare Legal Title)，且必须为了衡平法所有人的利益持有。
D. 卖方带留置权
错误。卖方的留置权（Vendor's Lien）仅在买方未付清款项时存在。本案中，母亲已支付了 $200,000 全款，因此不存在留置权。
MBE Real Property Topic: Contracts & Conveyance

questions.question:
When a buyer and a seller executed a valid contract for the sale of a house, the buyer gave the seller $1,000 as earnest money. The contract noted that the earnest money tendered would be applied to the purchase price at the time of sale but was silent as to remedies in the event of any default.
Just before the closing, the buyer lost her job. The buyer told the seller that she could no longer purchase the house and asked him to return the earnest money. The seller accurately told the buyer that the seller's actual losses exceeded the amount of the earnest money; that if the seller sued the buyer for damages, he would receive a minimum of $5,000; and that it would be difficult for him to sell the house in the current market.
Should the buyer get the earnest money back?

choices.a: No, because the contract was silent regarding remedies.
choices.b: No, because the seller's actual losses exceeded the amount of the earnest money.
choices.c: Yes, because the buyer is no longer ready, willing, and able to purchase the house.
choices.d: Yes, because the reason for the buyer's default was not anticipated.

data.questionStem:
Q86819 When a buyer and a seller executed a valid contract for the sale of a house, the buyer gave the seller $1,000 as earnest money. The contract noted that the earnest money tendered would be applied to the purchase price at the time of sale but was silent as to remedies in the event of any default.

Just before the closing, the buyer lost her job. The buyer told the seller that she could no longer purchase the house and asked him to return the earnest money. The seller accurately told the buyer that the seller's actual losses exceeded the amount of the earnest money; that if the seller sued the buyer for damages, he would receive a minimum of $5,000; and that it would be difficult for him to sell the house in the current market.

Should the buyer get the earnest money back? 当买卖双方就一栋房屋的销售签订了一份有效合同后，买方支付给卖方1000美元作为定金。合同注明，所付定金将在销售时用于抵扣购买价格，但对于任何违约情况下的救济措施保持沉默。

就在过户前，买方失去了工作。买方告诉卖方她无法再购买该房屋，并要求卖方退还定金。卖方如实告知买方，卖方的实际损失超过了定金的数额；如果卖方起诉买方要求损害赔偿，他将至少获得5000美元；并且在当前市场上他很难卖掉这栋房子。

买方是否应该拿回定金？
options:
A. No, because the contract was silent regarding remedies.
不应该，因为合同对救济措施保持沉默。

B. No, because the seller's actual losses exceeded the amount of the earnest money.
不应该，因为卖方的实际损失超过了定金的数额。

C. Yes, because the buyer is no longer ready, willing, and able to purchase the house.
应该，因为买方已不再准备好、愿意且能够购买该房屋。

D. Yes, because the reason for the buyer's default was not anticipated.
应该，因为买方违约的原因是未曾预料到的。
data.explanation:
Seller's remedies


Rescission & restitutionRescind (ie, cancel) agreement & recover possession of property
Rental value & physical damages are recoverable
Buyer not liable for purchase price
Specific performanceSeek an injunction ordering buyer to pay agreed purchase price
May be unavailable if money damages provide adequate compensation & property is not unique
eg, condominium identical to other units in complex
DamagesLoss of bargain = contract price – market value at time of breach
Liquidated damages = amount designated in the sales contract as compensation for breach
Retain buyer's deposit (up to amount of seller's actual damages)
Incidental & consequential damages that were contemplated during sales contract or reasonably foreseeable
Earnest money is a deposit paid by a buyer to show a good-faith intent to complete the transaction. Once accepted, the seller cannot recover other damages for breach. That is because earnest money typically constitutes liquidated damages—ie, an amount agreed upon during good-faith negotiations to reasonably compensate the injured party. These damages are recoverable unless they constitute a penalty (eg, when liquidated damages far exceed actual damages). In such a case, the seller can only recover actual damages.

Here, the buyer gave the seller $1,000 as earnest money. The contract was silent as to remedies, so the $1,000 constitutes liquidated damages (Choice A). The buyer breached the contract when she reported that she could no longer purchase the house, causing the seller to sustain losses. Since those actual losses exceed the amount of the earnest money, the liquidated damages provision is likely enforceable. As a result, the seller should receive the full $1,000 and the buyer should not receive any earnest money back.

(Choice C) The seller is entitled to the $1,000 because the buyer is no longer ready, willing, and able to purchase the house. This fact would not allow the buyer to get the earnest money back.

(Choice D) Unless otherwise stated, liquidated damages will be paid to the injured party as compensation for any breach, regardless of whether the breach was anticipated.

Educational objective: Earnest money typically constitutes liquidated damages, which are generally recoverable upon the buyer's breach. But if liquidated damages are deemed a penalty (eg, when they far exceed actual damages), then the seller may recover only actual damages.

卖方的救济措施


解除合同与返还财产解除（即取消）协议并收回房产所有权
可追回租金价值和物理损害赔偿
买方不承担购买价格的责任
特定履行寻求强制令，命令买方支付约定的购买价格
如果金钱赔偿足以提供充分补偿且房产并非独一无二，则可能无法获得
例如，与小区内其他单元完全相同的公寓
损害赔偿交易损失 = 合同价格 – 违约时的市场价值
约定违约金 = 销售合同中指定的作为违约赔偿的金额
保留买方定金（最高不超过卖方实际损失的金额）
销售合同期间可预见的或合理可预见的附带和间接损害
定金是买方为表示完成交易的善意意图而支付的押金。一旦卖方接受，就不能因违约而要求其他损害赔偿。这是因为定金通常构成约定违约金——即，在善意谈判中商定的，用以合理补偿受损方的金额。这些赔偿金是可以追回的，除非它们构成罚金（例如，当约定违约金远超实际损失时）。在这种情况下，卖方只能追回实际损失。

在此案中，买方支付给卖方1000美元作为定金。合同对救济措施保持沉默，因此这1000美元构成约定违约金（选项A）。当买方告知她无法再购买该房屋时，她违反了合同，导致卖方遭受损失。由于这些实际损失超过了定金的数额，因此约定违约金条款很可能是可强制执行的。因此，卖方应获得全部1000美元，而买方不应拿回任何定金。

（选项C）卖方有权获得这1000美元，因为买方已不再准备好、愿意且能够购买该房屋。这一事实并不能让买方拿回定金。

（选项D）除非另有规定，否则无论违约是否被预料到，约定违约金都将支付给受损方作为对任何违约的补偿。

教学目标： 定金通常构成约定违约金，在买方违约时通常可以追回。但如果约定违约金被视为罚金（例如，当它们远超实际损失时），那么卖方只能追回实际损失。

References

22 Am. Jur. 2d Damages § 540 (2020) (earnest deposit considered liquidated damages).
77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 478 (2020) (seller's recovery of liquidated damages).

MBE 考点解析：不动产定金与违约救济

本题考察的是不动产买卖合同中，当买方违约（Breach of Contract）时，卖方是否有权保留定金（Earnest Money）。

核心法律规则：
在没有明确违约金条款的情况下，如果买方无正当理由违约，卖方通常有权保留定金，前提是定金金额合理且不超过卖方的实际损失（Actual Damages）。

1. 法律分析：为什么选 B？

正确答案是 B。

逻辑推演如下：

  • 定金的性质： 定金（Earnest Money）通常被视为一种预设的约定违约金（Liquidated Damages）。它的目的是在买方违约时补偿卖方。
  • 合同的沉默： 即使合同没有明确说明违约救济措施，法院通常也允许卖方在买方违约时保留定金。
  • 关键测试——罚金原则（Penalty Doctrine）： 约定违约金必须是合理的，不能具有惩罚性。如果定金数额巨大，而卖方实际损失很小，法院可能会判定没收定金是不公平的“罚金”。
  • 本案事实： 卖方的实际损失（超过$5,000）远大于定金（$1,000）。因此，卖方保留这$1,000完全是用于弥补实际损失，不存在不当得利（Unjust Enrichment）或惩罚性过高的问题。

因此，因为卖方遭受了实质性的经济损失，且该损失超过了定金金额，卖方有权保留定金。

2. 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (错误)：
“因为合同对救济措施保持沉默。”
虽然合同沉默，但这并不是卖方能保留定金的根本原因。如果卖方没有任何损失却没收了定金，法院可能会要求退还部分定金以防止不当得利。卖方能保留定金的核心原因是存在实际损失。

选项 C (错误)：
“因为买方不再准备好、愿意且能够购买。”
这是买方违约的事实描述，但这本身并不自动决定定金的归属。如果定金数额极高（例如房价的50%），即使买方违约，法院也可能判决退还部分定金。关键在于损害赔偿的合理性。

选项 D (错误)：
“因为违约原因是未曾预料到的。”
买方失业（Financial Inability）虽然是不幸的，但在合同法中通常不构成履约不能（Impossibility）或商业目的落空（Frustration of Purpose）的有效抗辩。买方的个人财务状况变化风险通常由买方自己承担，这不能成为要求退还定金的理由。

🎓 MBE 破题金钥匙

在处理不动产违约金问题时，请遵循以下步骤：

  1. 确定违约方： 谁搞砸了交易？（本题是买方）。
  2. 检查定金金额： 通常定金占房价的 10% 或更少被视为合理的约定违约金（Liquidated Damages）。
  3. 比较损失：
    • 如果 定金 ≈ 实际损失 ➡️ 卖方保留。
    • 如果 定金 < 实际损失 ➡️ 卖方保留（甚至可能起诉追讨更多，除非合同限制了救济）。
    • 如果 定金 >>> 实际损失 ➡️ 买方可能拿回差额（避免罚金性质）。

本题中，实际损失 > 定金，这是最强有力的理由支持卖方保留款项。

questions.question:
Six months ago, a man told his cousin that he would give her his farm as a gift on her next birthday. The cousin then entered into a valid written contract to sell the farm to an investor with the closing to take place "one week after [the cousin's] next birthday."
The man failed to convey the farm to the cousin on her birthday. One week after the cousin's birthday, on the intended closing date, the investor first learned of the cousin's inability to convey the farm because the man had breached his promise. The investor considered suing the cousin but realized that the cousin could not be compelled to convey the farm because it was still owned by the man.
Two weeks after the cousin's birthday, the man died. Under his valid will, the man devised the farm to the cousin. Within a week, the executor of the man's estate gave the cousin an executor's deed to the farm in compliance with state law. The investor promptly learned of this transfer and demanded that the cousin convey the farm to her. The cousin refused.
The investor sued the cousin for specific performance.
Who will likely prevail?

choices.a: The cousin, because she received title by devise rather than by conveyance.
choices.b: The cousin, because the contract to convey was not signed by the legal owner of the farm as of the date of the contract and was therefore void.
choices.c: The investor, because the contract to convey merged into the executor's deed to the cousin.
choices.d: The investor, because the contract to convey remained enforceable by her within a reasonable period of time after the proposed closing date.

六个月前，一名男子告诉他的表亲，他将在她下一个生日时将他的农场作为礼物赠予她。该表亲随后与一名投资者签订了一份有效的书面合同，将该农场出售给该投资者，并约定交割将在“[该表亲]下一个生日后一周”进行。

该男子未能在表亲生日当天将农场转让给她。表亲生日后一周，即预定的交割日，投资者才得知由于该男子违背其承诺，导致表亲无法转让该农场。投资者考虑起诉该表亲，但意识到由于农场仍为该男子所有，无法强制表亲转让农场。

表亲生日后两周，该男子去世。根据其有效遗嘱，该男子将农场遗赠给了表亲。一周内，该男子遗产的执行人根据州法律，将农场的执行人契约交给了表亲。投资者迅速得知此项转让，并要求表亲将农场转让给她。表亲拒绝了。

投资者起诉表亲，要求其进行特定履行（specific performance）。

谁可能会胜诉？
options:
A. The cousin, because she received title by devise rather than by conveyance.
表亲，因为她是通过遗赠而非转让获得所有权的。

B. The cousin, because the contract to convey was not signed by the legal owner of the farm as of the date of the contract and was therefore void.
表亲，因为转让合同在签订之日并非由农场的合法所有人签署，因此该合同无效。

C. The investor, because the contract to convey merged into the executor's deed to the cousin.
投资者，因为转让合同已并入授予表亲的执行人契约中。

D. The investor, because the contract to convey remained enforceable by her within a reasonable period of time after the proposed closing date.
投资者，因为在拟议的交割日期后的合理期限内，她仍然可以强制执行该转让合同。
data.explanation:
The sale of real property typically comprises three parts:
  • Execution of the sales contract - the buyer promises to pay the purchase price in exchange for the seller's promise to deliver title
  • Executory period - the buyer can inspect the property, secure a loan, and review title documents; the seller can repair the property or correct imperfections in the title
  • Closing - the seller formally transfers title by delivering the deed to the buyer; the buyer pays the purchase price
A closing date is not an essential term of a land-sale contract, so the seller's performance is due at or within a reasonable time after the closing date unless time is of the essence. Time is of the essence when the contract or circumstances strongly suggest that the parties intended that the closing date be strictly enforced - not the case here. Therefore, the contract between the cousin and the investor was still enforceable when the cousin acquired title to the farm shortly after the proposed closing date, and the investor will likely prevail.

(Choice A) Since the cousin acquired title within a reasonable time after the proposed closing date, she was contractually obligated to transfer title to the investor. The method through which she received title (by devise or conveyance) is irrelevant.

(Choice B) The seller need not have title at the time the land-sale contract is executed since performance is not due until closing. As a result, the cousin could sign the contract with the investor even though she was not the legal owner of the farm at that time.

(Choice C) Under the merger rule, a land-sale contract merges into the deed of conveyance at the time of closing, so only the guarantees reflected in the deed remain. This means that the contract will merge into the cousin's deed (not the executor's deed) once the deed is conveyed.

Educational objective: A seller need not transfer title until closing or a reasonable time thereafter unless time is of the essence - ie, if the contract or circumstances strongly suggest that the parties intended the closing date to be strictly enforced.



选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 10%，C选项 16%，D选项 68%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

不动产的销售通常包括三个部分：
  • 销售合同的签订 - 买方承诺支付购买价款，以换取卖方交付所有权的承诺
  • 待执行期间 - 买方可以检查房产、获得贷款并审查所有权文件；卖方可以修缮房产或纠正所有权中的瑕疵
  • 交割 - 卖方通过向买方交付契约来正式转让所有权；买方支付购买价款
交割日期并非土地销售合同的必要条款，因此，除非时间至关重要（time is of the essence），否则卖方的履行义务应在交割日期或其后的合理时间内完成。当合同或情况强烈表明双方意图严格执行交割日期时，时间即为至关重要——本案并非如此。因此，当表亲在拟议交割日期后不久获得农场所有权时，她与投资者之间的合同仍然可以强制执行，投资者可能会胜诉。

(选项 A) 由于表亲在拟议交割日期后的合理时间内获得了所有权，她有合同义务将所有权转让给投资者。她获得所有权的方式（通过遗赠或转让）无关紧要。

(选项 B) 卖方在签订土地销售合同时无需拥有所有权，因为履行义务直到交割时才到期。因此，尽管表亲当时并非农场的合法所有人，她仍可以与投资者签订合同。

(选项 C) 根据合并规则（merger rule），土地销售合同在交割时并入转让契约中，因此只有契约中体现的保证仍然有效。这意味着一旦契约被转让，合同将并入表亲的契约（而非执行人的契约）中。

教学目标： 除非时间至关重要——即合同或情况强烈表明双方意图严格执行交割日期，否则卖方无需在交割之时或其后的合理时间内转让所有权。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考题解析

Real Estate Contracts
正确答案：D 投资者胜诉，因为在拟议的交割日期后的合理期限内，她仍然可以强制执行该转让合同。
⚖️ 核心法律规则

本题主要考察不动产买卖合同中的两个关键概念：

  1. 履行时间 (Time of Performance)：除非合同明确规定或情况表明Time is of the essence（时间至关重要），否则交割日期并非绝对截止日。
  2. 产权交付能力 (Ability to Convey Title)：卖方只需在交割时（Closing）拥有产权，而无需在签约时拥有。
🔍 深度解析

1. 时间并非至关重要 (Time is NOT of the Essence)

在普通法和大多数司法管辖区，土地销售合同中的交割日期被视为目标日期。除非合同中有明确条款说明“时间至关重要”，或者周围环境强烈暗示这一点，否则一方在交割日期的延迟履行并不构成实质性违约（Material Breach）。

在本案中，虽然表亲未能在原定日期交割，但合同并未规定时间至关重要。因此，表亲有权在原定日期后的合理时间 (Reasonable Time)内完成履约。

2. 延迟后的履行能力

表亲在原定交割日后仅两周（通过遗嘱）获得了农场的所有权，并在一周后拿到了契约。这通常被视为在“合理时间”范围内。一旦她获得了产权，她就有能力履行合同。由于合同仍然有效（未因轻微延迟而终止），投资者有权要求Specific Performance（特定履行/强制履行）。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A 错误： 获得产权的方式无关紧要。 无论是通过赠与（Conveyance）还是遗赠（Devise）获得产权，只要卖方拥有了合法的Marketable Title（适销产权），她就有义务履行出售合同。
选项 B 错误： 签约时无需拥有产权。 这是MBE常见的陷阱。法律允许人们出售他们尚未拥有的东西，只要他们在交割时 (Closing) 能够交付产权即可。因此，合同自始有效。
选项 C 错误： 合并原则 (Merger Doctrine) 适用对象错误。 合并原则是指土地销售合同的条款会并入最终交付给买方的契约（Deed）中。本案中，执行人给表亲的契约与投资者无关；投资者尚未收到契约，因此合同尚未“合并”消失，投资者仍可依据合同起诉。
💡 MBE 备考锦囊

遇到“卖方无产权”题目时的思考步骤：

  • 第一步：看签约时？（无产权不影响合同有效性）。
  • 第二步：看交割时？（卖方必须在交割时提供产权）。
  • 第三步：看是否迟延？（若非 Time is of the essence，卖方有合理宽限期去搞定产权）。

questions.question:
The owner of a tract of land mortgaged the tract to a bank to secure his preexisting obligation to the bank. The mortgage was promptly and properly recorded. The owner and a buyer then entered into a valid written contract for the purchase and sale of the tract, which provided for the transfer of "a marketable title, free of encumbrances." The contract did not expressly refer to the mortgage.
Shortly after entering into the contract, the buyer found another property that much better suited her needs and decided to try to avoid her contract with the owner. When the buyer discovered the existence of the mortgage, she asserted that the title was encumbered and that she would not close. The owner responded by offering to provide for payment and discharge of the mortgage at the closing from the proceeds of the closing. The buyer refused to go forward, and the owner brought an appropriate action against her for specific performance.
If the court holds for the owner in this action, what would be the likely reason?

choices.a: The doctrine of equitable conversion supports the result.
choices.b: The existence of the mortgage was not the buyer's real reason for refusing to close.
choices.c: The mortgage is not entitled to priority because it was granted for preexisting obligations.
choices.d: The owner's arrangements for the payment of the mortgage fully satisfied his obligation to deliver marketable title.

一块土地的所有人将该土地抵押给一家银行，以担保其对银行已有的债务。该抵押被及时且适当地进行了登记。随后，该所有人和一名买方签订了一份有效的书面买卖合同，合同规定转让“无产权负担的可售卖所有权”。合同中并未明确提及该抵押。

签订合同后不久，买方发现了另一处更适合她需求的房产，并决定试图避免履行与所有人的合同。当买方发现该抵押的存在时，她主张该所有权存在产权负担，并表示她不会完成交易。所有人回应称，他将在交易完成时，用交易所得款项支付并清偿该抵押。买方拒绝继续进行交易，所有人对她提起了要求强制履行的适当诉讼。

如果法院在此诉讼中支持了所有人，最可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. The doctrine of equitable conversion supports the result.
衡平法转换原则 (equitable conversion) 支持此判决结果。

B. The existence of the mortgage was not the buyer's real reason for refusing to close.
抵押的存在并非买方拒绝完成交易的真实原因。

C. The mortgage is not entitled to priority because it was granted for preexisting obligations.
该抵押不享有优先权，因为它是为已有的债务而设定的。

D. The owner's arrangements for the payment of the mortgage fully satisfied his obligation to deliver marketable title.
所有人为支付抵押所做的安排，完全履行了他交付可售卖所有权的义务。
data.explanation:
"Red flags" for marketable title


CovenantsEasements
LeasesLiens
Gaps in chain of titleBoundary disputes
Existing zoning violationsAdverse possession
All contracts for the sale of land have an implied warranty that the seller will convey marketable title to the buyer upon closing unless otherwise stated. Title need not be perfect to be marketable. However, it must be reasonably free from doubt and under no threat of litigation such that a reasonable person would accept and pay for it. If the seller cannot convey marketable title by the time of closing, the buyer can rescind (ie, cancel) the contract.

Title can be rendered unmarketable by encumbrances (eg, easements, mortgages, other liens). Although a mortgage is an encumbrance, the seller has the right to satisfy the mortgage up to the time of closing and will often use the sale proceeds to do so - as the owner has made arrangements to do here. As a result, the court will hold for the owner because the closing itself will likely render title marketable.

(Choice A) The doctrine of equitable conversion relates to the ownership of the property and the risk of loss in the period between contract formation and closing. It does not affect the parties' performance under the land-sale contract.

(Choice B) The buyer could have refused to close if she had an actual basis for doing so - even if that was not the buyer's actual reason for the refusal.

(Choice C) Priority refers to the order in which creditors receive sale proceeds from a foreclosure; whether a mortgage was granted for preexisting obligations does not affect its priority. Regardless, this will not affect the owner's success because (1) there is no indication that there are other encumbrances on the property, and (2) the mortgage will likely be satisfied and thereby extinguished upon closing.

Educational objective: A mortgage is an encumbrance that can render title unmarketable. However, the seller has the right to satisfy the mortgage up to the time of closing and will often use the sale proceeds to do so.

选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 3%，C选项 0%，D选项 92%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

影响可售卖所有权 (marketable title) 的“危险信号”


契约 (Covenants)地役权 (Easements)
租赁 (Leases)留置权 (Liens)
所有权链中的空白 (Gaps in chain of title)边界争议 (Boundary disputes)
现有的区划违规 (Existing zoning violations)侵权逆占 (Adverse possession)
除非另有规定，所有土地买卖合同都含有一项默示担保，即卖方将在交易完成时向买方转让可售卖所有权 (marketable title)。所有权无需完美才能被认为是可售卖的。然而，它必须合理地无疑问，且不受诉讼威胁，以致于一个理性人会接受并为此付款。如果卖方在交易完成时无法转让可售卖所有权，买方可以撤销（即取消）合同。

所有权可能因产权负担（例如，地役权、抵押权、其他留置权）而变得不可售卖。虽然抵押是一种产权负担，但卖方有权在交易完成之前的任何时间清偿该抵押，并且通常会使用出售所得款项来这样做——正如本案中的所有人所安排的那样。因此，法院将支持所有人，因为交易完成本身很可能会使所有权变得可售卖。

(选项 A) 衡平法转换原则 (The doctrine of equitable conversion) 涉及合同成立至交易完成期间的财产所有权和损失风险。它不影响双方在土地买卖合同下的履行。

(选项 B) 如果买方有实际理由，她可以拒绝完成交易——即使那并非她拒绝的真实原因。

(选项 C) 优先权指的是债权人从止赎拍卖中获得偿付的顺序；抵押是否为已有的债务而设定，并不影响其优先权。无论如何，这不会影响所有人的胜诉，因为（1）没有迹象表明该土地上还有其他产权负担，以及（2）该抵押很可能会在交易完成时被清偿并因此消灭。

教学目标：抵押是一种可能导致所有权不可售卖的产权负担。然而，卖方有权在交易完成之前的任何时间清偿该抵押，并且通常会使用出售所得款项来这样做。

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Marketable Title
正确答案：D 所有人为支付抵押所做的安排，完全履行了他交付可售卖所有权的义务。
核心考点：可售卖所有权 (Marketable Title)

在土地买卖合同中，卖方有一项默示担保 (Implied Warranty)，即在交易完成时 (at closing) 提供可售卖所有权。

什么是可售卖所有权？
并非完美无瑕的所有权，而是指一个理性买家愿意接受、没有重大诉讼风险的所有权。

关键规则：同步清偿 (Simultaneous Satisfaction)

虽然抵押 (Mortgage) 确实是一种产权负担 (Encumbrance)，通常会使所有权不可售卖，但法律允许卖方利用“时间差”进行补救：

合同签订时
土地上存在抵押，此时所有权有负担。
交易完成日 (Closing Day)
卖方有权使用买方支付的购房款 (Proceeds) 当场清偿抵押。
结果
只要卖方安排了在 Closing 时还款，所有权在交付的那一刻就是“干净”的。

因此，买方不能以“存在抵押”为借口在 Closing 之前拒绝履行合同，除非卖方明显无力偿还（例如抵押金额高于房价）。

干扰项分析
A 错误 衡平法转换 (Equitable Conversion)： 该原则主要涉及签约后、过户前房屋毁损的风险承担问题（Risk of Loss），与卖方是否有能力提供好标题无关。
B 错误 买方的真实动机： 虽然买方确实是想找借口毁约，但如果所有权真的不可售卖，买方的动机就不重要了（她有权合法退出）。她败诉的原因不是因为她动机不纯，而是因为卖方确实提供了合格的所有权。
C 错误 抵押的优先权 (Priority)： 抵押权是否针对“已有债务”设定，只影响债权人之间的受偿顺序，不影响该抵押权作为产权负担的性质。只要它存在，就需要被清除，而卖方已经安排了清除。
💡 MBE 考试技巧
看到“买方因发现抵押想毁约”的题目时，首先检查：
卖方是否打算用出售所得款 (Proceeds) 在 Closing 时还贷？
如果是，买方通常不能以此为由拒绝交易。

questions.question:
A seller entered into a written contract to sell a tract of land to an investor. The contract made no mention of the quality of title to be conveyed. The seller and the investor later completed the sale, and the seller delivered a warranty deed to the investor.
Soon thereafter, the value of the land increased dramatically. The investor entered into a written contract to sell the land to a buyer. The contract between the investor and the buyer expressly provided that the investor would convey a marketable title. The buyer's attorney discovered that the title to the land was not marketable and had not been marketable when the original seller had conveyed to the investor. The buyer refused to complete the sale.
The investor sued the original seller for breach of contract, claiming damages from the seller's failure to convey marketable title, which resulted in the investor's loss of the sale to the subsequent buyer.
Who is likely to prevail on this count?

choices.a: The investor, because the law implies in such a contract a covenant that the title will be marketable.
choices.b: The investor, because the original seller is liable for all reasonably foreseeable damages.
choices.c: The original seller, because her contract obligations as to title merged into the deed.
choices.d: The original seller, because she did not expressly agree to convey marketable title.

data.questionStem:
Q86146

A seller entered into a written contract to sell a tract of land to an investor. The contract made no mention of the quality of title to be conveyed. The seller and the investor later completed the sale, and the seller delivered a warranty deed to the investor.

Soon thereafter, the value of the land increased dramatically. The investor entered into a written contract to sell the land to a buyer. The contract between the investor and the buyer expressly provided that the investor would convey a marketable title. The buyer's attorney discovered that the title to the land was not marketable and had not been marketable when the original seller had conveyed to the investor. The buyer refused to complete the sale.

The investor sued the original seller for breach of contract, claiming damages from the seller's failure to convey marketable title, which resulted in the investor's loss of the sale to the subsequent buyer.

Who is likely to prevail on this count?

一位卖方签订书面合同，将一块土地出售给一位投资人。合同没有提及所转让所有权的品质。随后，卖方和投资人完成了交易，卖方将一份担保契据交付给了投资人。

此后不久，该土地的价值急剧上涨。投资人与一位买方签订书面合同，欲将该土地出售。投资人与买方之间的合同明确规定，投资人将转让一份可销售的所有权。买方的律师发现，该土地的所有权不具有可销售性，并且在原始卖方转让给投资人时就不具有可销售性。买方因此拒绝完成交易。

投资人以原始卖方未能转让可销售的所有权，导致其无法将土地出售给后来的买方而遭受损失为由，对原始卖方提起违约之诉，要求损害赔偿。

在此诉因上，哪一方可能胜诉？
options:
A. The investor, because the law implies in such a contract a covenant that the title will be marketable.
投资人，因为法律默示此类合同中包含一项所有权具有可销售性的契约。

B. The investor, because the original seller is liable for all reasonably foreseeable damages.
投资人，因为原始卖方对所有可合理预见的损害承担责任。

C. The original seller, because her contract obligations as to title merged into the deed.
原始卖方，因为她关于所有权的合同义务已并入契据。

D. The original seller, because she did not expressly agree to convey marketable title.
原始卖方，因为她没有明确同意转让可销售的所有权。
data.explanation:
All contracts for the sale of land, unless otherwise stated, impliedly warrant that the seller will convey marketable title to the buyer upon closing (Choices A & D). However, once a deed is delivered to and accepted by the buyer, the doctrine of merger provides that all obligations contained within the land-sale contract merge into the deed. Those obligations can be enforced thereafter only if they are incorporated into the deed.

Here, the investor has sued the original seller for breach of contract, claiming damages from the seller's failure to convey marketable title. Although the investor's allegations appear to be true, he can only seek a remedy that arises from the deed - not the contract that merged with the deed. As a result, the original seller is likely to prevail.†

†The investor likely would have prevailed had he instead sued the original seller for breaching a covenant of title contained within the warranty deed that he received.

(Choice B) A seller may be liable for reasonably foreseeable damages that arise from a breach of a warranty in the deed or from fraudulent assertions in the land-sale contract. But neither ground has been asserted by the investor in this case.

Educational objective: Under the doctrine of merger, all obligations contained within the land-sale contract merge into the deed and can be enforced thereafter only if they are incorporated into the deed.

选项正确率统计：A选项 37%，B选项 6%，C选项 51%（正确选项），D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

所有土地买卖合同，除非另有规定，均默示保证卖方在交易完成时向买方转让可销售的所有权（选项A和D）。然而，一旦契据交付给买方并被其接受，合并原则 (doctrine of merger) 规定，土地买卖合同中包含的所有义务均并入契据。此后，这些义务只有在被纳入契据后才能强制执行。

在本案中，投资人以原始卖方未能转让可销售的所有权为由，对原始卖方提起违约之诉，要求损害赔偿。尽管投资人的指控似乎属实，但他只能寻求源于契据的救济——而不是那个已经与契据合并的合同。因此，原始卖方很可能胜诉。†

†如果投资人转而以原始卖方违反其收到的担保契据中所含的所有权契约为由提起诉讼，他很可能会胜诉。

（选项B）卖方可能因违反契据中的保证或土地买卖合同中的欺诈性陈述而产生的可合理预见的损害承担责任。但在本案中，投资人并未主张上述任何一项理由。

教学目标：根据合并原则 (doctrine of merger)，土地买卖合同中包含的所有义务均并入契据，此后只有在被纳入契据后才能强制执行。

MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Contracts
核心考点：合并原则 (Doctrine of Merger)

在不动产法中，土地买卖合同（Contract）中的条款在交割（Closing）并交付契据（Deed）后，即被视为“并入”契据之中。

这意味着：一旦买方接受了契据，合同中的默示条款（如可销售所有权）即告终止。买方此后只能依据契据中的条款（Covenants in the Deed）进行起诉，而不能再依据合同起诉。

案情逻辑推演
1
合同阶段：
原始卖方与投资人签订合同。虽然未提及所有权质量，但法律默示包含Marketable Title（可销售所有权/适销所有权）的保证。
2
交割阶段 (关键点)：
卖方交付了Warranty Deed（担保契据），投资人接受了。此时，合同义务并入契据。合同中关于“可销售所有权”的默示保证随之消灭。
3
诉讼阶段：
投资人起诉的理由是“违约” (Breach of Contract)，指控卖方未能根据合同转让可销售所有权。
4
结论：
由于合同已并入契据，投资人不能再基于合同起诉。他本应依据担保契据中的条款（如 Covenant of Seisin 或 Covenant Against Encumbrances）起诉。因为起诉依据错误，卖方胜诉。
选项深度解析
✅ 选项 C (正确答案)

“原始卖方胜诉，因为她关于所有权的合同义务已并入契据。”

这是对 Doctrine of Merger 的直接应用。合同中的默示保证在交割后不再独立存在。如果契据本身没有包含同样的保证（尽管本案是Warranty Deed，通常包含，但原告起诉的是合同违约而非契据违约），或者原告起诉的依据仅限于合同，则原告败诉。

❌ 选项 A (常见陷阱)

虽然法律确实在土地买卖合同中默示了“可销售所有权”的契约，但这项权利仅在交割前（Pre-closing）有效。一旦交割完成，该权利即被合并原则切断。

❌ 选项 B (无关干扰项)

“可预见的损害”是计算赔偿额的标准，前提是必须先确立责任（Liability）。由于合并原则免除了卖方在合同项下的责任，损害赔偿的计算就无从谈起。

❌ 选项 D (法律错误)

该选项声称卖方没有明确同意转让可销售所有权。这是错误的，因为除非另有约定，所有土地买卖合同都默示包含可销售所有权的保证。卖方胜诉不是因为没有保证，而是因为该保证在合同阶段结束后已失效。

💡 MBE 考试技巧：
遇到不动产买卖纠纷，首先画出时间轴：
1. 合同签订后，交割前：买方依据合同条款（Marketable Title）主张权利。
2. 交割后（拿到Deed）：买方必须依据契据条款（Deed Covenants）主张权利。

本题中，题目明确指出已经 "delivered a warranty deed"（已交割），且原告起诉的是 "breach of contract"（违约）。这种阶段与诉因的不匹配是解题的关键。
© MBE 备考助手 | 知识点：Real Property - Deeds & Merger

questions.question:
A seller contracted to sell a vacant lot to a purchaser. The written contract required the seller to provide evidence of marketable title of record, specified a closing date, stated that "time is of the essence," and provided that at closing, the seller would convey by warranty deed. The purchaser paid the seller $7,000 earnest money toward the $140,000 purchase price.
The title evidence showed that an undivided one-eighth interest in the lot was owned by a third party. The purchaser immediately objected to title and said she would not close on the seller's title. The seller responded, accurately, that the third party was his daughter who would be out of the country until two weeks after the specified closing date. He said that she would gladly deed her interest upon her return, and that meanwhile his deed warranting title to all of the lot would fully protect the purchaser. The seller duly tendered his deed on the specified closing date but the purchaser refused to close.
The purchaser brought an appropriate action to recover the $7,000 earnest money promptly after the specified closing date. The seller counterclaimed for specific performance, tendering a deed from himself and his daughter, who had by then returned.
Which party will likely prevail?

choices.a: The purchaser, because the seller's title was not marketable and time was of the essence.
choices.b: The purchaser, because under the circumstances the earnest money amount was excessive.
choices.c: The seller, because his warranty deed would have given the purchaser adequate interim protection.
choices.d: The seller, because the daughter's deed completing the transfer was given within a reasonable time.

data.questionStem:
Q86127

A seller contracted to sell a vacant lot to a purchaser. The written contract required the seller to provide evidence of marketable title of record, specified a closing date, stated that "time is of the essence," and provided that at closing, the seller would convey by warranty deed. The purchaser paid the seller $7,000 earnest money toward the $140,000 purchase price.

The title evidence showed that an undivided one-eighth interest in the lot was owned by a third party. The purchaser immediately objected to title and said she would not close on the seller's title. The seller responded, accurately, that the third party was his daughter who would be out of the country until two weeks after the specified closing date. He said that she would gladly deed her interest upon her return, and that meanwhile his deed warranting title to all of the lot would fully protect the purchaser. The seller duly tendered his deed on the specified closing date but the purchaser refused to close.

The purchaser brought an appropriate action to recover the $7,000 earnest money promptly after the specified closing date. The seller counterclaimed for specific performance, tendering a deed from himself and his daughter, who had by then returned.

Which party will likely prevail?

一名卖方与一名买方签订合同，出售一块空地。书面合同要求卖方提供有记录的可售卖产权证明，规定了交割日期，并声明“时间至关重要”，还规定在交割时，卖方将通过保证契约进行转让。买方向卖方支付了7,000美元定金，作为140,000美元购买价款的一部分。

产权证明显示，该地块八分之一的不可分割权益由第三方拥有。买方立即对产权提出异议，并表示她不会在此产权状况下进行交割。卖方如实回应称，该第三方是他的女儿，她要到指定交割日两周后才能回国。他说，女儿回来后会很乐意将她的权益转让，同时，他为整个地块提供产权保证的契约将充分保护买方。卖方在指定交割日正式提交了他的契约，但买方拒绝交割。

在指定交割日之后，买方立即提起适当诉讼，要求追回7,000美元的定金。卖方提起反诉，要求强制履行，并提交了一份由他自己和他当时已回国的女儿共同签署的契约。

哪一方可能会胜诉？
options:
A. The purchaser, because the seller's title was not marketable and time was of the essence.
买方，因为卖方的产权不具有可售卖性，且时间至关重要。

B. The purchaser, because under the circumstances the earnest money amount was excessive.
买方，因为在这种情况下，定金的数额过高。

C. The seller, because his warranty deed would have given the purchaser adequate interim protection.
卖方，因为他的保证契约本可以给予买方充分的临时保护。

D. The seller, because the daughter's deed completing the transfer was given within a reasonable time.
卖方，因为女儿用以完成转让的契约是在合理时间内给出的。
data.explanation:
A real estate contract is executed when the seller promises to deliver marketable title and the buyer promises to pay the purchase price. However, these promises need not be performed until closing or a reasonable time thereafter - unless the parties set a strict closing deadline. The closing date will be strictly enforced when the contract includes express language that makes time of the essence or the circumstances strongly suggest that the parties intended it to be.

Here, the contract stated that "time is of the essence," so the seller was required to deliver marketable title at the time of closing - no later. Title is marketable if it is reasonably free from doubt and under no threat of litigation such that a reasonable person would accept and pay for it. Since 1/8 of the seller's title was held by his daughter who could not deed her interest to him until two weeks after closing, the seller could not timely deliver marketable title with a warranty deed. Therefore, the seller breached the contract (Choices C & D).

When a seller has breached, the buyer's remedies include rescission and restitution. This allows the buyer to cancel the contract and receive the return of any paid deposits and other restitution. As a result, the purchaser will likely prevail in her action to recover the $7,000 earnest-money deposit.

(Choice B) A seller may retain the buyer's earnest-money deposit as liquidated damages so long as the deposit is not so excessive that it constitutes a penalty. An amount exceeding 15% of the purchase price is likely excessive, so the buyer's $7,000 deposit (5% of the purchase price) was not excessive.

Educational objective: Performance is strictly due at the time of closing when the real estate contract includes express language that makes time of the essence or when the circumstances strongly suggest that the parties intended it to be.



选项正确率统计：A选项 72%（正确选项），B选项 0%，C选项 7%，D选项 18%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当卖方承诺交付可售卖产权，且买方承诺支付购买价款时，一份不动产合同即告成立。然而，这些承诺无需在交割日或其后的合理时间内履行——除非双方设定了严格的交割截止日期。当合同中包含明确规定时间至关重要的语言，或情况强烈表明双方意图如此时，交割日期将被严格执行。

在本案中，合同声明“时间至关重要”，因此卖方被要求在交割之时——而不是之后——交付可售卖产权。如果产权在合理程度上没有疑问，且没有诉讼威胁，以至于一个理性人愿意接受并为此付款，那么该产权就是可售卖的。由于卖方产权的1/8由其女儿持有，而女儿在交割日之后两周才能将其权益转让给他，因此卖方无法通过保证契约及时交付可售卖产权。因此，卖方违反了合同（选项C和D）。

当卖方违约时，买方的救济措施包括合同解除和返还财产。这允许买方取消合同，并收回任何已付的定金和其他返还财产。因此，买方在其要求追回7,000美元定金的诉讼中可能会胜诉。

（选项B）只要定金数额不过高以至于构成罚款，卖方可以保留买方的定金作为违约金。超过购买价款15%的金额可能被视为过高，因此买方7,000美元的定金（购买价款的5%）并不过高。

教学目的：当不动产合同中包含明确规定时间至关重要的语言，或情况强烈表明双方意图如此时，合同的履行必须在交割之时严格完成。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Contracts
✅ 正确答案：选项 A 买方胜诉。因为卖方未能提供可售卖产权，且合同规定了“时间至关重要”。
考点一：时间至关重要条款

在普通法下，土地买卖合同的交割日期通常不被视为绝对截止日期。如果一方稍微晚一点（合理时间内）履行，通常不构成实质性违约。

但是，如果合同明确写入了 "Time is of the essence"（时间至关重要）条款，交割日期就变成了严格的截止线。

  • 规则：卖方必须在交割日当天提供可售卖产权。
  • 后果：任何迟延都被视为实质性违约 (Material Breach)，买方有权解除合同 (Rescind) 并拿回定金。
考点二：可售卖产权

卖方有默示义务在交割时提供 Marketable Title（可售卖产权）。

本案分析：

  • 产权调查显示第三方（女儿）拥有 1/8 的权益。
  • 这意味着卖方无法在交割日当天将 100% 的产权过户给买方。
  • 虽然卖方承诺“两周后”解决，但由于有“时间至关重要”条款，买方没有义务等待。
  • 卖方提议先给“保证契约” (Warranty Deed) 也不行，因为买方买的是产权本身，而不是一个“将来可以起诉卖方违约”的权利。
🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 B (定金过高)：通常定金不超过售价的 10%-15% 被认为是合理的违约金 (Liquidated Damages)。本案中 $7,000 仅占 $140,000 的 5%，完全合理，不构成惩罚性赔偿。
  • 选项 C (保证契约)：保证契约只是卖方对产权的担保，它不能治愈产权本身的缺陷。买方有权拒绝接受有瑕疵的产权，无论卖方如何担保。
  • 选项 D (合理时间)：这是最大的陷阱！如果合同没有写 "Time is of the essence"，那么选项 D 可能是对的（卖方可以在合理时间内补救）。但既然写了该条款，"合理时间" 规则就不再适用。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在做不动产合同题目时，第一步先看有没有 "Time is of the essence" 这句话。

  • 有：截止日期是死的，迟一天也是违约。
  • 没有：截止日期是软性的，只要在合理时间内（通常1-2个月内）完成交割即可。

questions.question:
A buyer and a seller entered into a written contract for the sale of an identified parcel of land. The contract expressly provided that the buyer was to pay $150,000 cash for the land at the time of the closing but did not state the closing date. The parties had not agreed on the closing date because the buyer was not sure at the time the contract was signed how she would raise the cash.
Fifteen days after the contract was signed, the seller learned that he could sell the land to a third party for $200,000. The seller asked the buyer if she would agree to rescind the contract. The buyer refused. The seller then told her that he would not complete the transaction, contending that the contract was unenforceable under the statute of frauds because an essential element (time for performance) was not agreed upon by the parties and was not expressly stated in the written agreement. The seller sold the land to the third party.
The buyer brought an appropriate action against the seller for breach of contract.
For which party is the court likely to find?

choices.a: The buyer, because of the doctrine of unjust enrichment.
choices.b: The buyer, because the court will infer that performance within a reasonable time was intended.
choices.c: The seller, because the contract is unenforceable under the statute of frauds.
choices.d: The seller, because time of performance is presumed to be of the essence.

The buyer brought an appropriate action against the seller for breach of contract.

For which party is the court likely to find? 一位买方和一位卖方就一特定地块的出售签订了一份书面合同。合同明确规定，买方应在过户时为该土地支付150,000美元现金，但未说明过户日期。双方未就过户日期达成一致，因为在签订合同时，买方不确定如何筹集现金。

合同签订十五天后，卖方得知他可以以200,000美元的价格将土地出售给第三方。卖方询问买方是否同意撤销合同。买方拒绝了。卖方随后告知她，他将不完成交易，并主张该合同根据《防止欺诈法》不可强制执行，因为一个必要条款（履行时间）未经双方同意，且未在书面协议中明确说明。卖方将土地出售给了第三方。

买方对卖方提起了适当的违约诉讼。

法院可能支持哪一方？
options:
A. The buyer, because of the doctrine of unjust enrichment.
买方，因为不当得利原则。

B. The buyer, because the court will infer that performance within a reasonable time was intended.
买方，因为法院会推断双方意图在合理时间内履行。

C. The seller, because the contract is unenforceable under the statute of frauds.
卖方，因为该合同根据《防止欺诈法》不可强制执行。

D. The seller, because time of performance is presumed to be of the essence.
卖方，因为履行时间被推定为合同的关键条款。
data.explanation:
Contracts for the sale of land are enforceable only if they comply with the statute of frauds. This statute requires that these contracts be in writing, be signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought, and contain all essential terms. Essential terms often include:

the identity of the parties words of intent to buy or sell a description of the property and the sales price.

However, time for performance is not an essential term. Instead, courts will infer that performance within a reasonable time was intended. And since the contract here satisfies all the aforementioned requirements, it is enforceable under the statute of frauds (Choice C).

(Choice A) Unjust enrichment does not apply when, as here, the claimant has not given anything of value. Therefore, the buyer will not prevail on this basis.

(Choice D) Time is not presumed to be of the essence unless it is expressly stated in the contract (not seen here).

Educational objective: Under the statute of frauds, contracts for the sale of land must be in writing, be signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought, and contain all essential terms. Time for performance is not an essential term, and courts will presume that performance with a reasonable time was intended if no time is listed.



土地买卖合同只有在符合《防止欺诈法》的情况下才能强制执行。该法规要求此类合同必须采用书面形式，由被请求执行的一方签署，并包含所有必要条款。必要条款通常包括：

当事人的身份 买卖意图的表述 财产的描述以及 售价。

然而，履行时间不是一个必要条款。相反，法院会推断双方意图在合理时间内履行。由于本案中的合同满足了上述所有要求，因此根据《防止欺诈法》是可强制执行的（选项C）。

（选项A）当请求人未提供任何有价物时，不当得利原则不适用，如此案情形。因此，买方不能以此为由胜诉。

（选项D）除非合同中明确规定（本案未见），否则履行时间不被推定为关键条款。

教学目标： 根据《防止欺诈法》，土地买卖合同必须是书面形式，由被请求执行的一方签署，并包含所有必要条款。履行时间不是一个必要条款，如果合同未列明时间，法院将推定双方意图在合理时间内履行。

References

MBE 考点解析

Real Property | Statute of Frauds
正确答案：B

买方胜诉。

法院会推断双方意图在合理时间 (Reasonable Time) 内履行合同。

核心考点：防止欺诈法 (SOF)

土地买卖合同必须符合《防止欺诈法》 (Statute of Frauds) 才能强制执行。这意味着合同必须：

  • 是书面的 (In writing)
  • 由被执行方签署 (Signed by the party to be charged)
  • 包含所有必要条款 (Essential Terms)

关键点：什么是必要条款？

  • ✅ 当事人身份 (Parties)
  • ✅ 土地描述 (Description of land)
  • ✅ 价格 (Price)
  • ❌ 履行时间/过户日期 (Time for performance) 不是必要条款！
本案逻辑分析

卖方试图利用 SOF 撤销合同，理由是缺少“过户日期”。

然而，根据普通法规则，如果土地买卖合同中遗漏了过户日期，合同不会因此无效。相反，法院会自动填补这一空白，推定双方意图在合理的时间内完成交易。

因此，卖方关于“合同因缺少必要条款而不可执行”的抗辩是无效的。

易错陷阱辨析

🚫 选项 C (卖方胜诉)：

这是本题最大的干扰项。考生容易误以为所有条款都必须写在纸上。请记住：时间不是土地合同的必要条款。

🚫 选项 D (时间至关重要)：

这是一个常见的概念混淆。只有当合同明确规定“时间至关重要” (Time is of the essence) 时，迟延履行才构成实质性违约。法律不会自动推定时间是至关重要的。本案合同未提及此点，因此该推定不成立。

🚫 选项 A (不当得利)：

不当得利 (Unjust Enrichment) 通常用于一方已付款或提供服务，而另一方未履行的情况。本案中买方尚未支付现金，卖方也没有从中获利，因此该原则不适用。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 财产法题目中，看到卖方因为“价格上涨”想毁约，并试图找合同漏洞（如缺少日期）时，通常法院会倾向于维护合同的有效性。

记住公式：
缺少日期 ≠ 合同无效
缺少日期 = 合理期限

A seller owned a lot improved with an aging four-story warehouse. The warehouse was built to the lot lines on all four sides. On the street side, recessed loading docks permitted semi-trailers to be backed in. After the tractors were unhooked, the trailers extended into the street and occupied most of one lane of the street. Over the years, as the trailers became larger, the blocking of the street became more severe. The municipality advised the seller that the loading docks could not continue to be used because the trailers blocked the street; it gave the seller 90 days to cease and desist.
During the 90 days, the seller sold and conveyed the lot by warranty deed for a substantial consideration to a buyer. The problem of the loading docks was not discussed in the negotiations.
Upon expiration of the 90 days, the municipality required the buyer to stop using the loading docks. This action substantially reduced the value of the lot.
If the buyer seeks cancellation of the deed and return of all monies paid, which claim should the buyer bring against the seller?

choices.a: Breach of the covenant of warranty.
choices.b: Failure of consideration.
choices.c: Misrepresentation.
choices.d: Mutual mistake.

一名卖方拥有一块地皮，上面建有一座老旧的四层仓库。该仓库的四面墙体均建至地皮边界。在临街一侧，内凹的装卸平台允许半挂式卡车倒车驶入。当牵引车脱钩后，挂车会延伸至街道上，占据了大部分一条车道。多年来，随着挂车尺寸变大，对街道的堵塞情况也愈发严重。市政当局通知卖方，由于挂车堵塞街道，该装卸平台不得继续使用；并给予卖方90天的时间停止使用。

在这90天内，卖方通过一份担保契据，以可观的对价将该地皮出售并转让给了一名买方。在谈判过程中，双方并未讨论装卸平台的问题。

90天期限届满后，市政当局要求买方停止使用装卸平台。这一措施大幅降低了该地皮的价值。

如果买方寻求撤销该契据并要求返还所有已支付的款项，买方应对卖方提出何种诉求？
options:
A. Breach of the covenant of warranty.
违反担保契约。

B. Failure of consideration.
对价不成立。

C. Misrepresentation.
虚假陈述。

D. Mutual mistake.
共同错误。
data.explanation:
When disclosure is required to avoid misrepresentation


Previous assertionDisclosure would prevent previous assertion from being a misrepresentation or fraudulent or material
Mistake about basic assumptionDisclosure would correct other party's mistake about basic assumption of contract AND Failure to disclose would constitute lack of good faith & fair dealing
Fiduciary relationshipOther party is entitled to know fact because of confidential/fiduciary relationship
Mistake about writingDisclosure would correct other party's mistake about contents or effect of writing that embodies agreement
A misrepresentation is an untrue assertion of fact that makes a contract voidable by the adversely affected party when: the misrepresentation is fraudulent OR material, the misrepresentation induced assent to the contract and the adversely affected party justifiably relied on the misrepresentation.

Nondisclosure of a known fact is tantamount to an assertion that it does not exist if, among other things, the party not disclosing the fact knows that: disclosure would correct the other party's mistake about a basic assumption of the contract and the failure to disclose would violate the duty of good faith and fair dealing.

Here, the seller misrepresented that the loading docks could continue to be used (basic assumption of the contract) by failing to disclose to the buyer that this was untrue (lack of good faith and fair dealing). As a result of this misrepresentation, the buyer purchased the lot. And because the misrepresentation was not obviously false or known by the buyer to be false, the buyer justifiably relied on it. Therefore, misrepresentation is the claim the buyer should bring against the seller.

(Choice A) A covenant of warranty is the seller's promise to protect the buyer against claims of superior title brought by another party (not seen here).

(Choice B) The buyer should not claim failure of consideration because the buyer's agreement with the seller was supported by consideration (ie, conveyance of the lot in exchange for the purchase price).

(Choice D) There was no mutual mistake that would make the contract voidable here because only one party, the buyer, was mistaken about the use of loading docks.

Educational objective: Nondisclosure of a known fact is tantamount to an assertion that it does not exist if the party not disclosing the fact knows that (1) disclosure would correct the other party's mistake about a basic assumption of the contract and (2) the failure to disclose would violate the duty of good faith and fair dealing.

选项正确率统计：A选项 35%，B选项 0%，C选项 62%（正确选项），D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在何种情况下为避免虚假陈述而需要披露信息


先前的断言披露信息可防止先前的断言构成虚假陈述、欺诈或重大事项
关于基本假设的错误披露信息可纠正另一方关于合同基本假设的错误，并且不披露将构成对善意与公平交易义务的违反
信托关系由于存在保密/信托关系，另一方有权知晓事实
关于书面文件的错误披露信息可纠正另一方关于体现协议的书面文件内容或效力的错误
虚假陈述是指对事实的不实断言，在下列情况下，受不利影响的一方可因此撤销合同：该虚假陈述具有欺诈性或重大性，该虚假陈述诱使对方同意订立合同，并且受不利影响的一方正当地信赖了该虚假陈述。

不披露已知事实，等同于断言该事实不存在，如果未披露事实的一方知晓以下情况（其中包括）：披露信息将纠正另一方对合同基本假设的错误，并且不披露将违反善意与公平交易的义务。

在本案中，卖方未向买方披露装卸平台无法继续使用的真相（缺乏善意与公平交易），从而虚假地陈述了装卸平台可以继续使用（合同的基本假设）。由于这一虚假陈述，买方购买了该地皮。并且由于该虚假陈述并非明显错误，买方也未知其为虚假，因此买方正当地信赖了该陈述。所以，虚假陈述是买方应对卖方提出的诉求。

（选项A）担保契约是卖方作出的承诺，保证买方免受第三方提出的更优权利主张的侵害（本案中未出现此情况）。

（选项B）买方不应主张对价不成立，因为买方与卖方之间的协议是有对价支持的（即以购买价款交换地皮的转让）。

（选项D）本案中不存在可使合同被撤销的共同错误，因为只有一方，即买方，对装卸平台的使用存在错误认知。

教学目标：不披露已知事实等同于断言该事实不存在，如果未披露事实的一方知晓（1）披露信息会纠正另一方对合同基本假设的错误，并且（2）不披露会违反善意和公平交易的义务。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 161 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when nondisclosure is a misrepresentation).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 164 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when misrepresentation makes a contract voidable).

MBE 考点解析

Real Estate Contracts / Real Property
正确答案：C (Misrepresentation)

买方应基于虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation) 提出索赔。

⚖️ 核心法律规则：沉默即虚假陈述

在传统的普通法中，原则是“买者自负” (Caveat Emptor)，卖方通常没有义务披露缺陷。但是，现代合同法（如《合同法重述（第二次）》§ 161）确立了一个重要的例外：

不披露 (Nondisclosure) 等同于断言该事实不存在（即构成虚假陈述），如果：

  • 卖方知道该事实会纠正买方关于合同基本假设 (Basic Assumption) 的错误；并且
  • 不披露该事实违反了善意 (Good Faith) 和公平交易的原则。
🔍 案情分析

在本案中，我们可以提取出以下关键要素：

  1. 重大事实：市政当局已下令禁止使用装卸平台，这将大幅降低土地价值。
  2. 卖方知情：卖方收到了通知，明确知道这一限制。
  3. 买方不知情：买方在不知情的情况下购买，且这是一个隐蔽的法律/行政限制，而非显而易见的物理缺陷。
  4. 沉默：卖方在90天宽限期内迅速出售，且未提及此事。

卖方的行为构成了欺诈性隐瞒 (Fraudulent Concealment) 或至少是基于不披露的虚假陈述。因此，买方有权要求撤销合同 (Rescission)。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错误的？
A. 违反担保契约 (Breach of covenant of warranty)

错误原因：担保契据 (Warranty Deed) 保证的是所有权 (Title) 的完整性（例如没有未披露的抵押、第三方权利主张等）。

市政当局的土地使用限制（如分区条例或本案中的停用命令）通常被视为警察权 (Police Power) 的行使，而非所有权瑕疵。只要卖方合法拥有土地，就没有违反所有权担保。

B. 对价不成立 (Failure of consideration)

错误原因：只有当买方完全没有收到任何有价值的东西时（例如地皮根本不存在，或契据无效），才构成对价不成立。本案中，买方确实获得了地皮和仓库，只是价值低于预期。这属于估值错误，而非对价缺失。

D. 共同错误 (Mutual mistake)

错误原因：共同错误要求双方都对同一基本事实存在误解。在本案中，卖方完全知晓装卸平台被禁用的事实，只有买方处于错误认知中。这属于单方错误 (Unilateral Mistake)，且由于卖方知情不报，更适合归类为虚假陈述。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

区分“物理缺陷”与“法律限制”：

当题目涉及政府命令、分区法或违规使用时，首先排除“所有权担保”(Title Covenants) 类的选项，因为这些通常不属于 Title Defect。

寻找“知情不报”：

如果一方知道核心事实而另一方不知道，且该事实严重影响价值，通常指向 Misrepresentation（如果涉及欺诈）或 Unilateral Mistake（如果涉及利用对方错误）。

questions.question:
Three months ago, a buyer agreed in writing to buy a seller's single-family residence for $110,000. The buyer paid the seller a $5,000 deposit to be applied to the purchase price. The contract stated that the seller had the right at his option to retain the deposit as liquidated damages in the event of the buyer's default. The closing was to have taken place last week.
Six weeks ago, the buyer was notified by his employer that he was to be transferred to another job 1,000 miles away. The buyer immediately notified the seller that he could not close, and therefore he demanded the return of his $5,000 deposit. The seller refused and waited until after the contract closing date to sell the residence to a real estate broker for $108,000. The broker paid the full purchase price and immediately recorded his deed. The broker knew of the prior contract with the buyer.
In an appropriate action, the buyer seeks to recover the $5,000 deposit from the seller.
What is the most probable result?

choices.a: The seller may keep the $5,000 deposit, because the buyer breached the contract.
choices.b: The seller must return $3,000 to the buyer, because the seller's damages were only $2,000.
choices.c: The seller must return the $5,000 to the buyer, because the buyer was legally justified in not completing the contract.
choices.d: The seller must return the $5,000 to the buyer, because the seller can no longer carry out his contract with the buyer.

In an appropriate action, the buyer seeks to recover the $5,000 deposit from the seller.

What is the most probable result?

三个月前，一名买方书面同意以110,000美元的价格购买一名卖方的独栋住宅。买方向卖方支付了5,000美元的定金，该定金将用于支付购买价款。合同规定，如果买方违约，卖方有权选择保留该定金作为违约赔偿金。交易原定于上周完成。

六周前，买方接到其雇主的通知，他将被调往1000英里外的另一份工作。买方立即通知卖方他无法完成交易，因此要求退还其5,000美元的定金。卖方拒绝了，并等到合同规定的交易完成日期之后，以108,000美元的价格将该住宅出售给了一名房地产经纪人。该经纪人支付了全部购买价款，并立即登记了他的地契。该经纪人知道之前与买方的合同。

在一次适当的诉讼中，买方试图向卖方追回5,000美元的定金。

最可能的结果是什么？
options:
A. The seller may keep the $5,000 deposit, because the buyer breached the contract.
卖方可以保留5,000美元的定金，因为买方违反了合同。

B. The seller must return $3,000 to the buyer, because the seller's damages were only $2,000.
卖方必须向买方退还3,000美元，因为卖方的损失仅为2,000美元。

C. The seller must return the $5,000 to the buyer, because the buyer was legally justified in not completing the contract.
卖方必须向买方退还5,000美元，因为买方不履行合同具有法律上的正当理由。

D. The seller must return the $5,000 to the buyer, because the seller can no longer carry out his contract with the buyer.
卖方必须向买方退还5,000美元，因为卖方已无法履行其与买方的合同。

Seller's remedies


Rescission & restitutionRescind (ie, cancel) agreement & recover possession of property
Rental value & physical damages are recoverable
Buyer not liable for purchase price
Specific performanceSeek an injunction ordering buyer to pay agreed purchase price
May be unavailable if money damages provide adequate compensation & property is not unique
eg, condominium identical to other units in complex
DamagesLoss of bargain = contract price - market value at time of breach
Liquidated damages = amount designated in the sales contract as compensation for breach
Retain buyer's deposit (up to amount of seller's actual damages)
Incidental & consequential damages that were contemplated during sales contract or reasonably foreseeable
Land-sale contracts can include a liquidated damages provision , which allows a seller to recover a certain sum in the event of the buyer's breach. These provisions are enforceable if the liquidated amount bears a reasonable relation to anticipated damages. Courts have consistently held that an amount less than 15% of the purchase price is reasonable. However, an amount that exceeds this percentage may constitute an unenforceable penalty.

Here, the buyer breached the contract when he notified the seller that he could not close. The land-sale contract allows the seller to recover the $5,000 deposit as liquidated damages in the event of the buyer's breach. Since this amount is around 5% of the $110,000 purchase price, the liquidated-damages provision is reasonable and will likely be enforced. Therefore, the most probable result is that the seller will be permitted to keep the $5,000 deposit.

(Choice B) Had the liquidated-damages provision been unenforceable, the seller would have been required to return the deposit and could only recover his actual damages, which amounted to $2,000.

(Choice C) Changed circumstances may provide legal justification for not completing a contract if those circumstances make performance impossible or impracticable. However, the buyer's job transfer does not make it impossible or impracticable to purchase the residence since he can later sell the home.

(Choice D) The seller could have carried out the contract with the buyer at the time of closing since he still had title to the residence at that time. The fact that he cannot carry out his contract with the buyer at this time is irrelevant.

Educational objective: A liquidated damages provision is enforceable if the amount bears a reasonable relation to anticipated damages. An amount less than 15% of the purchase price is likely reasonable.

选项正确率统计：A选项 69%（正确选项），B选项 23%，C选项 5%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

卖方的救济措施


合同解除与返还解除（即取消）协议并收回房产所有权
可追讨租金价值和物理损害赔偿
买方不承担购买价款的支付责任
强制履行寻求法院禁令，命令买方支付约定的购买价款
如果金钱赔偿足以提供充分补偿且房产并非独一无二，则可能无法获得此救济
例如，与综合楼中其他单元完全相同的公寓
损害赔偿交易损失 = 合同价格 - 违约时的市场价值
违约赔偿金 = 销售合同中指定的作为违约赔偿的金额
保留买方定金（最高不超过卖方的实际损失额）
在签订销售合同时已预见到或可合理预见的附带损害和间接损害
土地销售合同可以包含违约赔偿金条款，该条款允许卖方在买方违约时收回一定金额。如果预定的赔偿金额与预期损害具有合理关系，则这些条款是可强制执行的。法院一贯认为，低于购买价格15%的金额是合理的。然而，超过此百分比的金额可能构成不可执行的罚款。

在本案中，买方在通知卖方他无法完成交易时违反了合同。土地销售合同允许卖方在买方违约时，收回5,000美元的定金作为违约赔偿金。由于该金额约为110,000美元购买价格的5%，因此该违约赔偿金条款是合理的，并且很可能被强制执行。因此，最可能的结果是卖方将被允许保留这5,000美元的定金。

(选项B) 如果违约赔偿金条款不可执行，卖方将被要求退还定金，且只能追偿其2,000美元的实际损失。

(选项C) 如果情势变更导致合同履行不可能或不切实际，则该情势变更可为不履行合同提供法律上的正当理由。然而，买方的工作调动并未使其购买该住宅变得不可能或不切实际，因为他可以在日后出售该房屋。

(选项D) 在交易完成时，卖方本可以履行与买方的合同，因为当时他仍然拥有该住宅的所有权。他此时无法履行与买方的合同这一事实是无关紧要的。

教学目标： 如果违约赔偿金的金额与预期损害具有合理关系，则该条款是可强制执行的。低于购买价格15%的金额很可能是合理的。

References

77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 478 (2020) (seller's recovery of liquidated damages).

MBE 考点解析

Real Estate Contracts (房地产合同)
⚖️ 核心考点：违约赔偿金 (Liquidated Damages)

在房地产合同中，如果买方违约，卖方能否没收定金取决于该条款是否有效。有效的违约赔偿金条款必须满足两个条件：

  1. 在签约时，实际损害难以估算 (Difficult to estimate)；
  2. 约定的金额是对可能损害的合理预估 (Reasonable forecast)。

如果金额过高，会被视为惩罚性条款 (Penalty) 而无效。

📊 本案数据分析

法院通常认为，房地产交易中定金占购买价格的 10% - 15% 以内是合理的。

房价 (Price): $110,000
定金 (Deposit): $5,000
比例: $5,000 ÷ $110,000 ≈ 4.5%

结论： 4.5% 的比例显然是合理的 (Reasonable)。因此，该条款有效。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 A)

卖方可以保留 $5,000 定金。

因为违约赔偿金条款 (Liquidated Damages Clause) 有效，卖方有权直接执行该条款，没收定金。一旦认定该条款有效，卖方无需证明实际损失，也不受实际损失金额的限制（除非金额差异巨大到显失公平，但在本案中不适用）。

❌ 易错陷阱解析 (选项 B)

陷阱：卖方只需退还 $3,000？

很多考生会计算实际损失：
$110,000 (原价) - $108,000 (转售价) = $2,000 (实际损失)。

错误原因： 只有在没有有效的违约赔偿金条款时，或者该条款被判定为无效（惩罚性）时，法院才会退回到“实际损害赔偿” (Actual Damages) 的计算。既然合同中已经有了有效的“一口价”赔偿条款，就按条款执行，不再计算实际盈亏。

❌ 其他错误选项

选项 C (工作调动)： 错误。虽然买方工作调动是意外，但这不构成履行不能 (Impossibility) 或 商业目的落空 (Frustration of Purpose)。买方仍然可以支付款项并购买房屋（即使他不住那里）。个人困难通常不是违约的合法抗辩。

选项 D (卖方已出售)： 错误。卖方是在买方明确表示违约 (Repudiation) 且过了交割日之后才转售的。卖方有义务减轻损失 (Mitigate damages)，转售行为是合法的，并不影响其追究买方违约责任的权利。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧：

看到“定金” (Deposit) 和“违约” (Default) 的题目：

  • 首先检查定金比例。如果是 10% 或更低，通常视为有效的 Liquidated Damages。
  • 如果条款有效，不要去计算实际损失 (Actual Damages) 来做减法。
  • 记住：Liquidated Damages 的目的就是为了避免计算实际损失的麻烦。

questions.question:
A vendor owned a tract of land in fee simple. The vendor entered into a valid written agreement with a purchaser under which the vendor agreed to sell and the purchaser agreed to buy the land by installment purchase. The contract stipulated that the vendor would deliver to the purchaser, upon the payment of the last installment due, "a warranty deed sufficient to convey fee simple." The contract contained no other provision that could be construed as referring to title.
The purchaser entered into possession of the land. After making 10 of the 300 installment payments obligated under the contract, the purchaser discovered that there was outstanding a valid and enforceable mortgage on the land, securing the payment of a debt in the amount of 25% of the purchase price the purchaser had agreed to pay. There was no evidence that the vendor had ever been late in payments due under the mortgage and there was no evidence of any danger of insolvency of the vendor. The value of the land now is four times the amount due on the debt secured by the mortgage.
The purchaser quit possession of the land and demanded that the vendor repay the amounts the purchaser had paid under the contract. After the vendor refused the demand, the purchaser brought an appropriate action against the vendor to recover damages for the vendor's alleged breach of the contract.
In such action, should damages be awarded to the purchaser?

choices.a: No, because the purchaser assumed the risk by taking possession.
choices.b: No, because the time for the vendor to deliver marketable title has not arrived.
choices.c: Yes, because in the absence of a contrary express agreement, an obligation to convey marketable title is implied.
choices.d: Yes, because the risk of loss assumed by the purchaser in taking possession relates only to physical loss.

data.questionStem:
Q86141

A vendor owned a tract of land in fee simple. The vendor entered into a valid written agreement with a purchaser under which the vendor agreed to sell and the purchaser agreed to buy the land by installment purchase. The contract stipulated that the vendor would deliver to the purchaser, upon the payment of the last installment due, "a warranty deed sufficient to convey fee simple." The contract contained no other provision that could be construed as referring to title.

The purchaser entered into possession of the land. After making 10 of the 300 installment payments obligated under the contract, the purchaser discovered that there was outstanding a valid and enforceable mortgage on the land, securing the payment of a debt in the amount of 25% of the purchase price the purchaser had agreed to pay. There was no evidence that the vendor had ever been late in payments due under the mortgage and there was no evidence of any danger of insolvency of the vendor. The value of the land now is four times the amount due on the debt secured by the mortgage.

The purchaser quit possession of the land and demanded that the vendor repay the amounts the purchaser had paid under the contract. After the vendor refused the demand, the purchaser brought an appropriate action against the vendor to recover damages for the vendor's alleged breach of the contract.

In such action, should damages be awarded to the purchaser?

一位卖方以完全保有地权(fee simple)的形式拥有一块土地。该卖方与一位买方签订了一份有效的书面协议，根据该协议，卖方同意出售，买方同意以分期付款的方式购买该土地。合同规定，在买方支付最后一笔到期分期款项后，卖方将向买方交付一份“足以转让完全保有地权(fee simple)的担保契据(warranty deed)”。合同中没有其他可被解释为涉及所有权的条款。

买方已占有该土地。在支付了合同规定的300期分期付款中的10期后，买方发现该土地上存在一笔有效且可强制执行的抵押，该抵押担保了一笔债务的支付，债务金额为买方同意支付的购买价格的25%。没有证据表明卖方曾迟延支付抵押贷款的到期款项，也没有证据表明卖方有任何破产的危险。目前该土地的价值是抵押所担保债务到期金额的四倍。

买方放弃了对土地的占有，并要求卖方偿还其根据合同已支付的款项。在卖方拒绝该要求后，买方对卖方提起了适当的诉讼，要求赔偿卖方被指控的违约行为所造成的损失。

在此诉讼中，是否应判给买方损害赔偿？
options:
A. No, because the purchaser assumed the risk by taking possession.
不应，因为买方通过占有土地承担了风险。

B. No, because the time for the vendor to deliver marketable title has not arrived.
不应，因为卖方交付可售所有权(marketable title)的时间尚未到来。

C. Yes, because in the absence of a contrary express agreement, an obligation to convey marketable title is implied.
应，因为在没有相反明确约定的情况下，转让可售所有权(marketable title)的义务是默示的。

D. Yes, because the risk of loss assumed by the purchaser in taking possession relates only to physical loss.
应，因为买方因占有而承担的损失风险仅涉及物理损失。
data.explanation:
"Red flags" for marketable title


  • Covenants
  • Easements
  • Leases
  • Liens
  • Gaps in chain of title
  • Boundary disputes
  • Existing zoning violations
  • Adverse possession


The warranty of marketable title is implied in all land-sale contracts unless otherwise stated. This guarantees that, upon closing, the seller will convey the buyer title that is reasonably free from doubt and under no threat of litigation, such that a reasonable person would accept and pay for it. In the case of an installment land contract - ie, one in which the buyer takes possession of the property and pays the purchase price over time - the seller need not deliver marketable title until the buyer makes the final payment.

Here, the purchaser made 10 of the 300 installment payments before discovering the outstanding mortgage on the land. Although an existing mortgage can render title unmarketable, the vendor does not need to deliver marketable title until the purchaser has made the final installment payment. Therefore, damages should not be awarded to the purchaser because the time for the vendor to deliver marketable title has not arrived (Choice C).

(Choices A & D) Under the doctrine of equitable conversion, the risk of loss is on the buyer during the period between contract formation and closing - regardless of whether the buyer takes possession. The risk of loss assumed by the buyer typically relates to physical loss (eg, from fire), but the doctrine may also apply to legal changes (eg, zoning changes). However, this has no relevance to the seller's obligation to deliver title as promised.

Educational objective: Under an installment land contract, the time for the seller to deliver marketable title arrives when the buyer makes the final installment payment.

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 86%（正确选项），C选项 11%，D选项 0%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

可售所有权(marketable title)的“危险信号”


  • 契约
  • 地役权
  • 租赁
  • 留置权
  • 所有权链中的空白
  • 边界争议
  • 现有的区划违规
  • 侵权逆占


除非另有规定，可售所有权(marketable title)的保证在所有土地销售合同中都是默示的。这保证了在交易完成(closing)时，卖方将向买方转让一个合理地没有疑问且不受诉讼威胁的所有权，以至于一个理性人会接受并为此付款。在分期付款土地合同(installment land contract)的情况下——即买方占有财产并随时间支付购买价格的合同——卖方无需在买方支付最后一笔款项之前交付可售所有权(marketable title)。

在本案中，买方在发现土地上存在未偿清的抵押之前，支付了300期分期付款中的10期。虽然现有的抵押可以使所有权变得不可售，但卖方在买方支付最后一笔分期款项之前，无需交付可售所有权(marketable title)。因此，不应判给买方损害赔偿，因为卖方交付可售所有权(marketable title)的时间尚未到来（选项B）。

（选项A和D）根据衡平法转换原则(doctrine of equitable conversion)，在合同成立和交易完成之间的期间，损失风险由买方承担——无论买方是否占有该财产。买方承担的损失风险通常涉及物理损失（例如，火灾造成的损失），但该原则也可能适用于法律变更（例如，区划变更）。然而，这与卖方按承诺交付所有权的义务无关。

教学目的：在分期付款土地合同下，卖方交付可售所有权(marketable title)的时间点是买方支付最后一笔分期款项之时。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 3.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (installment land contracts).

77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 93 (2020) (marketable title).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Installment Land Contracts
⚖️ 核心法律规则 (The Rule) 在分期付款土地合同 (Installment Land Contract)中，卖方交付可售所有权 (Marketable Title)的义务，仅在买方支付最后一笔分期付款时才到期。
案情逻辑分析

本题考察的是卖方何时必须清除产权负担（如抵押 Mortgage）。

  1. 合同性质：这是一个分期付款合同。买方先占有土地，分300期付款，付清后才获得地契（Deed）。
  2. 现状：买方仅支付了10期（10/300）。
  3. 问题：土地上有抵押，买方认为这是产权瑕疵，要求解约赔偿。
  4. 法律适用：虽然所有土地买卖合同都默示包含“可售所有权”保证，但这个保证的时间点是交割日 (Closing)。

在分期付款合同中，真正的“交割”是最后一笔付款日。在此之前，卖方完全有权利用买方的分期付款来偿还自己的抵押贷款。只要卖方在最后期限能拿出一张干干净净的地契，就不算违约。

选项深度解析
✅ 选项 B (正确答案)
"No, because the time for the vendor to deliver marketable title has not arrived."
这是对上述规则的直接应用。买方起诉得太早了。卖方目前没有义务提供无抵押的产权，只要他在第300期付款时能提供即可。
❌ 选项 C (主要干扰项)
虽然“默示包含可售所有权义务”这半句是对的，但它忽略了时间要素。义务是存在的，但履行的期限尚未到来。
❌ 选项 A & D (无关项)
这两个选项讨论的是衡平法转换 (Equitable Conversion) 和损失风险 (Risk of Loss)。
虽然买方占有土地通常要承担物理损失（如火灾）的风险，但这与卖方是否有权在产权上保留抵押无关。不要被“Risk”这个词带偏。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
看到 Installment Land Contract（分期付款合同）时，立即警惕时间点问题。

如果是普通房屋买卖（签约后30-60天交割），卖方必须在Closing Day提供好产权。
如果是分期付款（长达数年），卖方直到最后一天才有义务清除产权瑕疵。除非卖方已经破产或明显无法在到期时履约，否则买方不能提前起诉。
